title.en: Sydney records warmest winter on record as Melbourne equals previous hottest temperatures
title.zh: 悉尼创下有记录以来最温暖的冬天，墨尔本则追平此前最热纪录

summary.en: Australia's New South Wales, Victoria, and Tasmania have just experienced their warmest winters on record. The Bureau of Meteorology (BoM) predicts that above-average temperatures are likely to continue across much of the country, with an increased chance of unusually high maximums during spring.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的新南威尔士州、维多利亚州和塔斯马尼亚州刚刚经历了有记录以来最温暖的冬天。气象局（BoM）预测，全国大部分地区将继续保持高于平均水平的温度，并且在春季出现异常高温的可能性增加。

body.en: New South Wales, Victoria and Tasmania just experienced their warmest-ever winters – and BoM says above-average temperatures expected to continue Australia’s two biggest cities had their hottest and equal hottest winters on record, with three eastern states also breaking temperature records. The Bureau of Meteorology’s (BoM) spring outlook shows above average daytime and nighttime temperatures are expected to continue for much of the country, with an increased chance of unusually high maximums. Continue reading...
body.zh: 新南威尔士州、维多利亚州和塔斯马尼亚州刚刚经历了有史以来最温暖的冬天，BoM表示，预计气温将持续高于平均水平，澳大利亚最大的两个城市迎来了有记录以来最热的冬天，东部三个州也打破了气温记录。气象局 (BoM) 的春季展望显示，该国大部分地区的白天和夜间气温预计将持续高于平均水平，出现异常高最高气温的可能性也会增加。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Earth's climate systems are a testament to the intricate wisdom of its Creator. As record-breaking temperatures are observed, we are reminded of the delicate balance of creation and the profound knowledge embedded within its design. May we approach these changes with a spirit of awe and careful stewardship.
reflection.zh: 地球的气候系统是其创造者精妙智慧的明证。当创纪录的温度出现时，我们被提醒要认识到受造物的微妙平衡及其设计中蕴含的深刻知识。愿我们以敬畏之心和审慎的管理态度来应对这些变化。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Burnham to say he wants to unlock ‘positivity’ in first statement to MPs since becoming PM – UK politics live
title.zh: 首相在成为首相后首次向议员发表讲话，表示希望释放“积极性”——英国政治直播

summary.en: The Prime Minister will bring an upbeat message to the adversarial Commons after a summer of policy announcements and improved poll ratings. Alex Norris, the Justice Secretary, has insisted prisons will "still function properly" amid concerns over government plans to turn laundries into cells in a bid to tackle...
summary.zh: 在夏季公布政策并提高民意支持率后，首相将向充满对抗性的下议院带来积极的信息。司法大臣亚历克斯·诺里斯坚称，在政府计划将洗衣房改建成牢房以解决过度拥挤问题的担忧中，监狱将“仍然正常运作”。司法部宣布将斥资1.1亿英镑，利用现有的空间，如空置办公室、洗衣房和其他区域，在监狱中建造新牢房。

body.en: Prime minister will bring upbeat message to adversarial Commons after a summer of policy announcements and improved poll ratings Alex Norris , the justice secretary, has insisted prisons will “still function properly” amid concerns over government plans to turn laundries into cells in a bid to tackle overcrowding. As Ben Quinn reports, the Ministry of Justice announced overnight that it will spend £110m creating new cells in prisons using existing spaces like unused offices, laundry rooms and other areas. Of course we’re going to make sure that the prisons can still function properly. This is a creative look, as I say, around our estate and being able to use some space that we can re-prioritise. Those wouldn’t necessarily be the numbers I’d use, but it is possible that places come out of the estate. For example, you know, there can be damage, fire damage. We’ve got a very old estate. Continue reading...
body.zh: 经过一个夏天的政策宣布和民调支持率的提高，总理将向敌对的下议院传达乐观的信息。司法部长亚历克斯·诺里斯坚称监狱将“仍然正常运作”，因为人们对政府计划将洗衣房改成牢房以解决人满为患的问题感到担忧。据本·奎因报道，司法部连夜宣布，将斥资 1.1 亿英镑在监狱中利用现有空间（如未使用的办公室、洗衣房和其他区域）建造新牢房。当然，我们要确保监狱仍然能够正常运作。正如我所说，这是一种创造性的外观，围绕着我们的庄园，并且能够利用一些我们可以重新确定优先级的空间。这些不一定是我会使用的数字，但地方可能来自庄园。例如，你知道，可能会造成损坏、火灾损坏。我们有一处非常古老的庄园。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The government's plan to convert laundry rooms into prison cells, while aiming to address overcrowding, raises questions about the dignity and justice afforded within the penal system. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with God. This principle encourages a thoughtful approach to governance, ensuring that solutions to practical...
reflection.zh: 政府将洗衣房改建成监狱牢房的计划，虽然旨在解决过度拥挤问题，但引发了对监狱系统内尊严和公正的疑问。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与雅伟同行。这一原则鼓励一种深思熟虑的治理方式，确保实际问题的解决方案不损害基本的道德标准。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: At least 12 people killed in Russian overnight attacks on Ukraine – Europe live
title.zh: 俄罗斯夜袭乌克兰至少造成12人死亡

summary.en: Russian overnight attacks have killed at least 12 people and injured dozens more, leaving thousands without electricity in Ukraine's Odesa region. Ukraine's air force reported that Russia launched over 2,800 jet-powered drones in August, with an interception rate of about 60% for these harder-to-shoot-down models.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯的夜间袭击已造成至少12人死亡，数十人受伤，使乌克兰敖德萨地区数千人断电。乌克兰空军报告称，俄罗斯在8月份发射了超过2800架喷气式无人机，其中较难拦截的型号的拦截率约为60%。

body.en: Zelenskyy says dozens more injured as strikes leave thousands without electricity in Odesa region Russia ⁠launched more ⁠than ⁠2,800 harder-to-shoot-down jet-powered ​drones at ⁠Ukraine in August, Ukraine’s ⁠air ​force ‌spokesperson ‌ Yuriy Ihnat ‌said on Tuesday. Their interception rate was ‌lower compared with ​other types of drones, ⁠at around ​60%, Ihnat ​told ​Ukrainian ​television in comments reported by Reuters. Continue reading...
body.zh: 泽连斯基表示，敖德萨地区的罢工导致数千人断电，造成数十人受伤。乌克兰空军发言人尤里·伊纳特 (Yuriy Ihnat) 周二表示，俄罗斯 8 月在乌克兰发射了超过 2,800 架难以击落的喷气式无人机。伊纳特在路透社报道的评论中告诉乌克兰电视台，与其他类型的无人机相比，它们的拦截率较低，约为 60%。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The relentless nature of the attacks, causing widespread destruction and leaving thousands in darkness, speaks to a deep and ongoing suffering. In such times, the ancient words of Lamentations offer a profound truth: 'The steadfast love of Yahweh never ceases; his mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.' Even...
reflection.zh: 袭击的持续性造成大范围破坏，使数千人陷入黑暗，这反映了一种深刻而持续的苦难。在这样的时刻，《耶利米哀歌》中的古老话语提供了一个深刻的真理：“雅伟的慈爱永不枯竭；他的怜悯每早更新；你的信实广大。”即使在毁灭之中，雅伟永恒信实的应许也带来一丝希望。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: UK house prices rise for first time since April, says Nationwide
title.zh: 英国房价自4月以来首次上涨，Nationwide称

summary.en: The average price of a home rose 0.2% month on month in August to £275,465, as the market awaits an interest rate vote. Research reveals that UK houses near top state secondary schools cost £40,000 more. UK house prices increased for the first time in four months in August, according to a leading index, with buyers...
summary.zh: 8月份，房屋平均价格较上月上涨0.2%，达到275,465英镑，市场正等待利率投票。研究显示，英国顶尖公立中学附近的房屋价格高出4万英镑。根据一项主要指数，英国房价在8月份四个月来首次上涨，买卖双方在今年晚些时候预期加息前处于“观望状态”。

body.en: Average price of home rose 0.2% month on month in August to £275,465 as market awaits interest rate vote UK houses near top state secondary schools cost £40,000 more, research reveals UK house prices increased for the first time in four months in August, according to a leading index, as buyers and sellers remain in a “holding pattern” before an expected increase in interest rates later this year. The average price of a British home rose 0.2% month on month in August to £275,465, the first increase since April, according to Nationwide. Analysts had forecast a 0.1% rise in house prices. Continue reading...
body.zh: 市场等待利率投票，8月份房屋平均价格环比上涨0.2%，至275,465英镑 英国顶尖公立中学附近的房屋价格上涨了40,000英镑，研究显示，根据一项领先指数，英国8月份房价出现四个月以来的首次上涨，因为买家和卖家在预计今年晚些时候加息之前仍处于“持有模式”。根据 Nationwide 的数据，8 月份英国房屋的平均价格环比上涨 0.2%，达到 275,465 英镑，这是自 4 月份以来的首次上涨。分析师此前预测房价将上涨0.1%。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news reports a slight uptick in UK house prices, but the underlying tension is the anticipation of rising interest rates. This financial pressure, where borrowing costs increase, echoes the ancient wisdom that 'the borrower is slave to the lender.' Many households may soon feel this burden more acutely, highlighting the precariousness of financial...
reflection.zh: 新闻报道英国房价小幅上涨，但潜在的紧张之处在于人们预期利率会上升。这种财务压力，即借贷成本增加，呼应了古老的智慧：“欠债的是债主的仆人”。许多家庭可能很快会更深切地感受到这种负担，这凸显了财务稳定的脆弱性。

verse.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verse.textZh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。

title.en: Thai resort prepares to host USS Abraham Lincoln sailors after more than 270 days at sea
title.zh: 泰国度假胜地准备接待在海上超过270天的“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航空母舰船员

summary.en: Security has been increased in the Thai resort city of Pattaya as it prepares to welcome thousands of sailors and marines from the USS Abraham Lincoln. Their deployment was extended due to the US war in Iran, and they have been at sea for more than 270 consecutive days. Approximately 600 officials will provide...
summary.zh: 泰国度假城市芭堤雅已加强安保措施，准备迎接“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航空母舰上数千名水手和海军陆战队员的到来。由于伊朗的战争，他们的部署已被延长，并且他们已连续在海上度过了270多天。约有600名官员将提供安保和其他必要协助。

body.en: Security stepped up in Pattaya before arrival of thousands of sailors and marines, whose deployment was extended due to US war in Iran Authorities in the Thai resort city of Pattaya have stepped up security as they prepare to welcome thousands of sailors and marines from the USS Abraham Lincoln after more than 270 consecutive days at sea . “About 600 officials will provide security and other necessary assistance,” the provincial governor, Narit Niramaiwong, told AFP. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在数千名水手和海军陆战队员抵达之前，芭堤雅加强了安全保护，由于美国对伊朗的战争，部署时间延长了。泰国度假城市芭堤雅当局加强了安全保护，准备迎接连续海上航行 270 多天的亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰上的数千名水手和海军陆战队员。省长纳里特·尼拉迈旺 (Narit Niramaiwong) 告诉法新社：“约 600 名官员将提供安全和其他必要援助。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: After more than 270 days at sea, the crew of the USS Abraham Lincoln are nearing the end of a long and demanding deployment. The prophet Isaiah speaks of those who wait on Yahweh, finding their strength renewed to soar like eagles, run without growing weary, and walk without fainting. May this crew find rest and rejuvenation as they complete their mission.
reflection.zh: 在海上度过了270多天后，“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航空母舰的船员们即将结束一次漫长而艰巨的任务部署。先知以赛亚论到那些等候雅伟的人，他们的力量必更新，如同鹰一般展翅上腾，奔跑却不疲倦，行走却不困乏。愿这支船员队伍在完成任务之际，找到休息和恢复的力量。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: Nepal death toll crosses 1,000 as rescuers race to find workers trapped in mud-filled tunnels
title.zh: 尼泊尔救援人员炸开山坡搜寻水电工人，家属焦急等待

summary.en: Rescuers are using explosives in a desperate attempt to reach workers trapped in tunnels following severe flooding in Nepal. The death toll from the disaster has risen to 939, with over 600 workers feared missing.
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔发生严重洪灾后，救援人员正使用炸药绝望地试图接触被困在隧道中的工人。此次灾难的死亡人数已升至939人，另有超过600名工人据信失踪。

body.en:
The death toll in Nepal from devastating floods on the border with Tibet has crossed 1,000, according to the country's disaster agency.

More than 3,900 people remain missing - of whom more than 600 are workers believed to be trapped in a vast network of mud-filled tunnels at hydropower sites along Trishuli River.

Engineers have been pumping air into the tunnels - and while a team did manage to gain entry to one of them, it withdrew after finding no-one there.

"I wish we could find him. I wish he would come home," Anushila Bhandari, wife of Aurus Bhandari, a 33-year-old engineer missing on a project site, told BBC Nepali.

Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah said on Monday that 279 people had been rescued from the sites.

The rescue operation is being spearheaded by an international team made up of Chinese and Nepalese military personnel, while experts from India, Korea and Australia are also involved.

"I still have a 50% hope that he is alive because there is an oxygen system inside," Sita Pandey, whose husband was working in the plant when the floods hit, told Nepalese daily Kantipur.

Nepal relies heavily on hydropower and has spent years developing the projects along its mountainous river systems. At least 11 projects either completed or under construction were damaged in the floods, authorities said.

Rescuers began pumping air into a tunnel over the weekend, but the families of those trapped say that should have been done earlier.

A team was able to get into a tunnel leading to one hydropower plant earlier on Monday, but retreated after no one was found there.

"The longer it takes, the more our hope dies. This operation must move much faster because every second is meaningful to us," Jiban Khadka, whose relative is also trapped inside the plant, told Kantipur.

Rescue operations had been "intensified", Nepalese leader Shah said, noting that the floods were "not an ordinary" event.

"This incident indicates that the risks we face in the Himalayan region are increasing alongside climate change.

"It is now time for us to strongly raise with the international community the issue of the disasters we are experiencing as a result of climate change," Shah wrote in a Facebook post late on Monday.

Another family member anxiously awaiting news is Priya Kharel, whose brother Milan was working as an engineer in the Upper Trishuli-1 plant when the floods hit.

"Those who returned from the hydropower site said there were people inside the tunnel," she told BBC News Nepali. "So there is hope that if the army reaches them quickly, they can be saved."

Australian engineer Arnold Dix, who has been helping Nepalese authorities with the underground search operations remotely, said rescuers had been struggling to find the tunnels.

body.zh: 据信，600多名工人的家人被困在尼泊尔特里苏利河沿岸一个巨大的泥浆隧道中，他们的家人迫切希望能够找到他们的亲人。 周一，救援人员继续奋力救援，他们使用炸药炸毁山坡，然后向 Trishuli-3A 现场泵入空气——担心救援幸存者的关键窗口正在关闭。 “我希望我们能找到他。我希望他能回家，”在项目工地上失踪的 33 岁工程师 Aurus Bhandari 的妻子 Anushila Bhandari 告诉 BBC 尼泊尔语。 据尼泊尔灾害管理局称，尼泊尔和西藏边境的洪涝灾害造成的死亡人数已达939人。 该机构还将失踪人数估计数修正为 3,925 人，其中 592 人是外国人。 据信，大约七分之一的失踪人员是水力发电厂的工人。尼泊尔总理巴伦德拉·沙阿周一表示，已有 279 人从事故现场获救。 此次救援行动由中国和尼泊尔军事人员组成的国际救援队牵头，印度、韩国和澳大利亚的专家也参与其中。 西塔·潘迪（Sita Pandey）告诉尼泊尔日报《康提普尔》（Kantipur），洪水来袭时，他的丈夫正在工厂工作，“我仍有 50% 的希望，因为他还活着，因为里面有氧气系统。” 尼泊尔严重依赖水力发电，并花了数年时间开发沿山区河流系统的项目。当局表示，至少 11 个已竣工或在建项目在洪水中受损。 救援人员周末开始向隧道中泵入空气，但被困人员的家属表示，应该早点做。 周一早些时候，一支队伍进入了通往一座水电站的隧道，但在发现那里无人后撤退。 “时间越长，我们的希望就越破灭。这次行动必须加快速度，因为每一秒对我们来说都有意义，”吉班·卡德卡（Jiban Khadka）的亲戚也被困在工厂内，他告诉坎蒂普尔。 尼泊尔领导人沙阿表示，救援行动已经“加强”，并指出洪水“不是一次普通”事件。 “这一事件表明，我们在喜马拉雅地区面临的风险随着气候变化而增加。 沙阿周一晚间在脸书上发帖称：“现在是我们向国际社会强烈提出气候变化造成的灾难问题的时候了。” 另一位焦急等待消息的家庭成员是 Priya Kharel，洪水来袭时，他的兄弟 Milan 正在 Upper Trishuli-1 核电站担任工程师。 “那些从水电站回来的人说隧道里有人，”她告诉英国广播公司尼泊尔新闻。 “所以有...

reflection.en: In the face of overwhelming natural disaster, the courage of rescuers and the desperate hope of families are palpable. Amidst such chaos and loss, Psalm 46:1 reminds us that God is our refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble. May those searching find the trapped, and may all affected find solace in a higher power.
reflection.zh: 面对压倒性的自然灾害，救援人员的勇气和家属的绝望的希望显而易见。在如此混乱和损失中，《诗篇》46:1提醒我们，神是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。愿搜救人员找到被困者，愿所有受影响的人在更高的力量中找到安慰。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Zambia's president to be sworn in for second term while opponent detained
title.zh: 赞比亚总统将连任，反对派对手被拘留

summary.en: Hakainde Hichilema won the election decisively, but his primary rival is now in detention facing treason charges.
summary.zh: 哈凯恩德·希奇莱马以压倒性优势赢得选举，但其主要竞争对手目前正面临叛国罪的指控并被拘留。

body.en:
Zambia's President Hakainde Hichilema is due to be sworn in for a second five-year term on Tuesday following a disputed election and the arrest of his main opponent on treason charges.

Hichilema - credited with stabilising the economy - swept to victory on 13 August with 60% of the vote, according to official results. Runner-up Brian Mundubile, who received 38%, alleged that the outcome had been tampered with.

He was unable to mount a legal challenge to the result as the courts were sealed off last week on the final day a case could be filed.

Election observers said that while polling day was largely peaceful, some have raised questions about the vote tallying process.

European Union observers said staff in many tallying centres did not record results on tally sheets as soon as they were announced and cited weak verification between digital entries and paper records.

It added that returning officers frequently paused proceedings while awaiting instructions from headquarters.

The day after the poll, security forces raided a property in the capital, Lusaka, linked to Mundubile, killing a former cabinet minister and arresting a number of opposition politicians.

The authorities accused the opposition of planning an armed insurrection, which they denied.

Mundubile and his running mate, Makebi Zulu, had gone into hiding. They were detained by police last week and charged at the weekend.

When Hichilema, 64, came into office in 2021 after a landslide victory, Zambia had recently defaulted on its international debt and had an annual inflation rate of more than 24%.

"We inherited a broken-down country… the economy was declining," Hichilema told the BBC in Lusaka before the election.

The former businessman negotiated a restructuring of the debt and rebuilt relations with foreign creditors. Inflation has also come down, but prices are still rising and many continue to struggle with the cost of living.

Hichilema now wants to build on the foundations he said he laid over the past five years.

Presidents from Kenya, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Namibia and Tanzania are among several African leaders expected to attend the inauguration ceremony at the National Heroes Stadium in Lusaka.
body.zh: 赞比亚总统哈凯恩德·希奇莱马将于周二宣誓就职，开始第二个五年任期。此前，他进行了一场有争议的选举，并以叛国罪逮捕了他的主要对手。 根据官方结果，希奇莱马因稳定经济而受到赞誉，并于 8 月 13 日以 60% 的选票横扫胜利。获得 38% 的亚军布赖恩·蒙杜比莱 (Brian Mundubile) 声称结果被篡改。 他无法对结果提出法律质疑，因为上周法院在可以提起诉讼的最后一天被封锁。 选举观察员表示，虽然投票日基本上是和平的，但一些人对计票过程提出了质疑。 欧盟观察员表示，许多统计中心的工作人员并没有在结果公布后立即将结果记录在统计表上，并指出数字条目和纸质记录之间的验证薄弱。 它补充说，返回官员在等待总部指示时经常暂停程序。 投票后第二天，安全部队突袭了首都卢萨卡与蒙杜比莱有关的一处房产，杀死了一名前内阁部长，并逮捕了一些反对派政客。 当局指责反对派策划武装叛乱，但他们予以否认。 蒙杜比莱和他的竞选搭档马克比·祖鲁已经躲藏起来。他们上周被警方拘留，并于周末受到指控。 2021年，64岁的希奇莱马以压倒性胜利上任时，赞比亚最近出现国际债务违约，年通货膨胀率超过24%。 “我们接手的是一个支离破碎的国家……经济正在衰退，”选举前希奇莱马在卢萨卡告诉英国广播公司。 这位前商人就债务重组进行了谈判，并与外国债权人重建了关系。通货膨胀也有所下降，但物价仍在上涨，许多人仍在为生活成本而苦苦挣扎。 希奇莱马现在希望在他所说的过去五年奠定的基础上再接再厉。 来自肯尼亚、博茨瓦纳、津巴布韦、纳米比亚和坦桑尼亚的总统等几位非洲领导人预计将出席在卢萨卡国家英雄体育场举行的就职典礼。

reflection.en: The inauguration of President Hichilema for a second term is overshadowed by the detention of his main opponent on treason charges. This situation raises questions about the integrity of the electoral process and the rule of law, echoing the biblical concern for just governance where rulers are held accountable and justice prevails.
reflection.zh: 希奇莱马总统即将开始第二个任期，但其主要反对派对手却因叛国罪被拘留，这给就职典礼蒙上阴影。这种情况引发了对选举过程公正性和法治的质疑，呼应了圣经中对公正治理的关注，即统治者应承担责任，公正得以伸张。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Ex-gang boss guilty of orchestrating 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur
title.zh: 前帮派头目被判犯有策划1996年说唱歌手图帕克·夏库尔谋杀案

summary.en: Duane "Keffe D" Davis has been convicted of orchestrating the murder of rap superstar Tupac Shakur, who was killed in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas 30 years ago. This marks the first conviction in the high-profile cold case.
summary.zh: 杜安“Keffe D”戴维斯因策划说唱巨星图帕克·夏库尔的谋杀案而被定罪，夏库尔在30年前的拉斯维加斯的一场驾车枪击案中遇害。这是这起备受瞩目的悬案首次获得定罪。

body.en:
Former gang boss Duane "Keffe D" Davis has been found guilty of orchestrating the murder of Tupac Shakur - the first conviction in a cold case that has intrigued hip-hop fans for nearly 30 years.

The jury found him guilty of one count of murder with a deadly weapon for the rap superstar's death in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas on 7 September 1996.

Dressed in a black suit, the 63-year-old stood impassively in the Las Vegas court as the verdict was read, before saying he would appeal.

During the trial, the court heard a recording of a police interview in 2008 in which Davis said he was in the car from which shots were fired, but did not himself fire the bullets that killed Shakur.

Prosecutors argued that although Davis, a former leader of the South Side Compton Crips street gang, did not himself fire the gun, he ordered the shooting and supplied the gun that his nephew Orlando Anderson used to open fire.

Anderson died in an unrelated shooting in 1998, having denied involvement in the killing of Shakur.

As the verdict was read out on Monday, Shakur's relatives held hands, some hugging and crying.

Shakur was 25 when he was slain at the height of his career as one of rap's most influential voices. He has sold more than 75 million records worldwide.

For 30 years, the case remained one of America's most famous cold cases, spurring countless conspiracies - but never a conviction, until now.

During the trial, prosecutors said Davis had planned the shooting as retaliation after Anderson was involved in a fight with Shakur and his crew in Las Vegas just hours earlier.

Shakur's murder happened at a time of intense rivalry between the East Coast and West Coast rap scene and amid gang feuds between the Bloods and Crips, which had deep roots within hip-hop at the time.

His family appeared emotional in court, his sister embracing a prosecutor after the verdict was read while others sat crying nearby.

The key evidence in the case were Davis' own words, in which he repeatedly and publicly acknowledged being inside the white Cadillac from where the deadly shots were fired.

He had told authorities about his role in Shakur's death during a secret 2008 police interview related to the death of fellow rapper Notorious B.I.G., real name Christopher Wallace.

But his book and media interviews voided a protective agreement he had established with authorities that had blocked any criminal charges being filed, with the court ruling his police interview could be used in the murder trial against him.

In closing arguments, prosecutor Binu Palal told jurors to take Davis at his word and find him guilty.

For years, he argued, Davis had been telling people "that he is responsible for Tupac Shakur's murder" through documentaries, his memoir, podcasts and a police...
body.zh: 前黑帮老大杜安·“凯夫·D”·戴维斯 (Duane "Keffe D" Davis) 因策划谋杀图帕克·沙库尔 (Tupac Shakur) 被判有罪，这是近 30 年来引起嘻哈迷关注的悬案中的首次定罪。 陪审团裁定他犯有一项使用致命武器谋杀罪，导致这位说唱巨星于 1996 年 9 月 7 日在拉斯维加斯发生的驾车枪击事件中死亡。 宣读判决时，这位 63 岁的男子身着黑色西装，面无表情地站在拉斯维加斯法庭上，然后表示将上诉。 在审判期间，法庭听取了 2008 年警方采访的录音，戴维斯称他当时就在开枪的车里，但他本人并没有开枪杀死沙库尔。 检察官辩称，虽然南区康普顿克里普斯街头帮派的前头目戴维斯本人没有开枪，但他下令开枪，并提供了他的侄子奥兰多·安德森用来开枪的枪。 安德森于 1998 年死于一场无关的枪击事件，他否认参与杀害沙库尔。 周一宣读判决时，沙库尔的亲属手拉着手，有些人拥抱哭泣。 沙库尔 (Shakur) 被杀时年仅 25 岁，他是说唱界最具影响力的声音之一，正值他职业生涯的巅峰时期。他在全球已售出超过 7500 万张唱片。 三十年来，此案一直是美国最著名的悬案之一，引发了无数阴谋，但直到现在才被定罪。 在审判期间，检察官表示，戴维斯计划开枪是为了报复安德森几个小时前在拉斯维加斯与沙库尔及其团队发生的打架事件。 沙库尔的谋杀案发生在东海岸和西海岸说唱界之间激烈竞争的时期，以及 Bloods 和 Crips 之间的帮派争斗之中，这些争斗在当时的嘻哈音乐中根深蒂固。 他的家人在法庭上显得情绪激动，宣读判决后，他的妹妹拥抱了一名检察官，而其他人则坐在附近哭泣。 该案的关键证据是戴维斯自己的话，他在其中多次公开承认自己在开枪的白色凯迪拉克车内。 2008 年，警方秘密约谈时，他曾向当局讲述了自己在 Shakur 之死中所扮演的角色，该约谈涉及说唱歌手 Notorious B.I.G.（真名 Christopher Wallace）的死亡。 但他的书和媒体采访使他与当局达成的保护协议无效，该协议阻止了任何刑事指控，法院裁定他的警方采访可以用于针对他的谋杀案审判。 在结案陈词中，检察官比努·帕拉尔告诉陪审员相信戴维斯的话并判定他有罪。 他认为，多年来，戴维斯一直通过纪录片、他的回忆录、播客和警方告诉人们“他对图帕克·沙库尔的谋杀负有责任”……

reflection.en: For nearly three decades, the murder of Tupac Shakur remained an unsolved tragedy, a wound in the cultural landscape. The conviction of Duane Davis brings a measure of closure, yet it also underscores the destructive cycle of violence that ensnares individuals and communities. "Put your sword back in its place," Jesus told Peter, "for all who draw the sword...
reflection.zh: 近三十年来，图帕克·夏库尔的谋杀案一直是一桩悬案，是文化领域的一道伤疤。杜安·戴维斯的定罪带来了一定程度的了结，但也凸显了卷入个人和社区的破坏性暴力循环。“收起你的剑吧，”耶稣对彼得说，“因为凡动刀的，必死在刀下。”（马太福音 26:52）。愿这一判决成为一个令人警醒的提醒，警示暴力的最终徒劳。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: What's behind the 'biggest oil deal in world history' Trump is touting with Venezuela?
title.zh: 特朗普吹嘘的与委内瑞拉的“史上最大石油交易”背后是什么？

summary.en: Critics say the deal is the reason the Trump administration captured then-president Nicolás Maduro in a raid earlier this year. Details are emerging about what United States President Donald Trump is calling "the biggest oil deal in world history" with Venezuela. Trump said the agreement announced on Saturday would...
summary.zh: 批评人士称，这项协议是特朗普政府今年早些时候突袭抓捕委内瑞拉前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗的原因。有关美国总统唐纳德·特朗普所称的“史上最大石油交易”的细节正在浮出水面。特朗普表示，周六宣布的协议将使美国获得委内瑞拉庞大石油储备的股份，这是他从该国获取能源目标的一步，此前美军于一月份的一次午夜突袭中抓获了时任总统尼古拉斯·马杜...

body.en:
Details are emerging about what United States President Donald Trump is calling "the biggest oil deal in world history" with Venezuela.

Trump said the agreement announced on Saturday would give the US a stake in Venezuela's vast oil reserves, a step toward his goal of extracting energy from the country after US forces captured then-president Nicolás Maduro in a middle-of-the-night raid in January and brought him to New York to face federal drug trafficking charges.

Venezuela's acting president, Delcy Rodríguez, described the deal as a step toward economic recovery that will modernise the country’s oil industry.

In a televised address to the nation on Sunday, Rodríguez insisted Venezuela's sovereignty is secure and said she wants the country to become a global energy powerhouse.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The US government and a private operator in Venezuela have formed a new company that has been granted rights to access untapped oil fields for 100 years.

A statement from Rodríguez said the deal involves the development of 17 fields with a proven potential of 65 billion barrels.

It said the agreement could draw US$100 billion ($139 billion) in investment into Venezuela's oil industry and yield over US$209 billion ($291 billion) in taxes for the country.

The private operator is North America Blue Energy Partners, owned by Alejandro Betancourt, the White House confirmed on Tuesday.

The company currently produces about 200,000 barrels a day, which makes it the second-largest private operator in Venezuela behind Chevron, according to a source who spoke on condition of anonymity because they were not authorised to release the information.

Trump said the agreement was negotiated by US secretary of state Marco Rubio, defence secretary Pete Hegseth and Rodríguez.

The deal will give the US a 35 per cent ownership stake in the company, and the US state department will get a guarantee to buy 20 per cent of the output at cost. US purchases of oil will go towards US strategic oil reserves along with the military, according to a US official who was not authorised to discuss the matter publicly and spoke on the condition of anonymity.

The company would be the second largest corporate holder of proven reserves after Saudi Aramco, according to the US official.

Bob McNally, who was an energy adviser in former US president George W Bush's administration, said the current administration appears to be seeking ways to make it easier for the private sector to invest in Venezuela's industry through the deal.

"However, investors will remain cautious even if the terms of the deal, once released, pass legal muster. A future...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普所称的与委内瑞拉的“世界历史上最大的石油交易”的细节正在浮出水面。 特朗普表示，周六宣布的协议将使美国获得委内瑞拉庞大石油储备的股份，这是他向从该国开采能源的目标迈出的一步，此前美国军队在一月份的一次半夜突袭中抓获了时任总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗，并将他带到纽约接受联邦贩毒指控。 委内瑞拉代理总统德尔西·罗德里格斯 (Delcy Rodríguez) 表示，该协议是迈向经济复苏的一步，将实现该国石油工业的现代化。 罗德里格斯在周日向全国发表的电视讲话中坚称委内瑞拉的主权是安全的，并表示她希望该国成为全球能源强国。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 美国政府和委内瑞拉一家私人运营商成立了一家新公司，该公司已获得 100 年来未开发油田的开采权。 罗德里格斯在一份声明中表示，该交易涉及 17 个油田的开发，已证实潜力达 650 亿桶。 据称，该协议将为委内瑞拉石油工业吸引1000亿美元（1390亿美元）的投资，并为该国带来超过2090亿美元（2910亿美元）的税收。 白宫周二证实，这家私营运营商是亚历杭德罗·贝当古 (Alejandro Betancourt) 所有的北美蓝色能源合作伙伴公司 (North America Blue Energy Partners)。 据一位不愿透露姓名的消息人士透露，该公司目前每天生产约 20 万桶石油，这使其成为委内瑞拉第二大私营运营商，仅次于雪佛龙。 特朗普表示，该协议是由美国国务卿卢比奥、国防部长皮特·赫格斯和罗德里格斯谈判达成的。 这笔交易将使美国获得该公司35%的股权，美国国务院将获得以成本价购买20%产出的保证。一位未获授权公开讨论此事且不愿透露姓名的美国官员表示，美国购买的石油将与军方一起用于美国战略石油储备。 据美国官员称，该公司将成为继沙特阿美公司之后第二大探明储量企业持有者。 美国前总统乔治·W·布什政府的能源顾问鲍勃·麦克纳利表示，现任政府似乎正在寻求方法，让私营部门更容易通过该协议投资委内瑞拉的工业。 “然而，即使交易条款一旦公布并通过法律审查，投资者仍将保持谨慎。未来......

reflection.en: The news describes a significant shift in US-Venezuelan relations, marked by the capture of a leader and a major oil deal. Such events raise questions about power dynamics and the potential for exploitation, reminding us of the biblical warning against oppressive rule. The pursuit of national interest, when unchecked by justice, can lead to actions that...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻描述了美委关系的一个重大转变，以一位领导人的被捕和一项重大的石油交易为标志。此类事件引发了关于权力动态和剥削可能性的问题，提醒我们圣经中关于压迫性统治的警告。当国家利益的追求不受正义的约束时，就可能导致类似暴政的行为。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: How catastrophic flash flood unfolded at remote Nepal-China border point
title.zh: 喜马拉雅山脉偏远尼泊尔-中国边境口岸灾难性山洪暴发始末

summary.en: Over 100 Indians are missing at a vital Nepal-China trade crossing after devastating Himalayan floods.
summary.zh: 在毁灭性的喜马拉雅山洪爆发后，有超过100名印度人在一个至关重要的尼泊尔-中国贸易过境点失踪。

body.en:
A dark wall appears from behind the buildings at Gyirong, on the Chinese side of the Nepal-Tibet border. At first, it looks almost like a black cloud. Then it gathers shape and speed: water, mud, boulders, ice and rock surging down the valley. The timestamp on the CCTV footage reads 10:59:53 local time.

What happened in the minutes that followed is still difficult to reconstruct. But fragments of video and satellite imagery from before and after the disaster have begun to reveal the scale of the destruction. Much of the border complex appears to have been swept away, with buildings that once crowded the valley floor simply gone.

Gyirong was one of the places devastated by the floods that tore through the region on 26 August.

Just across the frontier, at Rasuwagadhi in Nepal's Rasuwa district, the destruction was also extensive. The Friendship Bridge linking Nepal and China was swept away, along with Nepal's immigration and customs facilities. Timure, the small trading settlement clustered around the crossing, was devastated.

"This is a historic travel route between Kathmandu and Tibet. The area is geologically vulnerable, characterised by deep gorges and steep rivers that flow at high velocity, carry heavy sediment and can bring down huge boulders," says Ajay Dixit, a Kathmandu-based hydrologist.

The route remains an important gateway between Nepal and China. It is a place where pilgrims heading towards Mount Kailash cross paths with traders travelling between Nepal and China, truck drivers, customs officials, tourists and people who live along the border.

On the morning of the flood, more than 100 Indians may have been in or around the crossing. At least 275 Indians remain missing in Nepal, according to India's foreign ministry.

Nepal's Department of Immigration has been trying to reconstruct who passed through Rasuwagadhi in the final hours before the disaster.

Electronic records show that 89 Nepali and foreign nationals had cleared immigration to leave Nepal for Tibet, while four people had registered their entry into Nepal.

The immigration system recorded its final transaction at 8:35:03am local time (10:52am Tibet time), less than 10 minutes before the torrent appeared on the CCTV footage at Gyirong.

Four immigration employees, including the head of the Rasuwagadhi office, went missing in the floods. His body was later recovered far downstream. The female official who recorded the final transactions is still missing.

Among the foreign nationals recorded leaving Nepal that morning were 32 Indians, 12 Chinese nationals and nine Americans, as well as citizens of Britain, Canada, Australia and Italy.

Tika Ram Pokharel, a senior immigration assistant at Rasuwagadhi, was the only member of his office known to have survived. He had...
body.zh: 吉隆位于尼泊尔和西藏边境的中国一侧，建筑物后面出现了一堵黑墙。起初，它看起来几乎像一朵乌云。然后它的形状和速度都聚集起来：水、泥土、巨石、冰和岩石沿着山谷汹涌而下。闭路电视录像上的时间戳显示当地时间 10:59:53。 接下来几分钟发生的事情仍然很难重现。但灾难前后的视频和卫星图像片段已经开始揭示破坏的规模。边境建筑群的大部分似乎已被冲走，曾经拥挤在谷底的建筑物完全消失了。 吉隆是8月26日席卷该地区的洪水所摧毁的地方之一。 就在边境另一边，尼泊尔拉苏瓦地区的拉苏瓦加迪也遭受了广泛破坏。连接尼泊尔和中国的友谊大桥以及尼泊尔的移民和海关设施被冲毁。蒂穆尔（Timure）是一个聚集在过境点周围的小型贸易定居点，遭到了破坏。 加德满都水文学家阿贾伊·迪克西特 (Ajay Dixit) 表示：“这是加德满都和西藏之间的一条历史悠久的旅行路线。该地区地质脆弱，其特点是峡谷深邃，河流陡峭，流速快，携带大量沉积物，可能会冲落巨大的巨石。” 这条路线仍然是尼泊尔和中国之间的重要门户。在这里，前往冈仁波齐峰的朝圣者与往返于尼泊尔和中国之间的商人、卡车司机、海关官员、游客和边境居民相遇。 洪水发生当天早上，过境点内或周围可能有 100 多名印第安人。据印度外交部称，至少有 275 名印度人在尼泊尔失踪。 尼泊尔移民局一直在努力重建灾难发生前最后几个小时内经过拉苏瓦加迪的人员情况。 电子记录显示，89名尼泊尔人和外国人已办理离开尼泊尔前往西藏的出入境手续，另有4人已登记进入尼泊尔。 出入境系统在当地时间上午 8:35:03（西藏时间上午 10:52）记录了最终交易，距离吉隆闭路电视录像中出现洪流不到 10 分钟。 包括拉苏瓦加迪办公室负责人在内的四名移民雇员在洪水中失踪。他的尸体后来在下游很远的地方被发现。记录最终交易的女官员仍然下落不明。 当天早上离开尼泊尔的外国人中有 32 名印度人、12 名中国人和 9 名美国人，以及英国、加拿大、澳大利亚和意大利公民。 拉苏瓦加迪 (Rasuwagadhi) 的高级移民助理蒂卡·拉姆·波卡雷尔 (Tika Ram Pokharel) 是其办公室中唯一已知幸存的成员。他有...

The devastation at this remote border crossing, where over 100 Indians are missing, speaks to the vulnerability of human endeavors in the face of overwhelming natural forces. reflection.zh: 吉隆镇的闭路电视录像显示，一股由水、泥土和瓦砾组成的恐怖洪流席卷了整个山谷，这 stark地提醒着我们大自然不可思议的力量。在这个偏远的边境口岸，有超过100名印度人失踪，这场灾难凸显了人类在压倒性自然力量面前的脆弱性。大地本身似乎也在这样的事件中呻吟，这与罗马书8:22中的感受不谋而合。

title.en: South Korean police officer admits to closing missing person cases to avoid work
title.zh: 韩国一名警官承认关闭失踪人口案件以逃避工作

summary.en: A South Korean police officer has admitted to falsely claiming he contacted missing persons and prematurely closing their cases on the holiday island of Jeju, in order to avoid additional work. The scandal has led to belated searches and the discovery of four bodies, prompting calls for police reform.
summary.zh: 一名韩国警官承认为了逃避额外工作，在济州岛捏造已联系失踪人口并过早结案的报告。这一丑闻导致了迟来的搜寻，并发现了四具尸体，引发了对警察改革的呼吁。

body.en:
A South Korean police officer has admitted to closing missing persons cases without investigating them in order to avoid additional work, according to authorities.

The officer, surnamed Bu, was arrested earlier this month after he was accused of prematurely closing cases on the popular holiday island Jeju and lying to missing persons' families.

Amid mounting public criticism, police embarked on belated searches for several missing persons on the island, and have since discovered four bodies in recent weeks.

The scandal has prompted President Lee Jae Myung to vow to reform the police, as the government prepares to give the police more powers.

On Tuesday, the Jeju Provincial Police said Bu had falsely closed at least two high-profile cases and had been charged with forgery of public electronic records, obstruction of official duties and dereliction of duty.

In both cases, Bu had falsely claimed he had contacted the missing persons and then prematurely closed their cases without confirming their whereabouts and safety.

A police statement said that during their investigations into Bu, he had "stated to the effect that 'the missing person was a typical adult so I thought about it carelessly. If the case was not closed, there would have been a lot to take care of, and out of a sense of pressure over the case handover, I falsely closed it'."

One of the cases involved a 37-year-old woman named Jang Mi-ran who went missing in May and was reported missing by her boyfriend.

At the time, Bu had told Jang's boyfriend that he had spoken to her and she did not want to meet the police nor be contacted by her boyfriend. Authorities later said that this was a complete fabrication by Bu.

Bu had entered this false information into the system, and also logged that Jang had died in a traffic accident, before closing the case, according to authorities.

In another case where a man in his 60s was reported missing in July, Bu similarly falsely claimed that he had spoken to the man and that the man did not want to be contacted.

Police also said that they believe Bu could have prematurely closed another 25 missing persons cases, though in some of those cases the people were eventually confirmed to be alive and safe.

Violent crime is rare in South Korea, where suicide rates are among the highest in the world.

While more than 70,000 adults are reported missing in South Korea each year, 99% of them are marked as resolved within a month.

The government had recently passed laws to transfer full investigative power from the prosecutors to the police, a move they said was intended to curtail the prosecutors' influence in politics.

However, this move has been unpopular among the public, who have for many years accused the police of corruption and incompetence.

body.zh: 据当局称，一名韩国警察承认，为了避免额外的工作，在没有进行调查的情况下就结案了失踪人员案件。 这名姓卜的警官于本月早些时候被捕，他被指控在热门度假岛济州岛过早结案并向失踪人员家属撒谎。 在公众批评不断增加的情况下，警方开始对岛上几名失踪人员进行迟来的搜寻，并在最近几周发现了四具尸体。 这一丑闻促使总统李在明发誓要改革警察，政府准备赋予警察更多权力。 周二，济州道警方表示，卜已错误地结案了至少两起备受瞩目的案件，并被指控伪造公共电子记录、妨碍公务和玩忽职守。 在这两起案件中，布均谎称自己已联系过失踪人员，然后在未确认失踪人员下落和安全的情况下过早结案。 警方的一份声明称，在对卜进行调查时，他“大意是‘失踪者是一个典型的成年人，所以我考虑不周。如果案件不结案，就会有很多事情需要处理，出于案件移交的压力感，我错误地结案了’。” 其中一起案件涉及一名名叫张美兰（Jang Mi-ran）的 37 岁女性，她于 5 月失踪，后来被男友报告失踪。 当时，布告诉张的男友，他已经和她谈过话，她不想见警察，也不想被男友联系。当局后来表示，这完全是卜的捏造。 据当局称，在结案之前，布将这些虚假信息输入了系统，并记录了张成泽死于交通事故。 7月份，另一起案件中，一名60多岁的男子被报告失踪，布同样错误地声称他曾与该男子交谈过，并且该男子不想被联系。 警方还表示，他们认为 Bu 可能会提前结案另外 25 起失踪人员案件，尽管其中一些案件最终被确认为活着且安全。 韩国的暴力犯罪很少见，自杀率是世界上最高的国家之一。 据报道，韩国每年有超过 70,000 名成年人失踪，但其中 99% 在一个月内得到解决。 政府最近通过了法律，将检察官的全部调查权移交给警方，他们表示此举旨在削弱检察官在政治中的影响力。 然而此举并不受民众欢迎，民众多年来一直指责警方腐败无能。 在...

reflection.en: The news from Jeju reveals a profound failure of duty, where a police officer prioritized personal convenience over the urgent needs of families searching for loved ones. This disregard for justice and compassion stands in stark contrast to the prophetic call to 'act justly and to love mercy.' May this scandal prompt a renewed commitment to diligent service...
reflection.zh: 济州岛的这则新闻揭示了一种严重的失职行为，一名警官将个人便利置于寻找亲人的家庭的迫切需求之上。这种对公正和怜悯的漠视，与先知呼吁的‘秉公行义，喜爱怜悯’形成了鲜明对比。愿这一丑闻能促使警队重新致力于勤勉服务和同情心。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Three decades after Tupac's death, a jury has reached a verdict
title.zh: 图帕克去世三十年后，陪审团做出裁决

summary.en: A Las Vegas jury found an ex-gang leader guilty of murder on Tuesday in a case accusing him of plotting the drive-by killing of legendary hip-hop artist Tupac Shakur, bringing a decades-old cold case to a close. Duane "Keffe D" Davis, 63, was charged with murder using a deadly weapon and accused of leading a group to...
summary.zh: 周二，拉斯维加斯一个陪审团裁定一名退休帮派头目谋杀罪名成立，该案指控他策划了传奇嘻哈艺术家图帕克·夏库尔（Tupac Shakur）的驾车枪杀案，从而了结了一桩尘封数十年的悬案。63岁的杜安（Duane "Keffe D" Davis）被控一项使用致命武器谋杀罪，并被指控策划了一群人杀害了图帕克，以报复其侄子被打一事。

body.en:
A Las Vegas jury found an ex-gang leader guilty of murder on Tuesday in a case accusing him of plotting the drive-by killing of legendary hip-hop artist Tupac Shakur, bringing a decades-old cold case to a close.

Duane "Keffe D" Davis, 63, was charged in Nevada's Clark County with a single count of murder using a deadly weapon. He had pleaded not guilty.

Davis was accused of leading a group of men to kill Shakur, who was one of rap's most commercially successful and influential artists, in retaliation for the beating of Davis' nephew.

Police had said they long suspected Davis but did not have enough evidence to charge him until he went public with his story in media appearances and a memoir, which, along with tapes of his secret meetings with investigators, made up the bulk of the prosecution’s case.

Davis' lawyer said his client's words were mere bravado and could not be corroborated by other evidence.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The trial began on 17 August. Prosecutors played hours of recorded conversations in which Davis said he was enraged after Shakur and his entourage beat up Davis’ nephew at a Las Vegas casino on 7 September 1996.

Davis and three other men, including his nephew, went looking for Shakur and record label executive Marion "Suge" Knight in a white Cadillac on the night of the beating, he said. Davis said he passed a gun to the backseat, and when they found Knight and Shakur’s car, one of the two men in the back opened fire.

Prosecutors have not named the shooter, and the three other men who were in the car have since died. Under Nevada law, Davis can be charged with murder even though he did not pull the trigger.

Davis was a leader of the Southside Compton Crips, a Los Angeles-area street gang that feuded with rival gang Mob Piru, which was associated with Shakur and his record label Death Row Records.

Shakur's killing in 1996 became a seminal moment in rap history and heightened hip-hop culture's violent image during 'gangsta' rap's heyday, an era defined by feuding between East and West Coast artists.

body.zh: 周二，拉斯维加斯陪审团裁定一名前帮派头目犯有谋杀罪，指控他密谋驾车杀害传奇嘻哈艺术家图帕克·沙库尔 (Tupac Shakur)，从而结束了这起长达数十年的悬案。 63 岁的杜安·“凯夫·D”·戴维斯 (Duane "Keffe D" Davis) 在内华达州克拉克县被指控犯有一项使用致命武器谋杀罪。他不认罪。 戴维斯被指控带领一群人杀害沙库尔，沙库尔是说唱界在商业上最成功和最有影响力的艺术家之一，以报复殴打戴维斯的侄子。 警方表示，他们长期以来一直怀疑戴维斯，但没有足够的证据来指控他，直到他在媒体上公开自己的故事和一本回忆录，其中加上他与调查人员秘密会面的录音，构成了检方案件的大部分。 戴维斯的律师表示，他当事人的言论只是虚张声势，无法得到其他证据的证实。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 审判于8月17日开始。检察官播放了数小时的对话录音，戴维斯表示，1996 年 9 月 7 日，沙库尔及其随行人员在拉斯维加斯赌场殴打戴维斯的侄子后，他感到非常愤怒。 戴维斯说，在遭到殴打的当晚，戴维斯和包括他侄子在内的另外三名男子开着一辆白色凯迪拉克去寻找沙库尔和唱片公司高管马里昂·“苏格”·奈特。戴维斯说，他把枪递到后座，当他们发现奈特和沙库尔的车时，后座的两名男子中的一个开枪了。 检察官尚未透露枪手的姓名，车内的其他三名男子现已死亡。根据内华达州法律，即使戴维斯没有扣动扳机，也可以被指控谋杀。 戴维斯是洛杉矶地区街头帮派南区康普顿克里普斯 (Southside Compton Crips) 的头目，该帮派与竞争对手帮派 Mob Piru 不和，后者与沙库尔及其唱片公司 Death Row Records 有联系。 1996 年 Shakur 被杀成为说唱史上的一个重要时刻，并提升了嘻哈文化在“黑帮”说唱全盛时期的暴力形象，这个时代的特点是东海岸和西海岸艺术家之间的不和。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

This case highlights how cycles of violence, born from a desire for revenge, can ensnare individuals and communities for generations. May we seek to overcome evil with good, breaking these...
reflection.zh: 三十年后，图帕克·夏库尔（Tupac Shakur）的谋杀案终于得到了审判。杜安（Duane "Keffe D" Davis）的定罪源于一次报复性的杀人计划。此案凸显了复仇心驱使下的暴力循环如何能世世代代地困住个人和社群。愿我们寻求以善胜恶，打破这些毁灭性的模式。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Albanese responds after China warns of 'consequences' over Taiwan at Pacific summit
title.zh: 中国警告台湾出席太平洋岛国论坛将带来“后果”

summary.en: China's top diplomat for Pacific Island Countries, Qian Bo, has warned of 'consequences' regarding Taiwan's presence as a development partner at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau. He expressed China's 'serious concerns' and called Taiwan's participation 'inappropriate,' though he denied...
summary.zh: 中国太平洋岛国事务特使钱波警告，台湾作为太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议的发展伙伴出席将带来“后果”。他表达了中国“严重关切”，并称台湾的参与“不恰当”，但他否认其言论是威胁。

body.en:
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has stopped short of criticising China over threats of "consequences" for Taiwan's attendance at an annual Pacific summit, saying the forum decides who takes part.

Albanese's comments follow a warning from China's top Pacific Islands diplomat, who said "there will always be consequences" for Taiwan's strong presence at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau, with the highly charged three-day talks officially starting on Tuesday.

Albanese said he was "not distracted" when asked if Taiwan's presence was a distraction. Asked if he thought it was appropriate for China to make threats, the prime minister said: "The Pacific Islands Forum determines what happens here, not any other country."

Earlier, China's special envoy for Pacific Island affairs, Qian Bo, denied his comments were a threat, but said China has "serious concerns" about Taiwan's status as a development partner at the forum.

"There will always be consequences. You know, this is objected to by all, so this should not have happened. We think it's very inappropriate to do so," he told Australian reporters while leaving the forum's opening ceremony on Monday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. Beijing views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary .

Like the United States, Australia recognises and has formal ties with China, but maintains unofficial ties with Taiwan.

Neither China nor Taiwan are part of the 18-member group at the forum, but countries including the United States and China have traditionally been invited as dialogue partners. Taiwan has been categorised as a development partner since 1993 and is being represented this year by foreign minister Lin Chia-lung, along with a sizeable delegation.

Palau is one of only three Pacific nations to have diplomatic relations with Taiwan, which has created great friction between the hosts and China over the past decade. In 2017, China placed de facto "tourist bans" on the tiny Micronesian country, which received 40 per cent of its GDP from the tourism industry, in an apparent attempt to sway Palau's diplomatic position away from Taiwan.

Palau's president Surangel Whipps Jr said on Sunday he was aware there would be "threats" of retaliation if Taiwan attended this year's talks.

"Let's not use this as a place that we should be threatening or making people feel uncomfortable," he told reporters.

"China doesn't tell us that we cannot be a partner to Taiwan. That is our sovereign decision, not their decision."

body.zh: 中国太平洋岛国最高外交官警告说，台湾在帕劳举行的太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议上的强势参与“总会产生后果”，拉开了周二正式开始的为期三天的高度紧张的会谈。 北京太平洋岛国事务特使钱波否认他的言论构成威胁，但表示中国对台湾在论坛上作为发展伙伴的地位“严重关切”。 “总会有后果的。你知道，这是所有人都反对的，所以这不应该发生。我们认为这样做是非常不合适的，”他在周一离开开幕式时告诉澳大利亚记者。 中国和台湾都不属于该论坛的 18 个成员国，但美国和中国等国家历来被邀请作为对话伙伴。台湾自1993年起就被列为发展伙伴，今年由外交部长林家龙率领一个规模庞大的代表团出席。 帕劳是仅有的三个与台湾建交的太平洋国家之一，过去十年来，东道主与中国之间产生了巨大摩擦。 2017年，北京对这个密克罗尼西亚小国实施了事实上的“旅游禁令”，该国GDP的40%来自旅游业，显然是试图动摇帕劳的外交立场，使其远离台北。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯周日表示，他知道如果台湾参加今年的会谈，将会有“报复威胁”。 他对记者说：“我们不要把这里当作我们应该威胁或让人们感到不舒服的地方。” “中国没有告诉我们，我们不能成为台湾的合作伙伴。这是我们的主权决定，而不是他们的决定。” 钱其琛还声称，中国得到了PIF“大多数”成员国的“理解和支持”，并向帕劳“非常明确”地表明了自己的立场。 今年的PIF在正式开始前就陷入了争议，六位领导人被确认缺席，其中包括即将离任的论坛主席、所罗门群岛总理马修·韦尔，以及基里巴斯亲北京总统塔内蒂·马毛，后者特意派了前驻华大使大卫·蒂博代替。 他们缺席的原因包括国家议会职责和健康问题，威尔士已抵达科罗尔，并被迫在周末返回家乡，以应对可能的领导挑战。但缺席的关键领导人让人怀疑，在为期三天的活动中，是否可以就关键议程项目（包括气候行动）采取有意义的集体行动……

reflection.en: As leaders gather in Palau for the Pacific Islands Forum, diplomatic tensions simmer. China's envoy has voiced strong objections to Taiwan's participation, warning of 'consequences.' In such moments of heightened political friction, the call to pursue peace and seek diplomatic solutions, even amidst disagreement, remains paramount.
reflection.zh: 在太平洋岛国论坛领导人在帕劳举行会议之际，外交紧张局势悄然升温。中国特使对台湾的参与表达了强烈反对，并警告将有“后果”。在政治摩擦加剧的时刻，即使存在分歧，寻求和平与外交解决方案的呼吁仍然至关重要。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Second Australian found after Nepal-Tibet flood as authorities report more than 1,000 dead
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪灾死亡人数超950人，救援人员争分夺秒营救被困隧道工人

summary.en: Rescuers are urgently working to free hundreds of workers trapped in tunnels at hydropower sites that were inundated by mud from catastrophic flooding along the Nepal-China border. The combined death toll in Nepal and China has surpassed 950, with over 4400 people missing. At least 900 workers are unaccounted for at...
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔-中国边境发生灾难性洪水后，救援人员正争分夺秒地营救被埋在水电站隧道中的数百名工人。尼泊尔和中国的合计死亡人数已超过950人，另有超过4400人失踪。受洪水影响的12个水电项目至少有900名工人下落不明。

body.en:
The Australian government has confirmed two Australians have been safely located amid catastrophic flooding on the Nepal-China border as the number of people killed climbs and increasingly desperate families search for missing loved ones.

The combined deaths in Nepal and China surpassed 1,000, with more than 4,400 people — including 42 Australians — missing.

Officials were in contact on Tuesday with an Australian in Tibet, after another Australian, Cara Severino, was located safely on the weekend.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong said she was "incredibly thankful" a second Australian has been found, whose identity the government did not confirm.

"It’s hard to imagine the sense of relief their loved ones must be feeling after what will have been an incredibly harrowing few days," Wong said in a statement.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Despite this second piece of welcome news in recent days, we must remain realistic about the days ahead .... the conditions facing search and recovery teams are extremely challenging."

Nepal's disaster agency said 987 deaths had been counted there, while Chinese authorities reported 16 deaths in their most recent update on Sunday.

Rescuers are racing to free hundreds of workers believed to be trapped in tunnels at hydropower sites that were buried in mud by the flooding.

A private-sector association representing power companies said at least 900 workers were unaccounted for at 12 hydropower projects damaged by the flash floods in Nepal's Rasuwa and Nuwakot districts.

At least one expert said that some workers could have access to oxygen, but others warned that the chances of finding survivors were diminishing.

As the rescue efforts intensified, four bodies were recovered from three mud-filled tunnels, Nepal's army said.

Some workers managed to call for help when the disaster struck last Wednesday, and others who managed to flee reported to authorities and relatives that many of their colleagues were still in the tunnels, said Mohan Kumar Dangi, president of the Independent Power Producers' Association.

It was unclear whether rescuers have had any contact with the trapped workers since the initial calls for help.

Six days after the disaster, fears were growing that some might have suffocated, Dangi said.

Rescue efforts were focused on people trapped in the gigantic tunnels built for controlling the flow of water.

"These tunnels are big enough to drive trucks through," said Jakob Steiner, a geoscientist at the University of Graz in Austria based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

"And from what we understand, they have managed to get oxygen to some of those stuck inside and are trying to rescue...
body.zh: 随着死亡人数不断攀升，以及越来越绝望的家庭寻找失踪亲人，救援人员正在竞相营救数百名据信被困在水电站隧道中的工人，这些工人因尼泊尔和中国边境的灾难性洪水而被埋在泥土中。 尼泊尔和中国的死亡人数合计超过 950 人，超过 4400 人失踪，其中包括 43 名澳大利亚人。 代表电力公司的私营部门协会表示，尼泊尔拉苏瓦和努瓦科特地区因山洪爆发而受损的 12 个水电项目中，至少有 900 名工人下落不明。 至少一位专家表示，一些工人可以获得氧气，但其他专家警告说，找到幸存者的机会正在减少。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 尼泊尔军方表示，随着救援工作的加强，从三个充满泥浆的隧道中找到了四具尸体。 独立电力生产商协会主席莫汉·库马尔·丹吉(Mohan Kumar Dangi)表示，上周三灾难发生时，一些工人设法寻求帮助，其他设法逃离的工人向当局和亲属报告，他们的许多同事仍在隧道里。 目前还不清楚自最初发出求救信号以来，救援人员是否与被困工人有过任何接触。 丹吉说，灾难发生六天后，人们越来越担心有些人可能会窒息而死。 救援工作的重点是被困在为控制水流而建造的巨大隧道中的人们。 “这些隧道足够大，可以让卡车通过，”位于孟加拉国达卡的奥地利格拉茨大学的地球科学家雅各布·施泰纳说。 “据我们了解，他们已经设法为一些被困在里面的人提供氧气，并正在努力营救他们。不过，这是一场时间竞赛，因为人们需要食物和水。” Dangi 说，在受灾最严重的 Rasuwa 地区的 Upper Trishuli-1 水电站项目中，至少有 576 人失踪，并补充说，其中约 300 人据信被困在该项目的隧道内。 尼泊尔陆军发言人 Raja Ram Basnet 准将表示，在 Trishuli-3 水电项目中，工作人员正在努力下潜到隧道内约 15 米处，以营救被困在隧道内的人员。 尼泊尔达丁一座遭受洪水破坏的发电站的工人们正在铲泥，他们表示，该发电站是为该地区 2 万多人提供电力的关键线路。 中方的救援和恢复工作包括重建通往吉隆口岸的道路，该口岸负责控制中尼之间的交通。 当工人们试图重新铺设道路时，卡车运载着巨大的岩石。

reflection.en: The news from the Nepal-China border is grim, with hundreds of workers trapped in tunnels following catastrophic floods. In such moments, the cry of the vulnerable echoes, reminding us of the biblical call to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves. May we be moved to advocate for the safety and rescue of these individuals, reflecting the compassion...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔-中国边境传来的消息令人心痛，数百名工人在灾难性的洪水后被困于隧道之中。在这样的时刻，弱者的呼喊回响，提醒我们圣经呼召我们要为那些无法为自己发声的人说话。愿我们被触动，为这些人的安全和救援而倡导，体现《箴言》31:8-9所敦促我们的怜悯之心。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: How China buried Tibet flood images after Nepal disaster
title.zh: 中国如何掩埋了尼泊尔灾难后的西藏洪水画面

summary.en: In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed a deadly flood that devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.
summary.zh: 在西藏，一场致命的洪水摧毁了中尼边境的社区，随后发生了数字镇压。审查人员删除了病毒式传播的画面，而中国官方媒体则向各大平台推送官方内容。

body.en:
In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.

When a catastrophic flash flood swept through the rugged China-Nepal border on August 26, the physical devastation was immediate.

In Nepal , a black torrent of mud and rock tore through communities, leaving hundreds dead and thousands more missing along the borderlands.

But across the frontier in Tibet, an autonomous region of China , the physical disaster was almost instantly followed by a digital one: the rapid, high-tech erasure of the catastrophe's visual evidence.

As survivors tried to upload raw footage of the deluge, China's state-backed information control apparatus swung into action, executing a sophisticated, precision operation to shape the public narrative and bury inconvenient truths.

The contrasting realities — a tragic humanitarian crisis in Nepal and a tightly sanitized, triumphant rescue narrative in China — reveal the evolving mechanics of Beijing's modern censorship machine.

Rather than imposing a blunt, blanket blackout, authorities deployed advanced image-recognition technology and "saturated information" tactics to drown out domestic scrutiny while deflecting diplomatic friction abroad.

In the immediate aftermath of the flood-triggered mudslide, local residents captured dramatic footage of the torrent engulfing Gyirong Port, a critical overland trade hub between China and Nepal.

The most striking video showed a black wall of water and debris crashing into and destroying the "national" border gate.

In an article titled "An Unrecorded Mudslide Rushes into Gyirong Port" on China's WeChat, a universal app that combines messaging with payment options and social media functions, local blogger "Matou Qingnian" described the chaotic scene.

"The most terrifying moment happened at the Gyirong Port," the author wrote, describing video footage of crowds, including children, fleeing in panic before a pitch-black torrent swallowed the camera's view.

Within hours, both the article and the raw video footage had vanished from Chinese social media .

According to  China Digital Times (CDT) , an independent watchdog that tracks Chinese internet censorship , the video of the collapsing border gate was systematically blocked from being shared on WeChat, even in private messages.

"The footage itself contained no graphic violence, no protests, and no political slogans," explained Mira, a CDT editor who specializes in tracking sensitive keywords and media. "The target of the censorship was the symbol itself: the National Gate."

Digital analysts note that this censorship highlights a significant upgrade...
body.zh: 在西藏，致命的洪水摧毁了中尼边境沿线的社区，随后进行了数字镇压。审查机构删除了病毒式传播的视频，而中国官方媒体则在平台上充斥着官方内容。 8 月 26 日，一场灾难性的山洪席卷崎岖的中尼边境，造成了立即的破坏。 在尼泊尔，一股黑色泥浆和岩石洪流席卷了边境地区的社区，造成数百人死亡、数千人失踪。 但在中国西藏自治区的边境地区，这场物理灾难几乎立刻就发生了一场数字灾难：灾难的视觉证据被迅速、高科技删除。 当幸存者试图上传洪水的原始镜头时，中国国家支持的信息控制机构立即采取行动，执行复杂而精确的操作，以塑造公众叙事并掩盖难以忽视的真相。 对比鲜明的现实——尼泊尔悲惨的人道主义危机和中国严密消毒、胜利的救援故事——揭示了北京现代审查机制不断演变的机制。 当局没有实施生硬、全面的封锁，而是采用了先进的图像识别技术和“饱和信息”策略来淹没国内审查，同时转移国外的外交摩擦。 洪水引发的泥石流发生后，当地居民拍下了洪流吞没吉隆港的戏剧性镜头，吉隆港是中国和尼泊尔之间重要的陆路贸易枢纽。 最引人注目的视频显示，黑色的水墙和碎片冲撞并摧毁了“国家”边境大门。 当地博主“马头青年”在中国微信（一款将消息传递、支付选项和社交媒体功能结合在一起的通用应用程序）上发表了一篇题为“一场未记录的泥石流冲进吉隆口岸”的文章，描述了当时的混乱场面。 “最可怕的时刻发生在吉隆口岸，”作者写道，并描述了包括儿童在内的人群在漆黑的洪流吞没摄像机视野之前惊慌失措的画面。 几个小时内，这篇文章和原始视频片段就从中国社交媒体上消失了。 据追踪中国互联网审查制度的独立监管机构中国数字时代（CDT）称，倒塌边境大门的视频被系统性地禁止在微信上分享，甚至在私人信息中也是如此。 专门跟踪敏感关键词和媒体的 CDT 编辑米拉解释说：“视频本身不包含暴力画面、抗议活动和政治口号。” “审查的目标是标志本身：国门。” 数字分析师指出，这次审查凸显了重大升级......

reflection.en: The story describes how images of a devastating flood in Tibet were systematically erased, silencing the suffering of those affected. This act of censorship obscures the reality of the disaster, leaving the victims' experiences unheard. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute"...
reflection.zh: 这个故事描述了西藏一场毁灭性洪水的画面是如何被系统性地抹去的，这使得受灾者的痛苦经历被噤声。这种审查行为掩盖了灾难的真实情况，使得受害者的经历无人倾听。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能说话的开口，为所有孤苦者辨明是非”和“为穷乏人和贫穷人伸冤”。在这种情况下，数字抹杀是一种深刻的噤声，而呼召则是要铭记并放大那些被刻意压制的声音。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Deceived and deployed: How young Cameroonians end up fighting in Russia's war in Ukraine
title.zh: 被欺骗和部署：喀麦隆青年如何卷入俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争

summary.en: Economic hardship and deceptive recruitment practices are drawing young Cameroonians into the Russian military, leading to severe consequences. The article questions the Cameroonian government's response to this crisis.
summary.zh: 经济困境和欺骗性的征兵行为正将喀麦隆青年卷入俄罗斯军队，并导致严重后果。文章质疑喀麦隆政府对此危机的应对。

body.en:
Analysts say economic desperation and fraudulent recruitment schemes are funneling Cameroonian youth into the Russian military — with deadly consequences.

Cameroon has emerged as one of the  leading sources of African recruits for the Russian military , with young men lured to Europe by false promises of jobs and fast-tracked Russian citizenship, only to find themselves on the front lines of the war in Ukraine.

As of May this year, Ukrainian officials say that nearly 3,000 citizens from various African countries were known to have fought — or to still be fighting — for Russia  : Cameroon, Ghana, Egypt, Kenya and Uganda were identified as significant.

In April, the Cameroonian government confirmed that Russia had reported the deaths of 16 Cameroonian nationals, seven of whom had died in military action in Ukraine.

The actual death toll is likely higher according to DW correspondent Dorcas Ekupe, reporting from Bamenda in northwestern Cameroon.

"When you look at other publications and see what is happening — even seeing families who are grieving their loved ones — the number is really much higher than what the government had earlier said," Ekupe told DW's AfricaLink program.

She described two forces causing this worrying phenomenon: economic desperation and deliberate deception.

Many recruits, she said, travelled to Russia believing they had secured jobs in construction or as security guards, or that they were participating in study programs.

Russia's perceived appeal meanwhile is also being amplified by well-organized campaigns.

Bamnjo Herman Yenika, a lecturer and political analyst at the University of Bamenda, pointed to the key role of the the Russian paramilitary Wagner Group as well as its successor, the Africa Corps, as Moscow's primary instrument for expanding its presence and reputation across Africa.

Yenika also cited Russian government programs such as the African Initiative and Alabuga, which present themselves as cultural or educational exchange schemes but have been linked to military recruitment.

"On the surface, sometimes it looks like cultural outreach," he said. "Sometimes Cameroonians are lured, thinking it is for work, not necessarily knowing what is beneath the surfac.," He added that offers of Russian nationality within six months were a particularly powerful draw.

France has previously described the African Initiative as a front administered by Russian intelligence services, designed to spread propaganda.

Yenika stressed, however, that the  economic situation of the men was typically the main motivator .

"Imagine that you are a carpenter in Cameroon who cannot even earn 100,000 CFA  francs (€150; $175) a month, but somebody is...
body.zh: 分析人士表示，经济绝望和欺诈性招募计划正在将喀麦隆年轻人输送到俄罗斯军队，并带来致命的后果。喀麦隆政府是否需要采取更加果断的行动？ 喀麦隆已成为俄罗斯军队非洲新兵的主要来源之一，年轻人被虚假的就业承诺和快速获得俄罗斯公民身份的诱惑所吸引，却发现自己身处乌克兰战争的前线。 乌克兰官员表示，截至今年 5 月，已知有近 3,000 名来自非洲各国的公民曾经或仍在为俄罗斯而战；喀麦隆、加纳、埃及、肯尼亚和乌干达被确定为主要来源国。 4月，喀麦隆政府证实俄罗斯已报告16名喀麦隆国民死亡，其中7人在乌克兰的军事行动中丧生。 德国之声通讯员多卡斯·埃库佩 (Dorcas Ekupe) 在喀麦隆西北部巴门达报道称，实际死亡人数可能更高。 埃库佩告诉德国之声非洲联播节目：“当你看其他出版物，看看正在发生的事情，甚至看到那些正在哀悼亲人的家庭时，这个数字确实比政府早些时候所说的要高得多。” 她描述了造成这种令人担忧的现象的两种力量：经济绝望和故意欺骗。 她说，许多新兵前往俄罗斯时相信自己已经找到了建筑业或保安的工作，或者正在参加学习项目。 巴门达大学讲师兼政治分析家班乔·赫尔曼指出，俄罗斯准军事瓦格纳集团及其继任者非洲军团发挥着关键作用，是莫斯科在非洲扩大其影响力和声誉的主要工具。 他还引用了俄罗斯政府的“非洲倡议”和“阿拉布加”等计划，这些计划自称是文化或教育交流计划，但与征兵有关。 “从表面上看，有时这看起来像是文化外展，”班卓说。 “有时喀麦隆人会被吸引，认为这是为了工作，不一定知道表面之下是什么，”他补充说，六个月内获得俄罗斯国籍也是一个特别强大的吸引力。 法国此前曾将非洲倡议描述为俄罗斯情报部门管理的一个阵线，旨在传播宣传。 然而，班卓强调，新兵的经济状况通常是主要动机。 “想象一下，您是喀麦隆的一名木匠，每月甚至无法赚取 10 万非洲法郎（150 欧元；175 美元），但有人承诺给您 300 万非洲法郎来工作，”他解释道。 “这是...

reflection.en: Young Cameroonians, driven by economic desperation, are being ensnared by fraudulent recruitment schemes, leading them to the front lines of a brutal war. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to speak up for those who cannot defend themselves and to ensure justice for the poor and the vulnerable, a principle desperately needed in this situation.
reflection.zh: 出于经济绝望的喀麦隆青年，正落入欺诈性征兵计划的陷阱，将他们带到残酷战争的前线。箴言31:8-9呼吁我们为那些无法自卫的人发声，并为穷人和弱势群体伸张正义，这一原则在此情境下尤为迫切需要。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Tariffs spat: Carney bets Canada can defy Trump
title.zh: 关税之争：卡尼押注加拿大能抵制特朗普

summary.en: Canada faces new US import penalties after Prime Minister Mark Carney refused to match US tariffs on China. Other countries are watching as the Trump trade clash turns into a fight over economic sovereignty.
summary.zh: 在总理马克·卡尼拒绝匹配中国对美关税后，加拿大正面临新的美国进口处罚。其他国家正密切关注这场特朗普贸易冲突如何演变成一场争夺经济主权的斗争。

body.en:
Canada is facing new US import penalties after Prime Minister Mark Carney refused to match US tariffs on China. Other countries are watching as the Trump trade clash turns into a fight over economic sovereignty.

Canada has been quietly praised for refusing to fold under pressure from US President Donald Trump in the long-running fight over trade tariffs .

The latest talks between the North American neighbors collapsed on August 21. Until the 11th hour, both sides were talking as if a deal was within reach.

The United States then put 50% tariffs on about $20 billion (€17.2 billion) worth of Canadian goods, while Ottawa pledged to match those duties on US imports.

Until the talks folded, Canada's approach was to cut a deal that would reduce the tariffs and keep cross-border supply chains functioning, particularly in the automotive  and steel sectors.

US negotiators were, however, accused of changing the terms at the last minute, which the Canadian side said would have forced them to match US tariffs on China .

According to Ottawa, Washington wanted a say on future trade deals with other nations and to prevent Chinese goods being routed through Canada to evade US duties.

Dan Ciuriak, a senior fellow at the Waterloo, Canada-based Center for International Governance Innovation, described Trump's tariff-matching plan as "fortress North America," which he said was now a sovereignty issue for Ottawa.

"Canada is a trading nation," Ciuriak told DW. "If we align perfectly with the Americans — primarily about China — we then end up sacrificing our trade policy."

There is a recent precedent. When the US imposed 100% tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles last year, Canada followed suit. Beijing retaliated with 100% tariffs against one of Canada's biggest exports — canola.

Canada's $4.9 billion exports of canola oil, meal and seed to China were cut in half last year, according to data from the Canada China Business Council.

"The smaller country is the one that bears the brunt in this kind of game. So that's one very good reason for Canada to have an independent trade policy," said Ciuriak.

As the US-Canada talks collapsed, Ottawa also complained that Washington had sought relief from rules on French-language movies and shows. Canada said this amounted to interference in its language and culture.

Despite the uncertainty and higher cost to business from walking away, the Canadian prime minister's approach to negotiations with the US has broad public support.

A survey conducted by the Angus Reid Institute found that three-in-four Canadians backed the more hard-line move, despite concerns over the impact on the domestic...
body.zh: 在加拿大总理马克·卡尼拒绝追随美国对中国征收的关税后，加拿大面临美国新的进口处罚。其他国家正在关注特朗普的贸易冲突演变成一场经济主权之争。 加拿大因在长期的贸易关税斗争中拒绝在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的压力下屈服而受到悄悄赞扬。 这两个北美邻国之间的最新谈判于 8 月 21 日破裂。直到 11 小时，双方都在谈论仿佛达成协议已触手可及。 随后，美国对价值约 200 亿美元（172 亿欧元）的加拿大商品征收 50% 的关税，而渥太华则承诺对美国进口商品征收同样的关税。 在谈判破裂之前，加拿大的做法是达成一项降低关税并保持跨境供应链正常运转的协议，特别是在汽车和钢铁行业。 然而，美国谈判代表被指控在最后一刻改变条款，加拿大方面表示，这将迫使他们与美国对中国征收的关税相匹配。 据渥太华称，华盛顿希望对未来与其他国家的贸易协议拥有发言权，并防止中国商品通过加拿大转运以逃避美国关税。 加拿大滑铁卢国际治理创新中心高级研究员丹·丘里亚克 (Dan Ciuriak) 将特朗普的关税匹配计划描述为“北美堡垒”，他表示这现在是渥太华的主权问题。 “加拿大是一个贸易国家，”Ciuriak 告诉德国之声。 “如果我们与美国人完全一致——主要是在中国问题上——那么我们最终会牺牲我们的贸易政策。” 最近就有先例。去年，当美国对中国电动汽车征收 100% 关税时，加拿大也紧随其后。 北京方面对加拿大最大的出口产品之一——油菜籽征收 100% 的关税进行报复。 加中贸易理事会的数据显示，去年加拿大对中国的芥花籽油、菜粕和种子出口额减少了一半，价值 49 亿美元。 “在这种游戏中，较小的国家首当其冲。因此，这是加拿大实行独立贸易政策的一个很好的理由，”Ciuriak 说。 随着美加谈判破裂，渥太华还抱怨华盛顿寻求放松对法语电影和节目的规定。加拿大表示，这相当于对其语言和文化的干扰。 尽管存在不确定性并且退出会给企业带来更高的成本，但加拿大总理与美国谈判的方法得到了广泛的公众支持。 安格斯·里德研究所进行的一项调查发现，四分之三的加拿大人支持这一更为强硬的举措，尽管担心这对国内经济的影响......

reflection.en: In the face of escalating trade disputes, Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney has chosen not to mirror the US tariffs. This decision, while potentially costly, reflects a commitment to de-escalation rather than further retaliation. The situation highlights the delicate balance leaders must strike between national interest and the pursuit of peaceful...
reflection.zh: 面对不断升级的贸易争端，加拿大总理马克·卡尼选择不效仿美国的关税措施。这一决定虽然可能付出代价，但体现了致力于缓和局势而非进一步报复的承诺。这一局面凸显了领导人在国家利益与追求和平经济关系之间必须谨慎权衡的难题。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Putin-Modi meeting at SCO: Can Russia-India ties hold?
title.zh: 普京-莫迪在上海合作组织会晤：俄印关系能否维系？

summary.en: Indian Prime Minister Modi and Russian President Putin are attending the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Kyrgyzstan amidst growing tensions with Washington for both Moscow and New Delhi.
summary.zh: 印度总理莫迪和俄罗斯总统普京正在吉尔吉斯斯坦举行的上海合作组织（SCO）峰会上会晤，此时莫斯科和新德里都面临着与华盛顿日益紧张的关系。

body.en:
Indian Prime Minister Modi and Russian President Putin are at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Kyrgyzstan as Moscow and New Delhi face rising tensions with Washington.

Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi  and Russian President Vladimir Putin  are set to meet in Kyrgyzstan's capital, Bishkek, on Monday on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) summit — a bloc often seen as a counterweight to US influence.

The meeting comes against the backdrop of the fallout from the US-Israel war on Iran , which has disrupted global energy markets, and Russia's war in Ukraine , now in its fifth year.

India has remained engaged with the SCO while resisting efforts to turn it into an anti-Western bloc. Its position reflects a broader effort to maintain relationships with competing powers.

That approach is under greater pressure. Russia  remains under Western sanctions over the war in Ukraine. Meanwhile, India has faced US pressure over its purchases of Russian oil, alongside wider trade tensions.

A former Indian ambassador to the US, Meera Shankar, told DW that India's relationship with Russia should not be seen as directed against the US.

"India has a long-standing strategic relationship with Russia. This is not directed against any country but intended to help India meet its national goals," said Shankar. 

Energy has become the most visible change in the India-Russia relationship . 

Before 2022, when Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, it supplied only a small share of India's crude imports. Discounted Russian oil rapidly changed that, making Moscow one of India's biggest suppliers.

It has also become the most contentious part of India's relationship with the US, which has pressed New Delhi to reduce its purchases from Russia . India maintains that securing affordable and reliable energy is a national interest.

The disruption to traditional energy supplies has made that calculation more complicated. This year's US-Israel war on Iran and disruption of traffic through the Strait of Hormuz have affected India's purchases from the Gulf and pushed up prices.

Shankar said India is responding by diversifying its sources of supply, including both Russia and the US.

"In the long run, a transition to a non-fossil fuel economy would strengthen India's energy independence. But this will not happen overnight," she added.

Until then, Shankar said, India will take steps it considers necessary to stabilize supplies and protect its people. 

Defense remains the other major pillar, but here the direction of travel is clearer: India's dependence on Russian equipment has been declining.

The Ukraine war has raised questions over Russia's production capacity, delivery...
body.zh: 印度总理莫迪和俄罗斯总统普京出席在吉尔吉斯斯坦举行的上海合作组织（SCO）峰会，莫斯科和新德里与华盛顿的紧张关系日益加剧。 印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将于周一在上海合作组织 (SCO) 峰会期间在吉尔吉斯斯坦首都比什凯克会面，该组织通常被视为抗衡美国影响力的组织。 此次会议召开的背景是美以对伊朗的战争扰乱了全球能源市场，而俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争现已进入第五个年头。 印度一直与上合组织保持接触，同时抵制将其变成反西方集团的努力。它的立场反映了维持与竞争大国关系的更广泛努力。 这种做法面临着更大的压力。俄罗斯仍因乌克兰战争而受到西方制裁。与此同时，印度因购买俄罗斯石油而面临美国的压力，而且贸易紧张局势更广泛。 印度前驻美大使梅拉·香卡 (Meera Shankar) 向德国之声表示，印度与俄罗斯的关系不应被视为针对美国。 香卡表示：“印度与俄罗斯有着长期的战略关系。这不是针对任何国家，而是为了帮助印度实现其国家目标。” 能源成为印俄关系中最明显的变化。 在2022年俄罗斯对乌克兰发动全面入侵之前，它只供应了印度原油进口的一小部分。俄罗斯石油打折迅速改变了这一状况，使莫斯科成为印度最大的供应国之一。 这也成为印度与美国关系中最具争议的部分，迫使新德里减少从俄罗斯的采购。 印度认为，获得负担得起且可靠的能源符合国家利益。 传统能源供应的中断使计算变得更加复杂。今年的美以对伊朗的战争以及霍尔木兹海峡的交通中断影响了印度从海湾地区的采购并推高了价格。 尚卡表示，印度的应对措施是实现供应来源多元化，其中包括俄罗斯和美国。 “从长远来看，向非化石燃料经济转型将加强印度的能源独立性。但这不会在一夜之间发生，”她补充道。 尚卡表示，在此之前，印度将采取其认为必要的措施来稳定供应并保护其人民。 国防仍然是另一个主要支柱，但这里的发展方向更加明确：印度对俄罗斯装备的依赖一直在下降。 乌克兰战争引发了对俄罗斯生产能力、交付能力的质疑……

reflection.en: As leaders gather at the SCO summit, the complexities of international relations are on full display. The meeting between Prime Minister Modi and President Putin occurs against a backdrop of geopolitical shifts, where maintaining diplomatic ties requires careful navigation. The call to 'live peaceably with all' reminds us to seek understanding and...
reflection.zh: 随着各国领导人在上海合作组织峰会上齐聚一堂，国际关系的复杂性展露无遗。莫迪总理和普京总统的会晤发生在地缘政治变动的背景下，维持外交关系需要谨慎的导航。《罗马书》12章18节提醒我们，即使在全球紧张局势中，也要寻求理解与合作，‘务要随众和睦’。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.zh: 中国观察

title.en: Nepal-Tibet floods: death toll passes 1,000 as rescue efforts continue at hydropower tunnels – latest updates
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪水：死亡人数超过1000人，救援工作仍在水电站隧道进行——最新消息

summary.en: The death toll from catastrophic flooding in Nepal and Tibet has surpassed 1,000, with approximately 4,500 people missing. Hundreds of unidentified victims have reportedly been buried as morgues were overwhelmed. Rescue efforts continue, but hopes are fading for those trapped in mud-filled tunnels at hydropower sites.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏地区灾难性的洪水造成的死亡人数已超过1000人，约有4500人失踪。据报道，由于太平间不堪重负，数百名身份不明的遇难者已被埋葬。救援工作仍在继续，但被困在水电站泥泞隧道中的失踪人员获救的希望渺茫。

body.en:
The death toll from the catastrophic flooding in Nepal and China has passed 1,000 as of Tuesday morning, officials said, with authorities reportedly burying hundreds of unidentified victims after the flood disaster overwhelmed morgues.

Nepal’s disaster agency said in an update on Tuesday that 987 deaths had been counted there, with 3,916 people missing, including 583 foreigners .

Chinese authorities, in their latest update on Sunday, reported 16 deaths and 546 people still missing.

The initial 72 hours after a disaster are viewed as critical to a rescue operation and there are fading hopes that the missing will be found alive.

Rescue efforts nonetheless persist, but have been complicated by challenging terrain, persistently high flood waters and difficult weather.

The devastating floods occurred last Wednesday when a huge section of a glacier in the Himalayas came loose and crashed on to the valley floor in Nepal’s Langtang national park, unleashing a massive wall of water and mud that rushed down rivers and valleys.

The resulting floods obliterated villages and destroyed vital infrastructure such as power stations, roads and bridges.

Much of the rescue efforts are now focused on trying to reach the 900 or so missing hydropower workers, hundreds of whom are feared trapped in the tunnels and underground areas of 12 hydropower projects in Nepal.

“A large amount of debris has been deposited and that is posing us a big challenge to open the tunnels,” the Nepal army spokesperson Raja Ram Basnet told the Reuters news agency on Monday.

About 250 people were rescued from the Upper Trishuli hydroelectric project over the weekend, and army engineers began blasting operations at the site to rescue another 42 workers thought be missing, as my colleague notes in this story .

Many people are feared to still be trapped in the sprawling network of mud-filled tunnels at hydropower sites along the Trishuli River, which flows through central Nepal.
body.zh: 官员称，截至周二上午，尼泊尔和中国发生的特大洪水造成的死亡人数已超过 1,000 人，据报道，洪水淹没了太平间，当局正在埋葬数百名身份不明的遇难者。 尼泊尔救灾机构在周二发布的最新消息中称，该国已统计出 987 人死亡、3,916 人失踪，其中包括 583 名外国人。 中国当局在周日发布的最新消息中称，已有 16 人死亡、546 人失踪。 灾难发生后的最初 72 小时被视为对救援行动至关重要，而找到失踪人员生还的希望也越来越渺茫。 尽管如此，救援工作仍在继续，但由于地形复杂、洪水持续高涨和恶劣的天气而变得复杂。 上周三发生了毁灭性的洪水，当时喜马拉雅山的一大片冰川松动，坠落到尼泊尔朗唐国家公园的谷底，释放出一道巨大的水墙和泥浆，冲入河流和山谷。 由此引发的洪水摧毁了村庄并摧毁了发电站、道路和桥梁等重要基础设施。 目前，救援工作主要集中在寻找大约 900 名失踪的水电工人，其中数百人可能被困在尼泊尔 12 个水电项目的隧道和地下区域中。 尼泊尔陆军发言人拉贾·拉姆·巴斯内特周一对路透社表示：“大量碎片已经堆积起来，这给我们打开隧道带来了巨大挑战。” 正如我的同事在这篇报道中指出的那样，上特里苏里水电站项目周末约有 250 人获救，陆军工程师开始在现场进行爆破作业，营救另外 42 名被认为失踪的工人。 担心许多人仍然被困在流经尼泊尔中部的特里苏里河沿岸水电站的庞大泥浆隧道网络中。

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet have brought immense loss, with over a thousand lives tragically ended and thousands more missing. In the face of such profound grief and destruction, we look to the promise of a future where suffering and death will be no more. May Yahweh comfort those who mourn and grant them His peace.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏地区毁灭性的洪水带来了巨大的损失，超过一千条生命不幸终结，另有数千人失踪。面对如此深切的悲痛和毁灭，我们寄望于一个不再有痛苦和死亡的未来。愿雅伟安慰那些哀恸的人，并赐予他们平安。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Nepal death toll crosses 1,000 as rescuers race to find workers trapped in mud-filled tunnels
title.zh: 尼泊尔救援人员炸开山坡搜寻水电工人，家属焦急等待

summary.en: Rescuers are using explosives in a desperate attempt to reach workers trapped in tunnels following severe flooding in Nepal. The death toll from the disaster has risen to 939, with over 600 workers feared missing.
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔发生严重洪灾后，救援人员正使用炸药绝望地试图接触被困在隧道中的工人。此次灾难的死亡人数已升至939人，另有超过600名工人据信失踪。

body.en:
The death toll in Nepal from devastating floods on the border with Tibet has crossed 1,000, according to the country's disaster agency.

More than 3,900 people remain missing - of whom more than 600 are workers believed to be trapped in a vast network of mud-filled tunnels at hydropower sites along Trishuli River.

Engineers have been pumping air into the tunnels - and while a team did manage to gain entry to one of them, it withdrew after finding no-one there.

"I wish we could find him. I wish he would come home," Anushila Bhandari, wife of Aurus Bhandari, a 33-year-old engineer missing on a project site, told BBC Nepali.

Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah said on Monday that 279 people had been rescued from the sites.

The rescue operation is being spearheaded by an international team made up of Chinese and Nepalese military personnel, while experts from India, Korea and Australia are also involved.

"I still have a 50% hope that he is alive because there is an oxygen system inside," Sita Pandey, whose husband was working in the plant when the floods hit, told Nepalese daily Kantipur.

Nepal relies heavily on hydropower and has spent years developing the projects along its mountainous river systems. At least 11 projects either completed or under construction were damaged in the floods, authorities said.

Rescuers began pumping air into a tunnel over the weekend, but the families of those trapped say that should have been done earlier.

A team was able to get into a tunnel leading to one hydropower plant earlier on Monday, but retreated after no one was found there.

"The longer it takes, the more our hope dies. This operation must move much faster because every second is meaningful to us," Jiban Khadka, whose relative is also trapped inside the plant, told Kantipur.

Rescue operations had been "intensified", Nepalese leader Shah said, noting that the floods were "not an ordinary" event.

"This incident indicates that the risks we face in the Himalayan region are increasing alongside climate change.

"It is now time for us to strongly raise with the international community the issue of the disasters we are experiencing as a result of climate change," Shah wrote in a Facebook post late on Monday.

Another family member anxiously awaiting news is Priya Kharel, whose brother Milan was working as an engineer in the Upper Trishuli-1 plant when the floods hit.

"Those who returned from the hydropower site said there were people inside the tunnel," she told BBC News Nepali. "So there is hope that if the army reaches them quickly, they can be saved."

Australian engineer Arnold Dix, who has been helping Nepalese authorities with the underground search operations remotely, said rescuers had been struggling to find the tunnels.
