body.zh: 周二，毁灭性的喜马拉雅冰川洪水造成的死亡人数突破了 1000 人大关，中国和尼泊尔救援队正在搜寻幸存者，其中包括数十人，担心被困在水电隧道中。陆军人员在拉苏瓦拉苏瓦加迪水电站项目的隧道现场进行搜救行动。照片：尼泊尔陆军/法新社。周三，高海拔冰川崩塌产生的冰水、岩石和碎片的巨大浪潮席卷下游，摧毁了整个定居点，并在尼泊尔开辟了一条毁灭之路，造成近 4,500 人失踪。尼泊尔救援队在险恶的条件下与时间赛跑，对废墟进行挖掘、钻孔和爆破，以解救据信被困在多条隧道中的约 100 名水电工人。到目前为止，只有尸体被从被污泥堵塞的隧道中拉出。尼泊尔陆军发言人拉贾·拉姆·巴斯内特周二告诉法新社：“我们的重点是隧道的搜救工作，我们的工作仍在继续。” “我们的士兵还被部署来收集尸体并防止疾病传播。”由于尼泊尔太平间人满为患，当局在 DNA 采样后开始掩埋数百具身份不明的尸体。印度还从下游的河流中打捞出了至少 17 具尸体。嵌入来自 Getty Images window.gie=window.gie||function(c){(gie.q=gie.q||[]).push(c)};gie(function(){gie.widgets.load({id:'-GbRBUoiQ-d AKzIWoOOwYg'，sig：'QIgaxwrxvh_cpLJBzxmfPa4p8KQgME6i2IGZUc3WsA8 ='，w：'594px'，h：'396px'，项目：'2292351602'，标题： true ,tld:'com',is360: false })});尼泊尔总理巴伦德拉·沙阿称这场灾难“难以想象且令人心碎”。 “找到他们的尸体” 在首都加德满都，人们排队寻找失踪的亲人，将照片贴在医院外的长墙上，希望找到他们还活着的希望越来越渺茫。 58 岁的司机德布·萨普科塔 (Debu Sapkota) 来贴出他 83 岁的婆婆和孙女的照片，他们在上周的洪水涌入后在 Trishuli Bazaar 镇失踪。他回忆道，警报响起，但这位老妇人“太老了，跑不动了”。 “她的孙女正在帮助她逃跑，但两人都被冲走了。”萨普科塔说，在目击者看到他们被洪流冲走后，他不再“对他们生还抱有任何希望”。 “我来这里是希望找到她们的尸体，”他举着两名失踪妇女身着传统服装的照片说道。嵌入来自 Getty Images...

reflection.en: The news of over a thousand lives lost and thousands more missing in the Himalayan floods is a stark reminder of the fragility of life and the deep sorrow that such disasters bring. In moments of profound grief, we look to the ultimate promise of Revelation 21:4, where Yahweh Himself will wipe away every tear, and death shall be no more, nor shall there be...
reflection.zh: 喜马拉雅洪水造成一千多人丧生、数千人失踪的消息，令人痛心地提醒我们生命的脆弱以及此类灾难带来的深切悲伤。在极度悲痛的时刻，我们仰望启示录21:4的终极应许，在那里，雅伟祂自己将擦去一切眼泪，不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭泣或痛苦。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: TKO school soldiers on without P1 classes
title.zh: TKO小学在小学一年级停办的情况下继续办学

summary.en: The principal of a primary school in Tseung Kwan O stated on Tuesday that its merger with a sister school will not diminish its dedication to students. The school has allocated HK$1.8 million for the current academic year to subsidize extracurricular activities. SKH Tseung Kwan O Kei Tak Primary School is one of 15...
summary.zh: 将官塘小学一名小学负责人周二表示，该校与姊妹学校合并不会削弱其对学生的承诺。本学年学校已拨款180万港元资助课外活动。基督教圣公会调景岭基德小学是15所因入学人数不足16人而未能开设小一课程的学校之一。根据教育局批准的发展计划，该校将与黄大仙的基督教圣公会基德小学合并，并于2029/30学年永久关闭校舍。因此，目前的小...

body.en: The principal of a primary school in Tseung Kwan O said on Tuesday that its merger with a sister school will not weaken its commitment to students, with the school setting aside HK$1.8 million this academic year to subsidise extracurricular activities. SKH Tseung Kwan O Kei Tak Primary School is among 15 schools barred from offering primary one classes after failing to meet the minimum enrolment threshold of 16 pupils. Under a development plan approved by the Education Bureau, it will merge with SKH Kei Tak Primary School in Wong Tai Sin, with the permanent closure of its campus set for the 2029/30 academic year. As a result, current primary two and three students will eventually have to transfer to another school or relocate to the Wong Tai Sin campus. Principal of the SKH Tseung Kwan O Kei Tak Primary School, Kwong Ka-man, said it will provide maximum support to affected families over the next three years, noting that primary two and three pupils currently account for just over 10 of the school's total enrolment of 121. Although 10 other students have left after the merger was announced, Kwong stressed that the departure rate is similar to those of past years. She also said six new students joined over the summer, which she believes shows that parents retain confidence in the school. To provide a diverse learning experience for the students, she said, the school will offer free athletics, cycling and English classes by native-speaking teachers, alongside subsidised swimming classes. And to help ensure a smooth transition, Kwong said the school will gradually align its curriculum and textbooks with those used at the Wong Tai Sin campus. The school, she stressed, is also striving to secure school bus and uniform subsidies for students who commit to moving to the Wong Tai Sin campus. Some parents, however, said they intend to stay put. Bel, whose daughter is now in primary two, said her child was determined not to change schools, citing the cross-district commute. She pointed out that a switch to the Wong Tai Sin campus would add 30 minutes to the travel time. Another parent, Cynthia, has two children in primary four and six and plans to have them graduate at the school. Her family returned from Australia about a year and a half ago. “It’s the vision of the school aligned with our vision. We believe that learning is not just in the classroom and this school actually provides the children and students a lot of opportunities,” she said. “Of course we feel sad but we still have a few years here and we actually feel very confident that my children or, I believe, other parents think the same: our children will gain the best in this school. That's why we decided to stay here.” Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 将军澳一所小学校长周二表示，与姊妹学校合并不会削弱对学生的承诺，学校本学年预留180万港元资助课外活动。圣公会将军澳启德小学是因未能达到16名学生的最低入学门槛而被禁止开设小学一年级的15所学校之一。根据教育局批准的发展计划，该校将与黄大仙圣公会启德小学合并，并于2029/30学年永久关闭校园。因此，目前的小二和小三学生最终将不得不转学到另一所学校或搬迁到黄大仙校区。圣公会将军澳基德小学校长邝家文表示，未来三年会为受影响的家庭提供最大程度的支持，并指出目前学校121名学生中，小二和小三学生仅占10多一点。虽然合并宣布后，已有10名学生离开，但邝家文强调，离校率与往年相若。她还表示，今年夏天有六名新生加入，她认为这表明家长对学校仍然充满信心。她说，为了给学生提供多样化的学习体验，学校将提供由母语教师授课的免费体育、自行车和英语课程，以及有补贴的游泳课程。邝说，为了确保顺利过渡，学校将逐步将其课程和教科书与黄大仙校区使用的课程和教科书保持一致。她强调，学校也在努力为承诺搬到黄大仙校区的学生提供校车和校服补贴。然而，一些家长表示他们打算留在原地。贝尔的女儿现在上小学二年级，她说她的孩子决心不转学，理由是跨区通勤。她指出，若转往黄大仙校区，行程时间会增加30分钟。另一位家长辛西娅 (Cynthia) 有两个孩子，分别在小学四年级和六年级，并计划让他们在学校毕业。她的家人大约一年半前从澳大利亚回来。 “学校的愿景与我们的愿景一致。我们相信学习不仅仅在课堂上，这所学校实际上为孩子和学生提供了很多机会，”她说。 “我们当然感到难过，但我们在这里还有几年时间，而且我们实际上非常有信心，我的孩子，或者我相信其他家长也有同样的想法：我们的孩子将在这所学校获得最好的成绩。这就是我们决定留在这里的原因。”埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: Even as SKH Tseung Kwan O Kei Tak Primary School faces a merger and the discontinuation of its Primary One classes, its leadership remains committed to nurturing its current students. The allocation of HK$1.8 million for extracurricular activities demonstrates a dedication to the holistic development of the children entrusted to their care. This situation...
reflection.zh: 尽管基督教圣公会调景岭基德小学面临合并和小一课程停办，其领导层仍致力于关怀现有学生。拨出180万港元用于课外活动，体现了对孩子们全人发展的承诺。这种情况提醒我们，即使在机构发生重大变革时，也必须勤勉地引导和教育年轻人，确保他们的成长得以继续。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: Tai Po fire victim and petition organiser Jason Kong, wife to see fraud and money laundering case moved to higher court
title.zh: 大埔火灾受害者兼请愿组织者孔令辉夫妇涉嫌欺诈洗钱案移交高等法院

summary.en: Jason Kong, 64, and his wife Rosanna Cheung, 62, residents of Wang Fuk Court who had been advocating for the rights of fellow fire victims, are facing charges of conspiracy to defraud and money laundering. Their case is being transferred to a higher court.
summary.zh: 王福苑居民孔令辉（64岁）及其妻子张女士（62岁）曾为火灾幸存者争取权益，现面临欺诈和洗钱指控。他们的案件将被移交至更高一级法院审理。

body.en: A Wang Fuk Court resident arrested on fraud and money laundering charges after advocating for the rights of fellow fire victims will have his case transferred to a higher court. Jason Kong, 64, and his wife Rosanna Cheung, 62, arrived at the Shatin Magistrates’ Courts on Tuesday morning, two days after police pressed charges against them. Jason Wong appears at the Shatin Magistrates’ Courts on September 1, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The pair face two counts of conspiracy to defraud and one count of dealing with property known or believed to represent proceeds of an indictable offence – known commonly as money laundering. The prosecution applied to transfer the case to the District Court. The couple will be summoned to court again on October 6, with the prosecution to prepare transfer documents in the meantime. They face up to seven years’ jail with their case being moved to the District Court, more than double of if their case proceeded at the magistrate level, where the maximum prison sentence that can be delivered is three years when dealing with more than offence. The two defendants were granted bail on a HK$10,000 cash bond. They were ordered to reside at their reported address, not leave Hong Kong, not contact prosecution witnesses, and report to a police station once a week. According to a court document, Kong and Cheung, both directors of an interior design and engineering company, were charged with presenting false documents to HSBC in 2022. These were allegedly used to support their application for the Special 100% Guarantee Loan, a government relief scheme launched in early 2020 to help companies struggling amid the Covid-19 pandemic. Rosanna Cheung appears at the Shatin Magistrates’ Court on September 1, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The prosecution alleged that Kong and Cheung did so with the intent of fraudulently obtaining loans of HK$231,300 and HK$100,000. They are also accused of money laundering linked to the two loans, which totalled HK$331,300. Arrests following petition Kong and Cheung were arrested in mid-May, two weeks after Kong delivered a petition urging the administrators of fire-ravaged Wang Fuk Court to meet with homeowners. Kong told reporters after being released from police custody that he would no longer be speaking to the press. The couple are both survivors of the blaze that tore through Wang Fuk Court in November last year, claiming 168 lives and displacing thousands from the Tai Po housing estate. Wang Fuk Court resident Jason Kong (left), one of the petition organisers, delivers their demand and the handwritten signatures to Hop On Management, a subsidiary of real estate giant Chinachem Group, on April 29, 2026. Photo: Supplied. Kong, who was a member of the Wang Fuk Court owners’...
body.zh: 宏福苑一名居民因倡导火灾受害者的权利而因欺诈和洗钱指控被捕，他的案件将被移交给高级法院。 64 岁的江杰森 (Jason Kong) 和 62 岁的妻子张洛珊 (Rosanna Cheung) 于周二上午抵达沙田裁判法院，两天前，警方对他们提出指控。 Jason Wong 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日在沙田裁判法院出庭。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。两人面临两项共谋诈骗罪和一项处理已知或据信代表可起诉犯罪（通常称为洗钱）所得财产的罪名。检方申请将案件移交区域法院。这对夫妇将于10月6日再次出庭，检方同时准备移交文件。如果案件移交地方法院，他们将面临最高七年的监禁，如果案件在治安法官一级审理，则刑期会增加一倍以上，如果处理的罪行超过犯罪，最高可判处三年监禁。两名被告以港币 10,000 元现金保释获准保释。他们被命令居住在所报告的地址，不得离开香港，不得联系控方证人，并每周到警察局报到一次。根据一份法庭文件，孔和张都是一家室内设计和工程公司的董事，他们被指控在 2022 年向汇丰银行提供虚假文件。据称，这些文件被用来支持他们申请 100% 特别担保贷款，这是一项政府于 2020 年初推出的救济计划，旨在帮助在 Covid-19 大流行中陷入困境的公司。 Rosanna Cheung 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日在沙田裁判法院出庭。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。检方指称江及张这样做的目的是骗取贷款港币231,300元及港币100,000元。他们还被指控与这两笔贷款有关的洗钱活动，总额为 331,300 港元。请愿后被捕 江和张于五月中旬被捕，两周前，江提交了一份请愿书，敦促遭受火灾的宏福法院的管理人员与房主会面。孔在被警方释放后告诉记者，他将不再向媒体发表讲话。这对夫妇都是去年 11 月席卷宏福苑大火的幸存者，这场大火夺去了 168 人的生命，并导致数千人离开大埔住宅区。 2026 年 4 月 29 日，请愿组织者之一、宏福苑居民江志强（左）将诉求和手写签名递交给房地产巨头华懋集团旗下合安管理公司。照片：提供。江先生是宏福苑业主委员会的成员...

reflection.en: Advocating for fellow fire victims, Jason Kong and his wife now face serious charges. The news prompts reflection on how justice and mercy intertwine, especially when individuals championing others find themselves entangled in legal battles. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with God, a...
reflection.zh: 孔令辉先生和他的妻子在为火灾幸存者争取权益的同时，自己却面临严峻的指控。这则新闻促使我们思考，当那些为他人发声的人自己陷入法律纠纷时，公义与怜悯如何交织。弥迦书6章8节提醒我们，真正的公义在于行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与神同行，这是在任何境况下都应遵循的正直之道。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.
reflection.zh: Shein在香港股市上市首日估值从近1000亿美元暴跌至略高于260亿美元，这有力地提醒我们商业的波动性。箴言16:3鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划，这智慧超越了市场的起伏。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: HKIS and its founding church end ties in settlement
title.zh: 香港国际学校协会与其创始教会达成和解，结束合作关系

summary.en: The Hong Kong International School Association Limited (HKISAL) and the Lutheran Church–Missouri Synod (LCMS) have reached a confidential mediated settlement, concluding their legal disputes and dissolving their governance relationship. This resolution follows a lawsuit filed by the US-based church in September 2025,...
summary.zh: 香港国际学校协会有限公司（HKISAL）与路德教会—密苏里州教区（LCMS）已达成一项保密的调解协议，结束了他们的法律纠纷并解散了治理关系。此项和解源于美国教会于2025年9月提起的诉讼，该教会声称学校已偏离其创办原则，仅服务富裕家庭，违反了双方协议。

body.en: The Hong Kong International School Association Limited (HKISAL) and the Lutheran Church–Missouri Synod (LCMS) have reached a confidential mediated settlement, bringing an end to their legal proceedings and officially dissolving their governance relationship. The resolution concluded a dispute that began in September 2025, when the US-based church – which founded Hong Kong International School (HKIS) in 1966 – filed a lawsuit against the school’s operator. In the legal action, the LCMS alleged that the school had strayed from its founding principles by catering exclusively to wealthy families, in violation of their operating agreement. According to a statement by the HKIS on Tuesday, the search for the head of school – initiated by the LCMS – has been discontinued. In addition, the school's leadership will remain unchanged, continuing under the governance of the board of managers, and the HKISAL will retain its role as the operator of both the Repulse Bay and Tai Tam campuses. The school also moved to reassure parents and stakeholders, emphasising that the settlement would not result in any additional tuition increases and that no philanthropic donations would be used to cover the legal or settlement costs. "We are pleased to have reached a resolution of this issue through mediation. We acknowledge the LCMS’s role as a founder of HKIS and its important contribution in establishing HKIS' Christian identity," said Harold Kim, a member of the HKIS board of managers. "We remain focused on providing our students with an exceptional educational experience." In its statement, the LCMS said the mediation resulted in a mutually respectful solution. It said the agreement allows the HKISAL to pursue its vision for the school, while the LCMS will receive a monetary settlement that reflects its historical contributions. The LCMS also acknowledged that over time, HKIS evolved into an operation that differed significantly from its founding vision. While the church recognised the school’s financial success and high academic standing, it argued that its unique mission – rooted in providing quality education for all – was no longer the driving purpose of the institution. The statement noted that years of struggle with HKISAL over the school's mission and purpose ultimately led to the lawsuit, through which the LCMS sought to enforce the operating agreement and restore its founding principles. "We did not take this step lightly, and we would have preferred to have not taken it at all," said Christian Preus, chairman of the LCMS board of directors. "The outcome provides a fair resolution to the concerns the LCMS has raised for many years. It also enables the LCMS to pursue its mission unencumbered by the dispute with HKISAL, so that we can best utilise our resources...
body.zh: 香港国际学校协会有限公司（HKISAL）与密苏里州信义会（LCMS）已达成保密调解和解，结束了法律诉讼并正式解除了治理关系。该决议结束了一场始于 2025 年 9 月的纠纷，当时这家于 1966 年创办香港国际学校 (HKIS) 的美国教会对该学校的运营商提起诉讼。在法律诉讼中，LCMS 指控学校专门为富裕家庭提供服务，违反了运营协议，从而偏离了其创办原则。根据香港国际学校周二的一份声明，由 LCMS 发起的寻找校长的工作已经停止。此外，学校的领导层将保持不变，继续由董事会管理，而香港国际学生总会将保留其浅水湾和大潭校区的运营者角色。学校还采取行动安抚家长和利益相关者，强调和解不会导致任何额外的学费增加，并且不会使用慈善捐款来支付法律或和解费用。 HKIS 董事会成员 Harold Kim 表示：“我们很高兴通过调解解决了这一问题。我们认可 LCMS 作为 HKIS 创始人的角色及其在建立 HKIS 基督教身份方面的重要贡献。” “我们仍然致力于为学生提供卓越的教育体验。” LCMS 在声明中表示，调解达成了相互尊重的解决方案。该协议表示，该协议允许 HKISAL 追求其对学校的愿景，而 LCMS 将获得反映其历史贡献的金钱和解。 LCMS 还承认，随着时间的推移，HKIS 逐渐发展成为与其创始愿景显着不同的业务。虽然教会承认学校的财务成功和较高的学术地位，但它认为其独特的使命——植根于为所有人提供优质教育——不再是该机构的驱动目标。声明指出，多年来与 HKISAL 在学校使命和宗旨上的斗争最终导致了诉讼，LCMS 通过诉讼寻求执行运营协议并恢复其创始原则。 LCMS 董事会主席克里斯蒂安·普鲁斯 (Christian Preus) 表示：“我们并没有轻易采取这一举措，而且我们宁愿根本不采取这一举措。” “这一结果为 LCMS 多年来提出的问题提供了一个公平的解决方案。这也使 LCMS 能够不受与 HKISAL 纠纷的影响，继续履行其使命，以便我们能够最好地利用我们的资源......

reflection.en: The resolution between the Hong Kong International School Association and the Lutheran Church–Missouri Synod demonstrates the power of mediation to bring an end to protracted disputes. By seeking a confidential settlement, both parties chose a path of peace over continued conflict, embodying the Beatitude for peacemakers.
reflection.zh: 香港国际学校协会与路德教会—密苏里州教区之间的和解，展示了调解在结束长期争端方面的力量。通过寻求保密和解，双方选择了和平而非持续的冲突，体现了为和平者所赐的福分。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Former economic crime chief to head discipline team at Hong Kong, Macau office
title.zh: 前经济犯罪主管将领导香港、澳门办事处纪律检查组

summary.en: A veteran mainland Chinese economic crime investigator and former police official has been appointed to lead the discipline inspection and supervision group at Beijing’s top office overseeing Hong Kong affairs. Hua Liebing, a former director of the Ministry of Public Security’s economic crime investigation bureau,...
summary.zh: 一位经验丰富的中国内地经济犯罪侦查员兼前警官已被任命为北京负责香港事务的最高机构的纪律检查和监督小组负责人。公安部经济犯罪侦查局前局长华列兵填补了香港及澳门事务办公室（港澳办）的空缺，该空缺由去年退休担任河北省纪委书记的耿长友留下。

body.en: A veteran mainland Chinese economic crime investigator and former police official has been appointed to lead the discipline inspection and supervision group at Beijing’s top office overseeing Hong Kong affairs. Hua Liebing, a former director of the Ministry of Public Security’s economic crime investigation bureau, fills the vacancy at the Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office (HKMAO) left by Geng Changyou, who stepped down last year to become secretary of Hebei’s Commission for Discipline...
body.zh: 一名资深的中国内地经济犯罪调查员、前警察官员已被任命领导北京最高办公厅负责香港事务的纪检监察组。公安部经济犯罪侦查局原局长华烈兵填补去年卸任河北省纪委书记耿长友留下的港澳事务办公室空缺。

reflection.en: The appointment of Hua Liebing, a former economic crime investigator, to lead discipline inspection in Hong Kong signals a focus on oversight and accountability. This echoes the prophetic call to "act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God." Such roles are vital for fostering integrity and trust within governance structures.
reflection.zh: 任命华列兵这位前经济犯罪侦查员来领导香港的纪律检查工作，表明了对监督和问责的重视。这呼应了先知所呼吁的“施行公义，喜爱怜悯，谦卑与你的雅伟同行”。这样的职位对于在治理结构中培养诚信和信任至关重要。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Rain, internet outages hit first day of Hong Kong’s robot convenience stores
title.zh: 香港首批机器人便利店开业遇雨和网络中断

summary.en: The debut of Hong Kong's first humanoid robot-operated convenience stores on Tuesday was hampered by heavy rain and internet outages. Despite these initial challenges, visitors expressed appreciation for the robots' efforts. The company Galbot launched two outdoor stores and one indoor shop, offering a range of...
summary.zh: 香港首家由人形机器人运营的便利店于周二开业，但受到大雨和网络中断的困扰。尽管面临这些初步挑战，访客们仍对机器人的工作表示赞赏。公司Galbot开设了两家户外店和一家室内店，提供各种零食、饮料和主题商品。

body.en: Heavy rain and internet outages marred the launch of Hong Kong’s first humanoid robot-operated convenience stores on Tuesday, but visitors said they still appreciated the work of the new robots. Embodied-intelligence robotics company Galbot opened two outdoor stores in Hung Hom and Wan Chai and an indoor shop in Kai Tak. The Galbot Stores offer a mix of snacks and drinks, along with local offerings such as pineapple-bun and egg-tart-themed merchandise, with prices ranging from HK$14 to HK$139...
body.zh: 周二，大雨和网络中断阻碍了香港第一家人形机器人便利店的开业，但游客表示，他们仍然欣赏新机器人的工作。具身智能机器人公司Galbot在红磡和湾仔开设了两家户外店，并在启德开设了一家室内店。 Galbot Stores 提供各种小吃和饮品，以及菠萝包和蛋挞主题商品等本地产品，价格从 14 港元到 139 港元不等...

reflection.en: The launch of Galbot's robot convenience stores, despite facing initial setbacks like rain and internet outages, embodies the spirit of committing one's work to Yahweh. This venture represents a significant entrepreneurial effort, aiming to innovate and serve customers in a new way. It reminds us that even in the face of unexpected challenges, dedication...
reflection.zh: 尽管面临大雨和网络中断等初步挫折，Galbot机器人便利店的开业体现了将工作献给雅伟的精神。这项事业代表着一项重要的创业努力，旨在以新的方式进行创新并为客户服务。它提醒我们，即使面对意想不到的挑战，在我们事业中的奉献和毅力也能带来进步。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Excitement and anxiety as pupils return to school, aided by new well-being campaign
title.zh: 新心理健康运动助推下，学童返校，喜忧参半

summary.en: Primary school pupils returned to class across Hong Kong on Tuesday with a mix of excitement and anxiety over the year ahead, as the education chief pledged to strengthen mental health support in schools. During a visit to the Hong Kong Taoist Association Wun Tsuen School, Secretary for Education Christine Choi...
summary.zh: 周二，香港小学生们怀着对新学年的兴奋与焦虑重返校园。教育局局长承诺将加强学校的心理健康支持。在香港道教联合会云泉学校的一次访问中，教育局局长蔡若莲宣布启动一项旨在改善学生福祉的新运动。“这项倡议鼓励学生互相支持和关爱，以防止校园欺凌。”...

body.en: Primary school pupils returned to class across Hong Kong on Tuesday with a mix of excitement and anxiety over the year ahead, as the education chief pledged to strengthen mental health support in schools. During a visit to the Hong Kong Taoist Association Wun Tsuen School, Secretary for Education Christine Choi Yuk-lin announced the launch of a new campaign aimed at improving student well-being. “This initiative encourages students to support and care for one another to prevent campus bullying,”...
body.zh: 周二，香港各地的小学生重返课堂，带着对未来一年的兴奋和焦虑，教育局长承诺加强学校的心理健康支持。教育局局长蔡玉莲在参观香港道教协会云村学校时宣布推出一项旨在改善学生福祉的新活动。 “这一举措鼓励学生互相支持和关心，以防止校园欺凌，”...

reflection.en: The return to school can be a time of great transition, bringing both anticipation and apprehension for young students. The launch of a new well-being campaign, as reported in Hong Kong, acknowledges the emotional needs of children and aims to foster a supportive environment. This echoes the divine promise to heal the brokenhearted, offering hope and...
reflection.zh: 返校季可能是一个巨大的过渡时期，给年幼的学生带来期待和不安。香港报道的这项新福祉运动的启动，承认了孩子们的情感需求，并旨在营造一个支持性的环境。这呼应了神治愈心碎之人的应许，为那些应对新学年焦虑的人们带来了希望和安慰。

verse.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

title.en: Choi unveils stronger support for non-Chinese students
title.zh: 蔡若蓮公布加強對非華語學生的支援

summary.en: Secretary for Education Christine Choi announced on Tuesday a series of enhanced measures aimed at bolstering support for non-Chinese speaking students and facilitating their smooth integration into the education system. Speaking at the Hong Kong Taoist Association Wun Tsuen School, she praised the institution for...
summary.zh: 教育局局長蔡若蓮週二宣布了一系列加強措施，旨在為非華語學生提供更多支援，並促進他們順利融入教育體系。她在香港道教聯合會圓玄學院的學校致辭時，讚揚該校培養了多元包容的環境，並強調了其多語言課程。

body.en: Secretary for Education Christine Choi announced on Tuesday a series of enhanced measures aimed at bolstering support for non-Chinese speaking students and facilitating their smooth integration into the education system. Speaking in a ceremony at the new campus of the Hong Kong Taoist Association Wun Tsuen School in Kwun Tong at the start of the academic year, she praised the primary school – which has a high enrolment of ethnic minority students – for fostering a diverse and inclusive environment. Choi said the campus not only offers small-group Chinese language courses for non-Chinese speaking learners but also a variety of multi-language programmes and extracurricular interest classes. "The Education Bureau has also allocated extra funding to create new pathways for students, provide parental education and support, and help non-Chinese students better learn the Chinese language, adapt to the local education system, and prepare for future study and work," she said. Choi also outlined a comprehensive range of measures covering curriculum development, teaching resources, teacher training and professional support services – all aimed at ensuring that students from non-Chinese backgrounds can achieve academic success on par with their peers. In response to questions from reporters after the ceremony, she also addressed the city’s declining school-age population, describing it as a structural issue. She emphasised that the bureau is implementing various strategies to help schools achieve a "soft landing" in the face of this decline, allowing them to gradually adjust class sizes and the number of classes offered. As part of these efforts, the bureau has invited schools under the Direct Subsidy Scheme (DSS) to apply for an expansion of their sources of students. This initiative permits DSS schools to increase both class numbers and sizes in order to admit self-financing non-locals who hold student visas. Choi said the Hong Kong Direct Subsidy Scheme Schools Council has been actively promoting the plan across Southeast Asia and has received positive feedback from parents in the region. The final number of non-locals arriving in Hong Kong for studies, she said, will be determined after the official student headcount is completed at the end of this month. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 教育局局长蔡徐亭周二宣布一系列加强措施，旨在加强对非华语学生的支持，促进他们顺利融入教育体系。学年开始时，她在香港道教协会观塘云村学校新校区举行的仪式上发表讲话，赞扬这所少数族裔学生入学率很高的小学营造了一个多元化和包容的环境。崔说，校园不仅为非华语学习者提供小组汉语课程，还提供各种多语言课程和课外兴趣班。她说：“教育局还拨款额外拨款，为学生开辟新途径，提供家长教育和支持，帮助非华裔学生更好地学习中文，适应当地教育体系，为未来的学习和工作做好准备。”蔡还概述了一系列全面的措施，涵盖课程开发、教学资源、教师培训和专业支持服务，所有这些措施都是为了确保非华裔背景的学生能够取得与同龄人同等的学术成功。在仪式后回答记者提问时，她还谈到了该市学龄人口的下降，称这是一个结构性问题。她强调，面对这种下滑，教育局正在实施各种策略，帮助学校实现“软着陆”，让学校逐步调整班级规模和课程数量。作为这些努力的一部分，教育局已邀请直接资助计划的学校申请扩大生源。这一举措允许 DSS 学校增加班级数量和规模，以招收持有学生签证的自负盈亏的非本地学生。蔡表示，香港直接资助计划学校议会一直在东南亚地区积极推动该计划，并得到了该地区家长的积极反馈。她表示，最终来港就读的非本地学生人数将在本月底完成官方学生人数统计后确定。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The Hong Kong government's new measures to support non-Chinese speaking students reflect a commitment to ensuring all children have the opportunity to learn and thrive. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for all their rights." This initiative embodies that principle by actively creating pathways for integration...
reflection.zh: 香港政府為非華語學生推出新的支援措施，體現了確保所有兒童都有學習和發展機會的承諾。《箴言》31:8-9 呼籲我們「為不能說話的開口，為一切孤苦人伸冤」。這項舉措體現了這一原則，積極為來自不同語言背景的學生創造融入和成功的途徑。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Danish sculptor writes to Hong Kong court asking for return of Tiananmen crackdown monument
title.zh: 丹麦雕塑家致信香港法院，要求归还天安门镇压纪念碑

summary.en: A Danish sculptor has petitioned a Hong Kong court to reclaim his 'Pillar of Shame' monument, which commemorates the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. This action follows the recent national security conviction of activists associated with the city's annual vigil mourning the event. The artist, Jens Galschiøt, asserts...
summary.zh: 一位丹麦雕塑家已致信香港法院，要求归还他纪念1989年天安门镇压事件的“国殇之柱”雕塑。此举发生在与该市年度悼念集会相关的活动人士因国家安全罪被定罪之后。艺术家延斯·加尔斯乔特（Jens Galschiøt）声称拥有这座八米高的雕塑的所有权，该雕塑于2021年被从香港大学校园移走。

body.en: A Danish sculptor has written to a Hong Kong court asking for the return of his statue commemorating China’s 1989 Tiananmen crackdown, following the national security conviction of a group behind the city’s annual vigil mourning the incident. The Pillar of Shame. File photo: May James/HKFP. Jens Galschiøt, the artist behind the Pillar of Shame monument that stood on the University of Hong Kong (HKU) campus for more than two decades before it was taken down in 2021, sent a letter to the High Court last Friday, claiming ownership of the eight-metre-tall sculpture and demanding its return. The letter – seen by HKFP – came after the court convicted two Tiananmen vigil activists , Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan, as well as the group they once led, the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, of inciting subversion under a Beijing-imposed national security law. Following the convictions, prosecutors asked the court to order the confiscation of the Pillar of Shame, which was among the exhibits cited in the case . A decision is yet to be made. In his letter, Galschiøt said he is the owner of the Pillar of Shame, which he lent to the Alliance in 1997 for permanent display in Hong Kong. “I claim the sculpture and respectfully request that it be returned to me. I do not consent to its confiscation, destruction, disposal, or transfer to any other person or institution,” the artist wrote. Return to Denmark Galschiøt said he will not personally travel to Hong Kong to collect his work and will instead appoint professional art handlers and transport specialists to bring the sculpture back to Denmark. The sculpture is a “large, valuable and fragile work of art,” he said, adding that transportation should be done by qualified professionals. They will cooperate with Hong Kong authorities to arrange the shipment, he said. Jens Galschiøt. File photo: Jens Galschiøt. “For the avoidance of doubt, the fact that I will not travel personally to Hong Kong does not mean that I have abandoned the sculpture, relinquished ownership, or do not wish to receive it,” he said. “To the contrary, by this letter I formally claim the [sculpture] and request its return,” he added. The artist also sent a letter to HKU on the same day, claiming ownership of the sculpture and demanding its return. The Pillar of Shame was an iconic tribute to the victims of the 1989 crackdown, when Beijing sent troops to disperse pro-democracy protesters around Tiananmen Square, killing hundreds and perhaps thousands. Members of the University of Hong Kong students’ union stand in front of the Pillar of Shame. File photo: Supplied. The sculpture was torn down in the middle of the night in December 2021, with HKU citing safety reasons and “legal...
body.zh: 一名丹麦雕塑家写信给香港一家法院，要求归还他为纪念中国 1989 年天安门镇压而建造的雕像，此前香港一年一度的悼念天安门事件的组织因国家安全罪被定罪。耻辱之柱。资料照片：May James/HKFP。香港大学 (HKU) 校园内矗立了二十多年的耻辱之柱纪念碑于 2021 年被拆除，延斯·加斯基特 (Jens Galschiøt) 上周五致信高等法院，声称拥有这座 8 米高的雕塑，并要求归还其。 《香港新闻社》看到的这封信是在法院根据北京实施的国家安全法对两名天安门守夜活动人士周恒东和李卓人以及他们曾经领导的团体“香港支持中国爱国民主运动联盟”定罪后发布的。定罪后，检察官要求法院下令没收本案引用的证物之一“耻辱之柱”。尚未做出决定。 Galschiøt 在信中表示，他是耻辱之柱的所有者，他于 1997 年将其借给联盟，以便在香港永久展示。 “我认领这件雕塑，并恭敬地请求将其归还给我。我不同意将其没收、销毁、处置或转让给任何其他人或机构，”艺术家写道。返回丹麦 Galschiøt表示，他不会亲自前往香港收集作品，而是会委托专业的艺术品处理人员和运输专家将雕塑带回丹麦。他说，这座雕塑是“大型、有价值且易碎的艺术品”，并补充说运输应由合格的专业人员进行。他说，他们将与香港当局合作安排发货。延斯·加尔斯基特。资料照片：Jens Galschiøt。他说：“为避免疑义，我不会亲自前往香港，但这并不意味着我已经放弃了该雕塑、放弃了所有权或不想接收它。” “相反，通过这封信，我正式认领该[雕塑]并要求归还，”他补充道。艺术家亦于同日致函香港大学，声称拥有该雕塑，并要求归还该雕塑。 《耻辱之柱》是对 1989 年镇压受害者的标志性致敬，当时北京派出军队驱散天安门广场周围的民主抗议者，造成数百甚至数千人死亡。香港大学学生会成员站在耻辱柱前。资料照片：提供。该雕塑于 2021 年 12 月半夜被拆除，香港大学以安全原因和“法律...

reflection.en: The artist's plea for his monument's return, following the conviction of activists, speaks to a deep sense of injustice and the suppression of historical memory. Habakkuk laments a similar perversion of justice, where the law itself seems to fail the righteous. This situation calls for reflection on how societies grapple with difficult histories and the...
reflection.zh: 艺术家在活动人士被定罪后为其纪念碑归还的呼吁，反映了一种深刻的不公感和对历史记忆的压制。哈巴谷哀叹类似的司法扭曲，在那里法律本身似乎未能保护义人。这种情况促使我们反思社会如何处理艰难的历史，以及艺术在保存真相中的作用。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Ex-official among 33,019 who failed to complete eTAX filings amid unclear wording
title.zh: 前官员等33019人因eTAX措辞不清未能完成报税

summary.en: Hong Kong's ombudsman found that over 33,000 individuals, including former Hospital Authority chief executive Dr Luk Che-chung, failed to complete their tax returns due to ambiguous wording in the eTAX system. This resulted in nearly 5,200 penalty notices and two prosecutions, prompting calls for government...
summary.zh: 香港申诉专员公署发现，包括医院管理局前行政总裁陆志聪医生在内的超过33,000名纳税人，因eTAX系统措辞含糊不清而未能完成报税。这导致近5,200人收到罚款通知，两人被检控，引发了对政府问责的呼吁。

body.en: More than 33,000 people failed to submit completed tax returns because of unclear wording in Hong Kong’s eTAX system, the ombudsman has found, with nearly 5,200 receiving penalty notices and two prosecuted. Dr Luk Che-chung, a former chief executive of the Hospital Authority’s Hong Kong East area, was among the affected taxpayers and urged the government on Tuesday to learn from the incident. In a report released on Monday, the Office of the Ombudsman said ambiguous instructions on the eTAX...
body.zh: 监察员发现，由于香港税务易系统中的措辞不明确，超过 33,000 人未能提交完整的纳税申报表，其中近 5,200 人收到罚款通知，两人被起诉。医院管理局港岛东地区前行政总裁陆志聪医生是受影响的纳税人之一，他周二敦促政府从这起事件中吸取教训。在周一发布的一份报告中，监察员办公室表示，关于 eTAX 的指示不明确……

reflection.en: The report from Hong Kong's ombudsman reveals a systemic failure where unclear government communication led to penalties for thousands of citizens. This situation underscores the prophetic call for public officials to administer services with clarity and integrity, ensuring that the people they serve are not harmed by administrative ambiguity. True...
reflection.zh: 香港申诉专员公署的报告揭示了一项系统性失误，即政府沟通不清导致数千名市民受到处罚。这种情况凸显了先知对公职人员的呼吁，要求他们以清晰和正直的态度管理公共服务，确保他们所服务的人民不因行政上的含糊而受到伤害。真正的治理需要勤勉地确保各项制度对所有人来说都是易于理解且公正的。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Lee confident of HK fighting spirit in Asian Games
title.zh: 李家超对香港的亚洲运动会拼搏精神充满信心

summary.en: Hong Kong is sending a delegation of 580 athletes to the Asian Games in Nagoya. Chief Executive John Lee expressed confidence that they will surpass previous achievements, citing their record medal haul in the last games. He spoke at an event where he officially handed over the SAR flag to the contingent.
summary.zh: 香港将派出由580名运动员组成的代表团参加本月在名古屋举行的亚洲运动会。行政长官李家超周二表示，他对香港代表团能够超越以往的成就充满信心，并提及他们在上一届亚运会上创纪录的奖牌数量。他在香港体育协会暨奥林匹克委员会主办的活动上发表了讲话，并向代表团正式授旗。

body.en: Hong Kong, China is sending 580 athletes to the Asian Games in Nagoya this month, with Chief Executive John Lee expressing confidence on Tuesday that they can surpass the achievements of past contingents. He was speaking after officially handing the SAR flag to the contingent at an event hosted by the Sports Federation and Olympic Committee of Hong Kong, China (SF&OC). In his address, Lee highlighted the outstanding performances of Hong Kong athletes in past Asian Games, particularly at the last edition in Hangzhou, where they secured a record haul of eight gold, 16 silver and 29 bronze medals. He voiced his strong belief that the team would carry forward the fighting spirit they demonstrated at last year’s National Games, giving their all on the Asian stage and striving for even better results – bringing further glory to both the nation and Hong Kong. "Every high-level competition is not only a test of the athletes' skills and willpower but also an opportunity for people from different countries and regions to deepen mutual understanding and forge friendships," Lee said. "The resilience and never-say-die spirit displayed by athletes from Hong Kong, China, on the field are the best embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. "They can transcend linguistic and cultural boundaries, showcasing our confidence and soft power to the world, and telling the good stories of the nation and of Hong Kong." Committee president Timothy Fok said this year’s Games, which will be held across multiple cities, pose certain logistical challenges. Nevertheless, he gave the reassurance that the SF&OC would serve as a solid pillar of support for the athletes, coordinating with relevant parties to ensure they are well taken care of off the field and can focus on delivering strong performances. Speaking after the ceremony, the contingent's chef de mission, Wong Po-kee, noted that there are 90 fewer athletes this time round compared with the one sent to Hangzhou in 2023. He pointed out that no athletes are fielded this time in some of the events where medals were won previously. Still, Hong Kong, China is setting the goal of achieving results roughly on par with the last edition. Wong added that most of the athletes would depart for Japan on September 16 and 18. As for the flag bearer arrangements for the opening ceremony, he said those details have yet to be discussed. One of the athletes representing the SAR is star fencer Edgar Cheung. The two-time Olympic champion and reigning Asian Games men's individual foil gold medallist said he's approaching the tournament with his usual training routine. "As for my goal, I hope that we can win a gold medal in the team event because we've already taken silver and bronze before, so I'm hoping that we can have a breakthrough this time," he...
body.zh: 中国香港将派出 580 名运动员参加本月在名古屋举行的亚运会，行政长官李家超周二表示有信心他们能够超越过去队伍的成就。他是在中国香港体育协会暨奥林匹克委员会（SF&OC）主办的活动中正式将特区旗交给代表团后发表上述言论的。李在致辞时强调，香港运动员在历届亚运会中表现出色，特别是在上届杭州亚运会上，他们夺得了8枚金牌、16枚银牌和29枚铜牌，创下了纪录。他坚信，球队一定会发扬去年全运会的拼搏精神，在亚洲舞台上全力以赴，争取更好的成绩，为国家和香港再创辉煌。 “每届高水平比赛不仅是对运动员技术和意志力的考验，也是不同国家和地区人民加深相互了解、结交友谊的机会。”李说。 “中国香港运动员在赛场上所展现的韧性和永不言败的精神，是香港精神的最佳体现。他们能够超越语言和文化的界限，向世界展示我们的信心和软实力，讲述国家和香港的好故事。”组委会主席霍震霆表示，今年的奥运会将在多个城市举行，对后勤工作带来一定的挑战。不过，他保证SF＆OC将作为一个坚实的基础代表团团长黄宝基在仪式结束后表示，与2023年派往杭州的运动员相比，本次派出的运动员人数减少了90人，与相关各方协调，确保他们在赛场外得到良好照顾，并能够集中精力发挥。他指出，这次没有运动员参加一些先前获得奖牌的项目。与上一届一样，大部分运动员将于9月16日至18日启程前往日本。至于开幕式的旗手安排，他表示，其中一名代表特区的运动员是两届奥运会冠军、卫冕亚运会男子花剑金牌得主张德强，他表示，他将以平常的训练方式迎接比赛。因为我们之前已经拿过银牌和铜牌了，所以我希望这次我们能有所突破，”他...

reflection.en: As 580 athletes from Hong Kong prepare to compete in the Asian Games, they embody the spirit of striving for excellence. The Apostle Paul reminds us in 1 Corinthians 9:24 that athletes train rigorously, 'so that they may obtain a perishable wreath.' May their efforts be marked by dedication and integrity, reflecting a commitment to giving their best.
reflection.zh: 香港有580名运动员即将参加亚洲运动会，他们体现了追求卓越的精神。使徒保罗在哥林多前书9章24节提醒我们，运动员们刻苦训练，“好得着能朽坏的冠冕”。愿他们的努力充满奉献和诚信，体现全力以赴的决心。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: Court of Appeal upholds ruling against gov’t over Fanling golf course housing plan
title.zh: 上诉法院维持反对政府粉岭高尔夫球场建屋计划的裁决

summary.en: Hong Kong's Court of Appeal has ruled against the government in a legal challenge concerning plans to develop public housing on the Fanling golf course. The court upheld a previous ruling that sided with the Hong Kong Golf Club, which had argued the government improperly approved an environmental report for the...
summary.zh: 香港上诉法院就将粉岭高尔夫球场改建公共房屋的计划，裁定政府败诉。法院维持了早前一项支持香港高尔夫球会、认为政府在批准该项目所需的环境报告时程序不当的判决。

body.en: Hong Kong’s appeals court has ruled against the government in a legal challenge connected with plans to build public housing on a golf course in Fanling. Fanling golf course. Photo: Wikicommons. The Court of Appeal handed down the verdict on Monday, upholding a lower court’s earlier judgement. In 2024, a judge sided with the Hong Kong Golf Club, which lodged a judicial review on the grounds that the government had not acted in accordance with the law when it approved an environmental report required for the public housing project. Judicial reviews are considered by the Court of First Instance and examine the decision-making processes of administrative bodies. Matters under review must be shown to affect the wider public interest. In the latest verdict, a three-judge Court of Appeal panel emphasised that the proceedings were not about the authorities’ decision to reclaim the golf club’s land and build homes, but rather about the project’s Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA). Hong Kong’s High Court. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. EIAs evaluate the likely ecological effects of major development projects. They are submitted on behalf of the Civil Engineering and Development Department (CEDD) and considered for approval by the Director of Environmental Protection, who leads the Environmental Protection Department (EPD). In its 2023 judicial review, the Hong Kong Golf Club challenged the approval of the housing project’s EIA, arguing that there was a lack of public consultation and a failure to account for ecological concerns. The High Court ruled in favour of the club, handing the government a defeat. Judge Russell Coleman agreed with the club that authorities should have reopened the project to public consultation after the CEDD submitted additional information to the EIA, including surveys on affected bird and moth populations. ‘Unfairness’ In Monday’s verdict, the Court of Appeal judges said there was “unfairness” in the consultation process. The Fanling Golf Course. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “[The new information]… was material that ought to have been but was not included in the EIA report for public inspection,” the judgement read. “The failure to remedy this deficiency by holding a further consultation meant that there was unfairness in the consultation overall,” it added. In approving the report, environmental authorities also did not consider the golf club’s response to the additional information, the judgement read. The government project was intended to provide housing for 33,600 residents on a 9.5-hectare plot of the Fanling golf course – part of a larger 32-hectare plot that has been returned to the government. After the court ruled in...
body.zh: 香港上诉法院在一项与在粉岭高尔夫球场建造公共住房计划有关的法律挑战中对政府做出了败诉。粉岭高尔夫球场。照片：维基共享资源。上诉法院周一作出判决，维持下级法院先前的判决。 2024年，法官站在香港高尔夫球会一边，提出司法复核，理由是政府在批准公营房屋项目所需的环境报告时没有依法行事。司法审查由初审法院审理，并审查行政机构的决策过程。正在审查的事项必须证明会影响更广泛的公共利益。在最新的判决中，上诉法院的三名法官强调，诉讼程序并不是关于当局收回高尔夫俱乐部土地和建造房屋的决定，而是关于该项目的环境影响评估（EIA）。香港高等法院。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。环境影响评估评估重大开发项目可能产生的生态影响。它们代表土木工程拓展署（土木工程拓展署）提交，并由领导环境保护署（环保署）的环境保护署署长考虑批准。在2023年的司法复核中，香港高尔夫球会对该住房项目环评的批准提出质疑，认为缺乏公众咨询且未能考虑到生态问题。高等法院做出了有利于俱乐部的裁决，让政府败诉。罗素·科尔曼法官同意该俱乐部的观点，即在土木工程拓展署向环境影响评估提交了更多信息（包括对受影响鸟类和飞蛾种群的调查）后，当局应重新开放该项目以供公众咨询。 “不公平” 在周一的判决中，上诉法院法官表示咨询过程存在“不公平”。粉岭高尔夫球场。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。判决书中写道：“[新信息]……本应包含在环境影响评估报告中以供公众查阅，但并未包含在内。” “未能通过进一步磋商来弥补这一缺陷，意味着整个磋商存在不公平之处，”它补充道。判决书称，环保部门在批准该报告时也没有考虑高尔夫俱乐部对附加信息的回应。该政府项目旨在为粉岭高尔夫球场 9.5 公顷土地上的 33,600 名居民提供住房，该土地是已归还给政府的 32 公顷更大土地的一部分。法院判决后...

reflection.en: This legal battle over public housing on the Fanling golf course touches on the fundamental responsibility of governance. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him that is plundered." The court's decision, upholding a challenge to the government's process, underscores the importance of...
reflection.zh: 这场关于粉岭高尔夫球场公共房屋的法律纠纷，触及了施政的根本责任。耶利米书 22:3 呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压者的手。” 法院维持了对政府程序的挑战，这强调了在公共服务中问责的重要性，并确保发展计划能满足更广泛社区的需求。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: In Pictures: Fans pay tribute to Hong Kong independent bookshop Have a Nice Stay on final day following raid
title.zh: 图文：香港独立书店“好好生活”遭搜查后最后一天，书迷前来致意

summary.en: Dozens of book lovers visited Hong Kong independent bookstore Have a Nice Stay on its last day of operation Sunday, honoring the shop that was raided by national security police last month. Fans had formed long queues throughout the week following the shop's announcement of a five-day clearance sale before its...
summary.zh: 上周日，数十名爱书之人涌入香港独立书店“好好生活”，送别这家在上个月被国安警察搜查的书店。在书店宣布结业前举行五天清仓大减价后，过去一周，书迷们排起了长龙。

body.en: Dozens of bookworms squeezed into Hong Kong independent bookstore Have a Nice Stay on Sunday for its final day in business, paying tribute to the shop that was raided by national security police last month. Have a Nice Stay co-founder Sum Wan-wah waves to his customers on the final operating day of his independent bookshop in Prince Edward, on August 30, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Over the past week, fans had formed long queues winding up the Prince Edward tenement building where Have a Nice Stay is located, following the bookshop’s announcement that it would hold a five-day clearance sale before closing its doors forever. At about 9pm on Sunday, Have a Nice Stay co-founder Sum Wan-wah thanked customers for their support and wished them well as he prepared to pull down the shutters. Hong Kong independent bookstore Have a Nice Stay on its last day in business on August 30, 2026. Cards on the wall read: “Make every effort to enter through the narrow door.” Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Take care, everyone. Have a Nice Stay will cease operation from today,” Sum told customers and reporters in Cantonese before closing the door to the bookshop he operated for four years. Sum was among five independent booksellers arrested last month by the city’s national security police on suspicion of sedition. Three of the arrestees worked at Have a Nice Stay, while the other two were staffers at the 50-year-old Greenfield Bookstore in Mong Kok. Hong Kong independent bookstore Have a Nice Stay, on August 30, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Police also raided the two stores, seizing allegedly seditious materials. The five were later granted bail pending police investigations. See also: How an escalating crackdown on Hong Kong’s independent bookstores put Taiwan publishers in the spotlight A day before the raid, Have a Nice Stay announced that it would close by August 30, citing “unclear red lines” and financial struggles. Supporters line up to enter Hong Kong independent bookstore Have a Nice Stay on its final day of operation on August 30, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The arrests marked an escalation in a national security crackdown on the city’s independent booksellers, and came after arrests at Book Punch in March and Hunter Bookstore in June. Have a Nice Stay closed for weeks following the raid, opening only for the clearance sale that began last Wednesday. Supporters flocked over from across the city, many lining up patiently along the steps leading up to the third-floor bookshop. Two electric fans were set up in the staircase to alleviate the suffocating heat. Supporters – including former lawmaker Emily Lau in green – filled Hong Kong independent bookstore Have a Nice Stay on its closing day on August 30, 2026. Photo:...
body.zh: 周日，数十名书虫挤进香港独立书店“Have a Nice Stay”，这是其营业的最后一天，向这家上个月被国安警察突击搜查的商店致敬。 2026 年 8 月 30 日，Have a Nice Stay 联合创始人 Sum Wan-wah 在他位于太子的独立书店的最后营业日向顾客挥手致意。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。过去一周，书店宣布将举行为期五天的清仓甩卖活动，然后永远关门，粉丝们在《Have a Nice Stay》所在的爱德华太子唐楼排起长队。周日晚上 9 点左右，Have a Nice Stay 联合创始人 Sum Wan-wah 在准备关门时感谢顾客的支持并祝愿他们一切顺利。 2026年8月30日，香港独立书店Have a Nice Stay迎来了营业的最后一天。墙上的卡片上写着：“尽力从窄门进入。”照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “大家保重，住得好，从今天开始停止营业。”沉先生用粤语对顾客和记者说，然后关上了他经营了四年的书店的大门。萨姆是上个月因涉嫌煽动叛乱而被该市国家安全警察逮捕的五名独立书商之一。其中三名被捕者在Have a Nice Stay工作，另外两人则在旺角拥有50年历史的翠怡书店工作。香港独立书店祝你住得愉快，2026 年 8 月 30 日。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。警方还突袭了这两家商店，没收了涉嫌煽动性的材料。五人随后获准保释，等待警方调查。另请参阅：对香港独立书店不断升级的打压如何让台湾出版商成为众人瞩目的焦点在突袭前一天，Have a Nice Stay 宣布将于 8 月 30 日关闭，理由是“红线不明确”和财务困境。 2026 年 8 月 30 日，香港独立书店 Have a Nice Stay 营业最后一天，支持者排队进入。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。此次逮捕标志着国家安全对该市独立书商的打压行动升级，此前，3 月份的 Book Punch 和 6 月份的 Hunter 书店都曾遭到逮捕。突袭后，Have a Nice Stay 已关闭数周，仅在上周三开始的清仓大甩卖期间开放。支持者从城市各处涌来，许多人沿着通往三楼书店的台阶耐心地排队。楼梯处设置了两台电风扇，缓解闷热。 2026 年 8 月 30 日闭店日，香港独立书店 Have a Nice Stay 挤满了支持者，其中包括身着绿色衣服的前立法会议员刘慧卿。照片：...

reflection.en: Even as authorities may seek to control the flow of information and ideas, the human spirit often finds ways to express its convictions. The patrons of Have a Nice Stay, by showing up on its final day, demonstrate a commitment to the values the bookstore represented, choosing to honor it despite its closure under pressure.
reflection.zh: 即使当局试图控制信息和思想的流动，人的精神常常会找到表达其信念的方式。“好好生活”书店的顾客们，在它结业的最后一天前来致意，这表明了他们对这家书店所代表的价值观的坚持，选择在压力下关门之际仍给予尊重。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 伦敦股市避开了 Shein 这颗“子弹”

summary.en: Shein, the Chinese fast-fashion giant, is set to list in Hong Kong with a reduced valuation after a potential London IPO stalled. Despite intense wooing by UK politicians seeking to revitalize the local market with 'tech adrenalin,' significant concerns regarding Shein's business model and ethical practices led to a...
summary.zh: 中国快时尚巨头 Shein 在伦敦上市计划搁置后，将转往香港上市，但估值有所缩水。尽管英国政界此前为了振兴当地市场而积极拉拢，希望注入“技术兴奋剂”，但由于对其商业模式和伦理实践存在重大疑虑，伦敦金融界对于未能成事反而感到一种解脱。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大质疑在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。从 2024 年到去年，随着两大主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of rapid economic growth often tempts leaders to overlook the long-term health and ethical foundations of their institutions. While the 'tech adrenalin' of a massive IPO is attractive, true prudence involves recognizing when a short-term gain carries risks that outweigh the benefits. Yahweh values the wisdom that looks beyond the surface of a...
reflection.zh: 对经济快速增长的追求往往诱使领导者忽视机构的长期健康和伦理基础。虽然大规模 IPO 带来的“技术兴奋剂”极具吸引力，但真正的谨慎在于识别短期利益何时携带了超过收益的风险。雅伟看重那种能看透“缩水的价格标签”表面、审视内在工作诚信的智慧。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年血腥镇压民主抗议活动的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of two Hong Kong activists for organizing a Tiananmen vigil highlights the silencing of memory and dissent. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle embodied by those who sought to keep the truth of 1989 alive. As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...
reflection.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织天安门守夜活动而被定罪，这凸显了记忆和异议被压制的情况。箴言31:8呼吁我们“为不能自辩的人开口”，这正是那些努力让1989年真相得以存留的人所体现的原则。随着香港自由的被扼杀，这个故事提醒我们，其他人有道德义务为那些被噤声的人发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists
title.zh: “她无所畏惧”：香港最后一位直言不讳的民主活动家狱中笔迹

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021 and has written about various topics, including her personal struggles with maintaining dignity in prison, such as worrying about her appearance before court. She emphasizes the importance of holding onto personal expression against dehumanizing rules and schedules, striving...
summary.zh: 邹幸彤自2021年起被拘留，她写过各种话题，包括她在狱中维持尊严的个人挣扎，例如在出庭前担心自己的仪容。她强调在非人化的规则和日程安排下，抓住一切可以表达自我的方式来维持个人表达的重要性，努力避免被体制塑造成一个“模范公民”。

body.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries about her hairstyle before court appearances because there are no combs or mirrors in her cell. “In a place like prison, where anything that is personal is stripped away, it’s even more important to hold on to every means by which you can express yourself,” she writes. “Don’t let uniform, depersonalised rules, dress codes, schedules, and behavioural requirements grind down your edges and mould you into a ‘model citizen’”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周恒东自 2021 年以来一直被拘留，并撰写了从服装到天安门广场以及自由的意义等各种内容。香港天安门广场守夜活动组织者被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。在一篇在狱中写的文章中，周恒东对自己出庭前的发型感到担忧，因为她的牢房里没有梳子或镜子。 “在监狱这样的地方，任何个人的东西都被剥夺了，更重要的是要坚持一切可以表达自己的方式，”她写道。 “不要让统一的、非个性化的规则、着装规范、时间表和行为要求磨掉你的棱角，把你塑造成‘模范公民’”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the stark confines of her prison cell, Chow Hang-tung finds profound meaning in the small acts of maintaining her personal identity and dignity. Her writings highlight the human spirit's resilience, even when stripped of outward freedoms. This echoes the call to be a voice for the voiceless, ensuring that the humanity of those silenced or imprisoned is...
reflection.zh: 在监狱的严酷环境中，邹幸彤在维持个人身份和尊严的微小行动中找到了深刻的意义。她的文字突显了人类精神的韧性，即使在失去外在自由时也是如此。这呼应了为无声者发声的呼召，确保那些被噤声或囚禁者的基本人性不被遗忘。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Food innovation in your kitchen: Giving peas, beans and lentils a surprisingly meat-like bite
title.zh: 厨房里的食品创新：赋予豌豆、豆类和扁豆令人惊讶的肉质口感

summary.en: Food scientists are developing innovative ways to process plant-based ingredients like peas, beans, and lentils. By breaking down these raw materials into their constituent parts (proteins, starches, fats) and then reassembling them, they aim to create products with a texture and bite similar to meat. This process,...
summary.zh: 食品科学家正在开发创新的方法来加工植物性食材，如豌豆、豆类和扁豆。通过将这些原材料分解成其组成部分（蛋白质、淀粉、脂肪），然后重新组装，他们旨在创造出质地和口感与肉类相似的产品。然而，这个过程有时会导致膳食纤维、维生素和矿物质的流失，并可能产生需要用于食品行业以外的副产品。

body.en: Separating things and then putting them back together is a common principle in industrial food production. Agricultural raw materials are broken down into their individual constituents, such as proteins, starches and fats, and the food industry then reassembles these building blocks into specific products. In many cases, not all of the harvested crop ends up in the food we eat. In some instances, byproducts are formed that must be reused outside the food industry. These processing steps can also lead to the loss of dietary fibers, vitamins and minerals in the finished product.
body.zh: 将事物分开然后重新组合起来是工业食品生产中的常见原则。农业原材料被分解成各自的成分，如蛋白质、淀粉和脂肪，然后食品工业将这些组成部分重新组装成特定的产品。在许多情况下，并不是所有收获的作物最终都会成为我们吃的食物。在某些情况下，形成的副产品必须在食品工业之外重新使用。这些加工步骤还会导致成品中膳食纤维、维生素和矿物质的损失。

reflection.en: This innovation in food science showcases human ingenuity in transforming simple ingredients into novel products. It reminds us that even in the detailed, technical work of food processing, there is an opportunity to honor Yahweh. Colossians 3:23 encourages us to perform all tasks, whether complex or mundane, with diligence and excellence, as if working...
reflection.zh: 食品科学的这项创新展示了人类在将简单食材转化为新颖产品方面的智慧。它提醒我们，即使在食品加工的细致、技术性工作中，也有机会荣耀雅伟。歌罗西书3章23节鼓励我们，无论任务多么复杂或平凡，都要勤奋、卓越地完成，就好像是直接为祂工作一样。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Declining star formation not caused by simple 'fuel crisis,' new measurements suggest
title.zh: 新的测量表明，恒星形成率下降并非由简单的‘燃料危机’引起

summary.en: New measurements indicate that the universe's declining rate of star formation over the past 4.5 billion years, which has fallen to less than half its previous level, is not caused by a simple shortage of essential 'fuel.' This finding comes from an international team using China's Five-hundred-meter Aperture...
summary.zh: 新的测量表明，过去45亿年来宇宙恒星形成率的下降——已跌至过去的一半以下——并非由简单的‘燃料’短缺所致。这一发现来自一个国际团队，他们使用了中国的‘五百米口径球面射电望远镜’。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The universe has been having fewer and fewer stellar "babies." Over the past 4.5 billion years, the rate of star birth has crashed to less than half of what it once was. But here's the twist: the most essential "fuel" for making stars has barely decreased.

This finding comes from an international team led by researchers from the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS), in collaboration with the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) project. They used China's Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical radio Telescope (FAST) to make high-precision measurements of cosmic neutral atomic hydrogen over the past 4.5 billion years.

The study reveals that while cosmic star formation has declined dramatically over this period, neutral atomic hydrogen (HI)—a vital gas reservoir for galaxies—has decreased only slightly.

Why has it become harder for the universe to form new stars? That question has long been central to the study of galaxy formation and evolution. A natural explanation is that, as the universe ages, the cold gas that fuels star birth is steadily consumed, inevitably driving a decline in star formation. If that were true, however, the drop in the star formation rate should be matched by a simultaneous sharp depletion of the cold gas reservoir. But such depletion has not been detected.

HI is a key cold-gas reservoir in galaxies that links the large-scale cosmic gas cycle to internal star formation and is mainly detected via its extremely faint 21-centimeter radio emission line. Unfortunately, individual signals for distant galaxies are often swamped by background noise.

For this reason, astronomers long faced a frustrating dilemma: Deep observations could not cover large areas, while wide-field surveys lacked the sensitivity to detect faint signals. As a result, the evolution of total HI mass in the low-to-intermediate-redshift universe has remained difficult to measure directly and reliably.

To overcome this bottleneck, the new study integrated FAST's ultra-high radio sensitivity with DESI's massive optical spectroscopic survey. The researchers analyzed a vast sample of about 2.5 million galaxies, covering nearly one-third of the sky.

Using an innovative HI spectral stacking technique, they aligned and stacked the faint, otherwise undetectable radio signals based on precise galaxy redshifts. This allowed them to extract the average HI signal from the noise, tracing the evolution of cosmic neutral hydrogen with unprecedented statistical precision and sample size.

The precise measurements revealed a striking disparity: 4.5 billion years ago, the cosmic star formation...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 宇宙中的恒星“婴儿”越来越少。在过去的 45 亿年里，恒星诞生的速度已降至以前的一半以下。但这里有一个转折点：制造恒星最重要的“燃料”几乎没有减少。 这一发现来自于中国科学院（CAS）研究人员领导的国际团队与暗能量光谱仪器（DESI）项目的合作。他们利用中国的五百米口径球面射电望远镜（FAST）对过去45亿年的宇宙中性原子氢进行了高精度测量。 研究表明，虽然在此期间宇宙恒星的形成急剧减少，但中性原子氢（HI）（星系的重要气体储存库）仅略有减少。 为什么宇宙越来越难形成新的恒星？这个问题长期以来一直是星系形成和演化研究的核心。一个自然的解释是，随着宇宙的老化，为恒星诞生提供燃料的冷气体不断消耗，不可避免地导致恒星形成的减少。然而，如果这是真的，那么恒星形成率的下降应该与冷气体储层同时急剧消耗相匹配。但这种消耗尚未被发现。 HI 是星系中一个关键的冷气体库，它将大规模宇宙气体循环与内部恒星形成联系起来，主要通过其极其微弱的 21 厘米射电发射线来探测。不幸的是，遥远星系的单个信号经常被背景噪声淹没。 因此，天文学家长期以来面临着令人沮丧的困境：深层观测无法覆盖大面积，而广域观测又缺乏检测微弱信号的灵敏度。因此，低到中红移宇宙中总 HI 质量的演化仍然难以直接可靠地测量。 为了克服这一瓶颈，这项新研究将 FAST 的超高射电灵敏度与 DESI 的大规模光学光谱勘测相结合。研究人员分析了约 250 万个星系的庞大样本，覆盖了近三分之一的天空。 他们使用创新的 HI 光谱叠加技术，根据精确的星系红移来对齐和叠加微弱的、否则无法检测到的无线电信号。这使得他们能够从噪声中提取平均 HI 信号，以前所未有的统计精度和样本量追踪宇宙中性氢的演化。 精确的测量揭示了一个惊人的差异：45亿年前，宇宙恒星的形成......

reflection.en: The vastness of the cosmos and the intricate processes of star birth invite awe and wonder. As scientists use instruments like the Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical radio Telescope to probe these mysteries, we are reminded of the profound wisdom embedded in creation itself. May we approach such discoveries with humility, recognizing the Creator behind...
reflection.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚和恒星诞生的复杂过程引人入胜。当科学家们使用‘五百米口径球面射电望远镜’等仪器来探索这些奥秘时，我们被提醒，在造物本身中蕴含着深刻的智慧。愿我们以谦卑的心态来面对这些发现，认识到万物背后的创造者。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Researchers catch sharks off NY's Hamptons, attach trackers to toothy predators
title.zh: 研究人员在纽约汉普顿附近捕获鲨鱼，并为其装上追踪器

summary.en: Shark researcher Greg Metzger and his team caught and tagged sand tiger sharks off the coast of New York's Hamptons, collecting tissue samples and attaching data trackers to study the predators.
summary.zh: 鲨鱼研究员格雷格·梅茨格和他的团队在纽约汉普顿海岸附近捕获并标记了沙虎鲨，收集了组织样本并安装了数据追踪器以研究这些捕食者。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Just off one of New York's famed Hamptons beaches, shark researcher Greg Metzger reels in one of the day's prize catches: a young but powerful sand tiger shark.

He and another marine researcher quickly lasso the tail of the sharp-toothed female to the side of the boat and hold it steady as they take tissue samples and work to attach small data collection devices. Metzger marvels as the shark's thick, rugged skin snaps a surgical-grade scalpel.

"It's no surprise that they've been around since prehistoric times and they're still going strong," Metzger says as he stitches up the incision and sends it along its way.

Metzger and other researchers are catching, tagging and releasing a wide range of sharks as they seek to understand the local population and shed more light on one of the world's few confirmed great white shark nurseries , where masses of young predators spend their first vulnerable years feeding and growing. Other white shark nurseries recognized globally are in the coastal waters off California, Mexico and Australia.

"It's that initial fear of sharks that captures people's imagination," said Metzger, who also teaches marine science at Southampton High School. "Hopefully, through educational opportunities like today, we'll be able to show that these sharks are far from mindless eating machines."

The researchers attach different types of tags. One relays location by sending an acoustic signal that can be detected by monitoring receivers set up along the coast. Another measures depth and water temperature for several months, then pops off.

The data illustrates how sharks can cover vast distances in a year, said Bradley Peterson, the Stony Brook University marine scientist working with Metzger this particular day.

"Their tags are being detected in North Carolina and Georgia and Florida and the Gulf of Mexico, and then they'll be back here the following year," he said. "So a lot of them are coming up here to get themselves fueled up and fattened up."

The research also suggests more varied species of sharks are coming up from more tropical southern waters during the summer months, as the waters off Long Island's coast and elsewhere are warming, likely due to climate change, said Frank Quevedo, executive director at the South Fork Natural History Museum and Nature Center, which is coordinating the research.

"We're seeing more spinner sharks, more black tip sharks, more bull sharks," he said as he showed off the Bridgehampton museum's interactive exhibit on the work. "These are temperate sharks that utilize this habitat when the food source is here. So right...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 就在纽约著名的汉普顿海滩附近，鲨鱼研究员格雷格·梅茨格钓到了当天的战利品之一：一条年轻但力量强大的沙虎鲨。 他和另一位海洋研究人员迅速将尖齿雌性的尾巴套在船边并保持稳定，同时采集组织样本并安装小型数据收集设备。梅茨格惊讶地发现鲨鱼厚实、崎岖的皮肤能折断外科手术刀。 “毫不奇怪，它们从史前时代就已经存在，而且仍然很强大，”梅茨格一边说，一边缝合切口并将其沿途送去。 梅茨格和其他研究人员正在捕捉、标记和释放各种鲨鱼，以期了解当地种群，并更多地了解世界上为数不多的已确认的大白鲨保育场之一，大量年轻的捕食者在那里度过了他们最初脆弱的岁月，在那里进食和生长。全球公认的其他白鲨繁殖地位于加利福尼亚州、墨西哥和澳大利亚的沿海水域。 “正是对鲨鱼最初的恐惧激发了人们的想象力，”梅茨格说，他也在南安普敦高中教授海洋科学。 “希望通过像今天这样的教育机会，我们能够证明这些鲨鱼远非无意识的进食机器。” 研究人员附加了不同类型的标签。一种通过发送声音信号来中继位置，该信号可以通过沿海岸设置的监控接收器检测到。另一个测量深度和水温几个月，然后弹出。 与梅茨格一起工作的石溪大学海洋科学家布拉德利·彼得森说，这些数据说明了鲨鱼如何在一年内完成很长的距离。 “他们的标签在北卡罗来纳州、佐治亚州、佛罗里达州和墨西哥湾被检测到，然后他们将在明年回到这里，”他说。 “所以他们中的很多人来这里是为了给自己补充能量并增肥。” 负责协调这项研究的南福克自然历史博物馆和自然中心执行主任弗兰克·奎维多(Frank Quevedo)表示，这项研究还表明，夏季月份，由于长岛海岸和其他地方的水域正在变暖，可能是由于气候变化，更多种类的鲨鱼从更热带的南部水域中出现。 “我们看到了更多的飞旋鲨、更多的黑鳍鲨、更多的牛鲨，”他在展示布里奇汉普顿博物馆的互动展览时说道。 “这些是温带鲨鱼，当食物来源在这里时，它们就会利用这个栖息地。所以对......

reflection.en: The vastness and complexity of the ocean, teeming with creatures like the sand tiger shark, reveal the intricate wisdom of its Creator. As researchers like Greg Metzger study these animals, they uncover more of the marvels Yahweh has put in place, reminding us that creation itself is a source of profound knowledge and wonder.
reflection.zh: 海洋的浩瀚与复杂，以及像沙虎鲨这样的生物，都彰显了其创造者精妙的智慧。像格雷格·梅茨格这样的研究人员在研究这些动物时，揭示了雅伟所设定的更多奇迹，提醒我们，创造本身就是深刻知识和奇迹的源泉。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Eruption of Sinabung volcano on Indonesia's Sumatra island prompts higher alert
title.zh: 印尼锡纳朋火山喷发，提高警戒级别

summary.en: Mount Sinabung on Indonesia erupted Monday, spewing a column of black ash and smoke 3,500 meters (11,482 feet) into the sky over Sumatra island. While no casualties were immediately reported, residents and tourists were advised to stay clear of nearby villages and areas within 6 kilometers of the summit.
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚的锡纳朋火山于周一爆发，喷出高达3500米（11482英尺）的黑色火山灰和烟柱升入苏门答腊岛上空。虽然没有立即伤亡报告，但建议附近村庄的居民、游客以及距离火山口6公里范围内的区域人员保持警惕。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Mount Sinabung on Indonesia erupted Monday, spewing a column of black ash and smoke 3,500 meters (11,482 feet) from the top of the mountain into the sky over Sumatra island.

There were no immediate reports of casualties, evacuations or disruptions to flights in the region. But residents, visitors and tourists were advised to refrain from activities in nearby villages in Karo district in North Sumatra province and areas within 6 kilometers (3.7 miles) of the summit.

Roads, vehicles and buildings in several villages in Karo affected by the eruption were covered in gray ash. Local authorities distributed masks to residents to protect themselves.

Officials raised the volcano alert level to "Watch," the second-highest level for volcanic activity, which expanded the safe zone around the 2,600-meter (8,530-foot) mountain.

"This eruption is considered an initial eruption, and it is possible that a larger eruption could occur," Lana Saria, chief of Indonesia's Geological Agency, said in a statement Monday.

The agency previously recorded visual evidence of Mount Sinabung's increased activity in mid-August including dozens of earthquakes and expanded the recommended radius for public activities.

About 30,000 people have been forced to leave their homes around Sinabung in the past few years because of volcanic activity.

Indonesia is an archipelago of more than 280 million people with frequent seismic activity and Sinabung is among more than 120 active volcanoes. The country is prone to seismic upheaval due to its location on the Pacific "Ring of Fire," an arc of volcanoes and fault lines encircling the Pacific Basin.
