body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 印度尼西亚锡纳朋火山周一喷发，从山顶向苏门答腊岛上空 3,500 米（11,482 英尺）喷出一股黑色火山灰和烟雾。 目前还没有关于该地区人员伤亡、疏散或航班中断的报道。但建议居民、游客和游客不要在北苏门答腊省卡罗区附近的村庄以及距离山顶6公里（3.7英里）以内的地区进行活动。 受火山喷发影响的卡罗几个村庄的道路、车辆和建筑物都被灰色火山灰覆盖。当地政府向居民分发了口罩以保护自己。 官员们将火山警报级别提升至“观察”，这是火山活动的第二高级别，从而扩大了这座2,600米（8,530英尺）高山周围的安全区。 印度尼西亚地质局局长拉娜·萨里亚周一在一份声明中表示：“这次喷发被认为是初次喷发，可能会发生更大规模的喷发。” 该机构此前记录了锡纳朋山八月中旬活动增加的视觉证据，包括数十次地震，并扩大了公共活动的建议半径。 过去几年，由于火山活动，锡纳朋周围约有 3 万人被迫离开家园。 印度尼西亚是一个拥有超过 2.8 亿人口的群岛国家，地震活动频繁，锡纳朋火山是 120 多座活火山之一。由于位于太平洋“火环”（环绕太平洋盆地的弧形火山和断层线），该国很容易发生地震剧变。 物理学硕士，具有研究经验。长期科学新闻爱好者。在 Science X 的编辑成功中发挥着关键作用。完整档案 → © 2026 美联社。版权所有。未经许可，不得出版、广播、重写或重新分发本材料。

reflection.en: The eruption of Mount Sinabung serves as a stark reminder of the immense power of natural forces. In the face of such events, which can disrupt lives and raise alarms, we are called to remember that God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in times of trouble. This truth offers solace and stability when the earth itself seems to tremble.
reflection.zh: 锡纳朋火山的喷发，提醒我们大自然拥有何等强大的力量。面对可能扰乱生活并拉响警报的事件，我们被呼召铭记，在患难中，神是我们的避难所和力量，是随时可得的帮助。当大地似乎都在震动时，这一真理能带来安慰和稳固。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Family fear for missing hydropower worker after Nepal flood
title.zh: 家人为尼泊尔洪水失踪的水电站工人感到担忧

summary.en: Jit Bahadur Chaudhary was working at the hydropower site when the flood hit on Wednesday. A woman in Wales is awaiting news of a family member in Nepal who is missing following a massive flash flood last week. Chaudhary, who is considered family by the woman, was working at the Trishuli 3B site in Bagmati Province...
summary.zh: Jit Bahadur Chaudhary 周三洪水来袭时正在水电站工作。一位在威尔士的女士正在焦急等待关于她尼泊尔失踪的亲人的消息，此前上周发生了一场巨大的洪水。Chaudhary 被这位女士视为家人，事发时正在巴格马蒂省的 Trishuli 3B 工地工作。截至周一上午，尼泊尔各地水电站已有 933 名工人失踪。

body.en:
A woman in Wales says she has "lost hope" as she awaits news of a family member in Nepal who is missing following the massive flash flood last week .

Jyoti Upadhyay, who is from Nepal but has lived in Tal-y-bont in Ceredigion for the past five years, said she and her husband had not been able to find out anything about the whereabouts of hydropower station worker Jit Bahadur Chaudhary.

Chaudhary, who is not a blood relation but is considered family by Upadhyay as he has lived with her mother-in-law for the past 25 years, was working at the Trishuli 3B site in the Bagmati Province.

On Monday morning, 933 hydropower workers from sites across Nepal were missing - in total, 4,247 people were unaccounted for, with at least 903 known to have died.

"Since Wednesday, life has been upended," Upadhyay told BBC Radio Wales Breakfast on Tuesday.

"For the first few days, we were we were waiting very hopefully for some information. There was some hope that he would somehow have walked up to higher ground and would have made the long trek, sort of the 60-mile trek home.

Authorities said rescue efforts had been largely focussed on the Trishuli 3A and 3B sites - hydropower projects with tunnels.

Nepali authorities are blasting into hillsides to try and reach those trapped, with a controlled blast carried out at the Trishuli site in an attempt to open up access in the early hours of Monday.

"It has been extremely difficult to reach the site. What we understand is that all the buildings are under meters of mud and it has been impossible to search for anyone there," Upadhyay told BBC Radio Cymru's Bwrw Golwg programme on Sunday.

"Within 20 minutes the connections were all down. The phone signals have not been working and that is why it has been so difficult to hear anything.

"It took about three days for us to get any information. We have been looking at the news, trying local contacts and trying to see what the army and the police have been doing."

She continued: "We know that the only way to reach the site is by helicopter. You need special skills to be able to drive a helicopter in that area. It is an extremely difficult place. We have been waiting for special machines to be able to work through the mud.

"There is some good news from other stations along the river as some people were able to hide in tunnels within the hydropower stations .

"There's not a lot of hope for that particular site - but we don't know until someone can get in. At the moment everything is under mud."

Upadhyay said there were about 14 hydropower stations along the river valley, and Chaudhary was a driver.

Though he was on site at the time, Upadhyay said it was unlikely he would have been deep in the tunnel network.

"So our expectation is that the first wave came and he was...
body.zh: 威尔士的一名妇女表示，她在等待尼泊尔一名家人的消息时“失去了希望”，这名家人在上周的大规模山洪爆发后失踪。 来自尼泊尔的乔蒂·乌帕德耶 (Jyoti Upadhyay) 过去五年一直住在锡尔迪金 (Ceredigion) 的塔尔邦特 (Tal-y-bont)，她表示，她和丈夫一直无法找到水电站工人吉特·巴哈杜尔·乔杜里 (Jit Bahadur Chaudhary) 的下落。 Chaudhary 与她的婆婆没有血缘关系，但被 Upadhyay 视为家人，因为他在过去 25 年里一直与她的婆婆住在一起。乔杜里当时在巴格马蒂省的 Trishuli 3B 工地工作。 周一上午，尼泊尔各地 933 名水电工人失踪，总共 4,247 人下落不明，其中至少 903 人死亡。 “自周三以来，生活发生了翻天覆地的变化，”乌帕德耶周二告诉英国广播公司威尔士广播电台早餐。 “最初几天，我们满怀希望地等待一些信息。我们希望他能以某种方式走到地势较高的地方，并完成长途跋涉，相当于 60 英里的长途跋涉回家。 当局表示，救援工作主要集中在Trishuli 3A和3B工地——带有隧道的水电项目。 尼泊尔当局正在山坡上进行爆破，试图救出被困人员，并在特里苏里现场进行了一次受控爆破，试图在周一凌晨打开通道。 “到达现场非常困难。据我们所知，所有建筑物都在数米深的泥浆下，不可能在那里搜寻任何人。”乌帕德耶周日告诉 BBC 电台 Cymru 的 Bwrw Golwg 节目。 “20 分钟内，所有连接都中断了。电话信号一直不好，这就是为什么很难听到任何声音的原因。 “我们花了大约三天的时间才得到任何信息。我​​们一直在查看新闻，尝试与当地联系，并试图了解军队和警察在做什么。” 她继续说道：“我们知道到达现场的唯一方法是乘坐直升机。你需要特殊的技能才能在该地区驾驶直升机。这是一个极其困难的地方。我们一直在等待能够在泥浆中作业的特殊机器。 “沿河其他水电站也传来了一些好消息，一些人能够躲进水电站内的隧道里。 “对于那个特定地点没有太多希望 - 但我们不知道直到有人可以进入。目前一切都在泥浆中。” Upadhyay说，沿河谷大约有14个水电站，乔杜里是一名司机。 尽管乌帕迪亚当时就在现场，但他不太可能深入隧道网络。 “所以我们的期望是第一波浪潮到来，他......

reflection.en: The news from Nepal paints a stark picture of devastation and uncertainty, with families like Jyoti Upadhyay's desperately seeking information about loved ones caught in the flash flood. In times of such crisis, the ancient call to action resonates: 'Share your food with the hungry and provide shelter for the displaced.' This is a practical expression of...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔传来的消息描绘了一幅严峻的毁灭和不确定景象，像 Jyoti Upadhyay 一样的家庭迫切地寻求关于亲人在洪水中的消息。在这样的危机时刻，古老的行动呼吁产生了共鸣：“要将你的食物分给饥饿的人，要将无家可归的人领进你的家。” 这是实际的怜悯，为那些面对难以想象的损失和流离失所的人们提供切实的安慰和希望。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: How catastrophic flash flood unfolded at remote Nepal-China border point
title.zh: 喜马拉雅山脉偏远尼泊尔-中国边境口岸灾难性山洪暴发的经过

summary.en: More than 100 Indians are missing at a vital Nepal-China trade crossing after devastating Himalayan floods.
summary.zh: 在喜马拉雅山毁灭性的洪水之后，一个重要的尼泊尔-中国贸易过境点有超过100名印度人失踪。

body.en:
A dark wall appears from behind the buildings at Gyirong, on the Chinese side of the Nepal-Tibet border. At first, it looks almost like a black cloud. Then it gathers shape and speed: water, mud, boulders, ice and rock surging down the valley. The timestamp on the CCTV footage reads 10:59:53 local time.

What happened in the minutes that followed is still difficult to reconstruct. But fragments of video and satellite imagery from before and after the disaster have begun to reveal the scale of the destruction. Much of the border complex appears to have been swept away, with buildings that once crowded the valley floor simply gone.

Gyirong was one of the places devastated by the floods that tore through the region on 26 August.

Just across the frontier, at Rasuwagadhi in Nepal's Rasuwa district, the destruction was also extensive. The Friendship Bridge linking Nepal and China was swept away, along with Nepal's immigration and customs facilities. Timure, the small trading settlement clustered around the crossing, was devastated.

"This is a historic travel route between Kathmandu and Tibet. The area is geologically vulnerable, characterised by deep gorges and steep rivers that flow at high velocity, carry heavy sediment and can bring down huge boulders," says Ajay Dixit, a Kathmandu-based hydrologist.

The route remains an important gateway between Nepal and China. It is a place where pilgrims heading towards Mount Kailash cross paths with traders travelling between Nepal and China, truck drivers, customs officials, tourists and people who live along the border.

On the morning of the flood, more than 100 Indians may have been in or around the crossing. At least 275 Indians remain missing in Nepal, according to India's foreign ministry.

Nepal's Department of Immigration has been trying to reconstruct who passed through Rasuwagadhi in the final hours before the disaster.

Electronic records show that 89 Nepali and foreign nationals had cleared immigration to leave Nepal for Tibet, while four people had registered their entry into Nepal.

The immigration system recorded its final transaction at 8:35:03am local time (10:52am Tibet time), less than 10 minutes before the torrent appeared on the CCTV footage at Gyirong.

Four immigration employees, including the head of the Rasuwagadhi office, went missing in the floods. His body was later recovered far downstream. The female official who recorded the final transactions is still missing.

Among the foreign nationals recorded leaving Nepal that morning were 32 Indians, 12 Chinese nationals and nine Americans, as well as citizens of Britain, Canada, Australia and Italy.

Tika Ram Pokharel, a senior immigration assistant at Rasuwagadhi, was the only member of his office known to have survived. He had...
body.zh: 吉隆位于尼泊尔和西藏边境的中国一侧，建筑物后面出现了一堵黑墙。起初，它看起来几乎像一朵乌云。然后它的形状和速度都聚集起来：水、泥土、巨石、冰和岩石沿着山谷汹涌而下。闭路电视录像上的时间戳显示当地时间 10:59:53。 接下来几分钟发生的事情仍然很难重现。但灾难前后的视频和卫星图像片段已经开始揭示破坏的规模。边境建筑群的大部分似乎已被冲走，曾经拥挤在谷底的建筑物完全消失了。 吉隆是8月26日席卷该地区的洪水所摧毁的地方之一。 就在边境另一边，尼泊尔拉苏瓦地区的拉苏瓦加迪也遭受了广泛破坏。连接尼泊尔和中国的友谊大桥以及尼泊尔的移民和海关设施被冲毁。蒂穆尔（Timure）是一个聚集在过境点周围的小型贸易定居点，遭到了破坏。 加德满都水文学家阿贾伊·迪克西特 (Ajay Dixit) 表示：“这是加德满都和西藏之间的一条历史悠久的旅行路线。该地区地质脆弱，其特点是峡谷深邃，河流陡峭，流速快，携带大量沉积物，可能会冲落巨大的巨石。” 这条路线仍然是尼泊尔和中国之间的重要门户。在这里，前往冈仁波齐峰的朝圣者与往返于尼泊尔和中国之间的商人、卡车司机、海关官员、游客和边境居民相遇。 洪水发生当天早上，过境点内或周围可能有 100 多名印第安人。据印度外交部称，至少有 275 名印度人在尼泊尔失踪。 尼泊尔移民局一直在努力重建灾难发生前最后几个小时内经过拉苏瓦加迪的人员情况。 电子记录显示，89名尼泊尔人和外国人已办理离开尼泊尔前往西藏的出入境手续，另有4人已登记进入尼泊尔。 出入境系统在当地时间上午 8:35:03（西藏时间上午 10:52）记录了最终交易，距离吉隆闭路电视录像中出现洪流不到 10 分钟。 包括拉苏瓦加迪办公室负责人在内的四名移民雇员在洪水中失踪。他的尸体后来在下游很远的地方被发现。记录最终交易的女官员仍然下落不明。 当天早上离开尼泊尔的外国人中有 32 名印度人、12 名中国人和 9 名美国人，以及英国、加拿大、澳大利亚和意大利公民。 拉苏瓦加迪 (Rasuwagadhi) 的高级移民助理蒂卡·拉姆·波卡雷尔 (Tika Ram Pokharel) 是其办公室中唯一已知幸存的成员。他有...

reflection.en: The news from Nepal describes a "dark wall" of water, mud, and debris surging down the valley, a stark image of nature's destructive power. The Bible speaks of all creation groaning, awaiting its redemption from decay and ruin. This event, like so many natural disasters, is a painful reminder of our world's fragility and the deep impact of the fall on the...
reflection.zh: 来自尼泊尔的新闻描述了“一道黑色的墙”——水、泥和瓦砾——汹涌而下，这是大自然毁灭力量的鲜明写照。《圣经》提到，万物都在一同叹息，劳苦直到如今，等待着脱离败坏的辖制。这次事件，以及许多其他自然灾害，都痛苦地提醒我们这个世界的脆弱，以及堕落对自然秩序造成的深刻影响。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Heathland plan to support two rare species of ant
title.zh: 计划支持两种稀有蚂蚁的生境

summary.en: Devon Wildlife Trust is undertaking a three-year project, funded by the government, to improve the heathland habitats of the narrow-headed ant and the erratic ant, and to establish new colonies for these rare species.
summary.zh: 德文野生动物信托基金正在进行一项为期三年的政府资助项目，以改善狭头蚁和游蚁的石楠地生境，并为这些稀有物种建立新的栖息地。

body.en:
Two of the UK's rarest ant species are being supported by a new conservation project.

Chiefs at Devon Wildlife Trust said they plan to improve the heathland homes of both the narrow-headed and erratic ants, and start new colonies at suitable nearby sites.

The only English population of the narrow-headed ant lives in the trust's Chudleigh Knighton Heath nature reserve and the nationally scarce erratic ant was recently discovered at the charity's Bovey Heathfield nature reserve.

The three-year project by the wildlife trust and invertebrate conservation charity Buglife has been funded with £212,000 from the government's wildlife restoration campaign.

Buglife conservation officer Laura Krusin said: "The narrow-headed ant is only found at one site in England and the erratic ant is also nationally scarce, putting these species' survival at risk."

She said both species had seen declines in their numbers over the last 150 years, mostly because of the loss of their heathland homes.

Chris Moulton, of the Devon Wildlife Trust, said the first step would be to improve the heathland habitat in the nature reserves to secure the existing ant colonies.

He said the target was to double the number of narrow-headed ant nests from 200 to more than 400 at Chudleigh Knighton Heath.

Other heathland reserves, including those at Ideford Common and Teigngrace Meadow, would become home to both species, he added.

Krusin said the narrow-headed ant, a wood ant, was named for the "pinched-look" of its head and was also found at a few sites in Scotland .

The erratic ant was named for its "high-energy foraging behaviour which sees it scamper with meandering and unpredictable movements", she added.

Follow BBC Devon on X , external , Facebook , external and Instagram , external . Send your story ideas to spotlight@bbc.co.uk , external .
body.zh: 英国最稀有的两种蚂蚁物种正在得到一个新的保护项目的支持。 德文郡野生动物信托基金的负责人表示，他们计划改善窄头蚂蚁和古怪蚂蚁的石南栖息地，并在附近合适的地点建立新的栖息地。 英国唯一的窄头蚂蚁种群生活在该信托基金的查德利奈顿希思自然保护区，而这种全国稀有的不稳定蚂蚁最近在该慈善机构的博维希思菲尔德自然保护区被发现。 这个为期三年的项目由野生动物信托和无脊椎动物保护慈善机构 Buglife 发起，已获得政府野生动物恢复活动的 212,000 英镑资助。 Buglife 保护官员劳拉·克鲁辛 (Laura Krusin) 表示：“窄头蚂蚁仅在英格兰的一处地方发现，而且这种古怪的蚂蚁在全国范围内也很稀有，这使这些物种的生存面临风险。” 她说，在过去 150 年里，这两个物种的数量都在下降，主要是因为失去了它们的石南家园。 德文郡野生动物信托基金的克里斯·莫尔顿表示，第一步是改善自然保护区的石南地栖息地，以保护现有的蚁群。 他说，目标是将查德利·奈顿希思 (Chudleigh Knighton Heath) 的窄头蚁巢数量从 200 个增加到 400 多个。 他补充说，其他石南荒地保护区，包括艾德福德公地 (Ideford Common) 和泰恩格雷斯草甸 (Teigngrace Meadow) 的石南地保护区，都将成为这两个物种的家园。 克鲁辛说，这种窄头蚂蚁是一种木蚁，因其头部“捏紧的样子”而得名，在苏格兰的一些地方也发现了这种蚂蚁。 她补充说，这种飘忽不定的蚂蚁因其“高能量的觅食行为而得名，它会以蜿蜒和不可预测的动作奔跑”。 在 X, external、Facebook, external 和 Instagram, external 上关注 BBC Devon。将您的故事创意发送至外部聚光灯@bbc.co.uk。

reflection.en: The intricate lives of the narrow-headed and erratic ants, now the focus of a conservation project in Devon, remind us of the profound wisdom woven into the fabric of creation. Yahweh's world teems with diverse life, each species a testament to His intricate design and the flourishing of His handiwork.
reflection.zh: 狭头蚁和游蚁的复杂生命，如今成为德文郡一项保护项目的焦点，这提醒我们创造中蕴含的深刻智慧。雅伟的世界充满了多样的生命，每一个物种都证明了他精妙的设计和他手工作的繁荣。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: New storm names for 2026-2027 released by Met Office
title.zh: 气象局发布2026-2027年新风暴名称

summary.en: The UK storm season begins on September 1st, and the Met Office has released a new list of storm names for the 2026-2027 season, including Austen, Chloe, and Evelyn, chosen by the public. Storms are named when they are forecast to cause medium to high impacts.
summary.zh: 英国的风暴季于9月1日开始，气象局发布了2026-2027年风暴季的新名称列表，其中包括公众选出的奥斯汀（Austen）、克洛伊（Chloe）和伊芙琳（Evelyn）。当风暴预计会造成中度至高度影响时，便会被命名。

body.en:
The first of September marks the start of meteorological autumn, and with it the start of the UK's storm season.

In preparation for potential stormy spells, the Met Office has released a new list of names for the 2026-2027 season which have been chosen by members of the public.

This year, expect to hear the names Austen, Boelo and Chloe, which are the first three on the alphabetical list, followed by Dano and Evelyn.

Storms are named by the UK Met Office, Ireland's Met Éireann or the Netherlands' KNMI when they are forecast to cause "medium" or "high" impacts.

In the UK, storms are named when they are likely to cause disruption or damage that could lead to an amber or red warning being issued.

This decision is based on both the potential impact of the weather and how likely it is to occur.

Names are typically given to storms where impacts from strong winds are expected, although other weather-related effects are also taken into account such as heavy rainfall or snow which may lead to flooding or travel disruption.

Using one official system to name storms helps to share clear and consistent information about severe weather, making it easier for the public to stay safe.

Storm names are selected jointly by the Met Office, Met Éireann and KNMI, with the final list aiming to reflect communities across the UK, Ireland and the Netherlands.

In 2025 the three meteorology agencies invited nominations for names from the public.

More than 40,000 were submitted - we saw names such as Amy, Isla and Marty selected for the 2025/2026 storm season.

This year's list continues to draw on those suggestions, reflecting not only popular choices, but also some of the personal stories behind them.

For example Austen was suggested in honour of Austen Nagle, the first director of the Irish Meteorological Service.

Chloe was selected by the Met Office after being nominated more than 130 times, including once by the mother of a five-year-old who is described by her mum as "fascinated by the weather" but can also "create a storm by herself" when she is tired.

And Ivy was nominated in honour of a nine-month-old Labrador puppy affectionately known as "the absolute destructor".

Any remnant of a tropical storm or hurricane that crosses the Atlantic will keep its original name, for example ex-Hurricane Erin, which brought a large swell to South West England in August 2025 and was named 'Storm Erin'.

To ensure consistency with the US National Hurricane Centre naming conventions, names that begin with the letters Q, U, X, Y and Z are not used.

In Europe, there are five storm naming groups created from the meteorological agencies based in a similar geographic location.

In the UK, storms are named when they are likely to cause disruption or damage that could lead to an...
body.zh: 九月一日标志着气象秋季的开始，英国风暴季节也随之开始。 为了应对可能出现的暴风雨天气，英国气象局发布了一份由公众选出的 2026-2027 年季节的新名单。 今年，预计会听到 Austen、Boelo 和 Chloe 的名字，它们是按字母顺序排列的前三个名字，其次是 Dano 和 Evelyn。 当风暴预计会造成“中度”或“高度”影响时，英国气象局、爱尔兰气象局或荷兰 KNMI 都会对风暴进行命名。 在英国，当风暴可能造成破坏或损害并可能导致发布黄色或红色警告时，就会对风暴进行命名。 该决定基于天气的潜在影响及其发生的可能性。 通常为预计会受到强风影响的风暴命名，尽管也考虑了其他与天气相关的影响，例如可能导致洪水或旅行中断的暴雨或降雪。 使用一个官方系统来命名风暴有助于分享有关恶劣天气的清晰一致的信息，使公众更容易保持安全。 风暴名称由英国气象局、爱尔兰气象局和 KNMI 联合选出，最终名单旨在反映英国、爱尔兰和荷兰的社区。 2025年，三个气象机构邀请公众提名提名。 提交的申请超过 40,000 份 - 我们看到 Amy、Isla 和 Marty 等名字被选为 2025/2026 风暴季节。 今年的榜单继续借鉴这些建议，不仅反映了流行的选择，还反映了它们背后的一些个人故事。 例如，奥斯汀是为了纪念爱尔兰气象局首任局长奥斯汀·内格尔而提出的。 克洛伊 (Chloe) 在获得 130 多次提名后被英国气象局选中，其中一次是由一名 5 岁孩子的母亲提名，她的妈妈形容她“对天气着迷”，但在疲倦时也能“自己制造一场风暴”。 艾维的提名是为了纪念一只九个月大的拉布拉多小狗，它被亲切地称为“绝对破坏者”。 任何穿越大西洋的热带风暴或飓风的残余物都将保留其原始名称，例如前飓风艾琳，它于 2025 年 8 月给英格兰西南部带来了巨大的海浪，并被命名为“风暴艾琳”。 为了确保与美国国家飓风中心命名约定的一致性，不使用以字母 Q、U、X、Y 和 Z 开头的名称。 在欧洲，位于相似地理位置的气象机构创建了五个风暴命名组。 在英国，当风暴可能造成破坏或损害并可能导致……时，风暴就会被命名。

reflection.en: The Met Office's naming of storms, like Austen and Evelyn, reflects humanity's attempt to understand and categorize the powerful forces of nature. This endeavor echoes the Psalmist's awe at the vastness and intricate design of creation, recognizing that all of it is filled with Yahweh's wisdom.
reflection.zh: 英国气象局为风暴命名，如奥斯汀和伊芙琳，反映了人类试图理解和分类自然界强大力量的努力。这项工作呼应了诗篇作者对造物浩瀚和精妙设计的敬畏之情，认识到这一切都充满了雅伟的智慧。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Clicks, grunts and squeals: the wonders of whale communication – podcast
title.zh: 咔哒声、咕哝声和尖叫声：鲸鱼交流的奇迹——播客

summary.en: Since the earliest recording of whale song in 1949, scientists have been fascinated by their complex vocalizations. Advances in technology are enabling researchers to decode these intricate patterns, which could lead to better whale protection from human-caused threats.
summary.zh: 自1949年首次录制鲸鱼歌声以来，科学家们一直被它们复杂的发声方式所吸引。技术的进步使研究人员能够解码这些复杂的模式，这可能有助于更好地保护鲸鱼免受人类的威胁。

body.en: Ever since the earliest known recording of whale song was made in 1949 , researchers have been captivated by the wails, rumbles, clicks, grunts and squeals of their communication. As technology improves, scientists are decoding the intricate patterns that make different species’ vocalisations distinctive. Madeleine Finlay hears from Emma Bryce, a journalist who has spent months investigating human efforts to understand whale song. She explains how this knowledge could help us better protect whales from human-made harms. Credits: 1. Copyright 1978 National Geographic Society and 1977 Capitol Records, Inc. reflection.en: The deep sea holds mysteries, and for decades, humans have strained to understand the complex language of whales. As technology allows us to decipher their clicks and songs, we gain not only knowledge but also a deeper appreciation for the intricate life Yahweh has woven into creation. This pursuit of understanding reminds us that wisdom is often found by...
reflection.zh: 深海充满了奥秘，几十年来，人类一直努力理解鲸鱼复杂的语言。随着技术使我们能够破译它们的咔哒声和歌声，我们不仅获得了知识，还对雅伟编织到造物中的复杂生命有了更深的欣赏。这种理解的追求提醒我们，智慧往往是通过观察我们周围的世界来获得的，而这个世界充满了雅伟多样的艺术。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Higher cutting could reduce annual bluegrass contamination in tall fescue seed
title.zh: 更高的收割高度可能减少多年生黑麦草种子中的一年生黑麦草污染

summary.en: Harvesting tall fescue above annual bluegrass seed heads could help reduce contamination and seed-cleaning costs. Preliminary Oregon research found that cutting at 28 centimeters (11 inches) rather than 5 centimeters (2 inches) reduced annual bluegrass collected with the crop without consistently reducing tall fescue...
summary.zh: 在多年生黑麦草种子中，将收割高度提高到一年生黑麦草的种子头之上，可能有助于减少污染并降低种子清理成本。俄勒冈州的一项初步研究发现，在28厘米（11英寸）的高度收割，而不是在5厘米（2英寸）的高度收割，可以减少与作物一同收集到的一年生黑麦草，同时并未持续降低多年生黑麦草的种子产量。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Harvesting tall fescue above annual bluegrass seed heads could help reduce contamination and seed-cleaning costs. Preliminary Oregon research found that cutting at 28 centimeters (11 inches) rather than 5 centimeters (2 inches) reduced annual bluegrass collected with the crop without consistently reducing tall fescue seed yield.

Annual bluegrass is difficult to remove from grass seed crops and can remain despite careful establishment, herbicide use and hand roguing. However, most annual bluegrass seed heads sit below tall fescue panicles at harvest. Trials in 2024 and 2025 tested whether this height difference could be used to leave annual bluegrass seed in the field. Researchers compared:

Annual bluegrass was absent from the 2024 trial, but 2025 results showed less contamination when the crop was harvested at 28 centimeters (11 inches) rather than 5 centimeters (2 inches). This suggests higher cutting could complement existing weed management and reduce the burden on seed cleaning. Its effectiveness is likely to depend on crop lodging and the height of annual bluegrass plants, which can reach 40.6 centimeters (16 inches).

Tall fescue yield was not reduced when swathing occurred at 27% rather than 43% seed moisture in 2024. Cutting with a combine at 28 centimeters (11 inches) and 27% moisture produced more seed than conventional swathing at 5 centimeters (2 inches) and 43% moisture.

Results from the low-yielding 2025 crop were also broadly encouraging. However, using the swather at 28 centimeters (11 inches) reduced yield as seed moisture declined, possibly because higher reel speed increased seed shattering.

These findings show that machinery settings will be critical. Further work is needed to refine cutting height, reel speed, harvest timing and direct-combining practices.

Hannah Rivedal, Todd N Temple, Robert J Starchvick, Joseph P Gallagher, Dustin W Herb, Jason Crisp, Nicole Anderson, Tatiana Benedetti and Amy B Peetz, Sustainable management strategies for the seed gall nematode (Anguina funesta) parasitizing annual ryegrass (Lolium multiflorum) seed in Oregon (2025), IHSG proceedings and abstracts. ihsg.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/IHSG-2025.pdf

Swati Mestri holds a bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering and has worked as a content editor since 2019. She has experience editing research documents across technology, health care, and materials science, and has a particular interest in technology and space. Full profile →

Master's in physics with research experience. Long-time science news enthusiast. Plays key role in Science X's editorial...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 收获一年生早熟禾种子头上方的高羊茅有助于减少污染和种子清洁成本。俄勒冈州的初步研究发现，以 28 厘米（11 英寸）而不是 5 厘米（2 英寸）的高度进行切割会减少随作物收集的一年生早熟禾的数量，但不会持续降低高羊茅种子的产量。 一年生早熟禾很难从草种作物中去除，尽管精心种植、使用除草剂和手工除草，但仍可能残留。然而，大多数一年生早熟禾种子头在收获时位于高羊茅圆锥花序下方。 2024 年和 2025 年的试验测试了是否可以利用这种高度差将一年生早熟禾种子留在田间。研究人员比较： 2024 年的试验中没有使用一年生早熟禾，但 2025 年的结果显示，当作物收获高度为 28 厘米（11 英寸）而不是 5 厘米（2 英寸）时，污染较少。这表明更高的修剪量可以补充现有的杂草管理并减轻种子清洁的负担。其有效性可能取决于作物倒伏和一年生早熟禾植物的高度，其高度可达 40.6 厘米（16 英寸）。 2024 年，当种子湿度为 27% 而不是 43% 时，高羊茅产量并未减少。使用联合收割机在 28 厘米（11 英寸）和 27% 湿度下进行割草，比传统在 5 厘米（2 英寸）和 43% 湿度下进行割草产生的种子更多。 2025 年低产作物的结果也总体令人鼓舞。然而，由于种子水分下降，使用 28 厘米（11 英寸）的收割机会降低产量，这可能是因为较高的卷轴速度会增加种子的破碎。 这些发现表明机械设置至关重要。需要进一步的工作来完善切割高度、卷轴速度、收获时机和直接结合实践。 Hannah Rivedal、Todd N Temple、Robert J Starchvick、Joseph P Gallagher、Dustin W Herb、Jason Crisp、Nicole Anderson、Tatiana Benedetti 和 Amy B Peetz，俄勒冈州寄生一年生黑麦草（黑麦草）种子的种子瘿线虫（Anguina funesta）的可持续管理策略（2025），IHSG 会议记录和摘要。 ihsg.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/IHSG-2025.pdf Swati Mestri 拥有电子工程学士学位，自 2019 年以来一直担任内容编辑。她拥有编辑技术、医疗保健和材料科学领域研究文档的经验，并且对技术和空间特别感兴趣。完整档案 → 物理学硕士，具有研究经验。长期科学新闻爱好者。在 Science X 的社论中发挥关键作用...

reflection.en: The wisdom of the earth is often revealed through careful observation and patient work. This research in Oregon demonstrates how understanding the life cycles and physical characteristics of plants can lead to practical solutions for agricultural challenges. It reminds us that knowledge gained from studying creation can help us steward it more effectively.
reflection.zh: 大地的智慧常常通过细致的观察和耐心的工作得以显现。俄勒冈州这项研究表明，理解植物的生命周期和物理特性可以为农业挑战带来实际的解决方案。它提醒我们，从研究造物中获得的知识可以帮助我们更有效地管理它。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: New policy brief outlines how EU policies can better support sponge restoration
title.zh: 新政策简报概述欧盟政策如何更好地支持海绵恢复

summary.en: Europe's water and climate resilience is under increasing pressure from degraded soils, drained catchments, and the loss of wetlands, which exacerbate droughts and floods. Three EU-funded projects (SpongeBoost, SpongeWorks, and SpongeScapes) have released a policy brief recommending ways to strengthen resilience by...
summary.zh: 欧洲的水和气候韧性正面临日益增长的压力，土壤退化、集水区排水不畅以及湿地丧失加剧了干旱和洪水。三个欧盟资助的项目（SpongeBoost、SpongeWorks 和 SpongeScapes）发布了一份政策简报，建议通过恢复景观的自然“海绵功能”来加强韧性——即土壤、湿地等自然元素吸收、储存和缓慢释放水的能力。

body.en: Europe's water and climate resilience is under increasing pressure, with degraded soils, drained catchments and the loss of wetlands intensifying droughts and contributing to more destructive floods. In response, the EU-funded projects SpongeBoost, SpongeWorks and SpongeScapes have published a joint policy brief, "Achieving Better Implementation of EU Policies by Restoring the Sponge Function." The brief provides recommendations to strengthen Europe's water and climate resilience by restoring the natural sponge function of landscapes—the ability of soils, wetlands, forests and floodplains to absorb, store and slowly release water. Together, the three sister projects combine policy guidance, scientific evidence and real-world implementation to advance sponge landscapes across Europe.
body.zh: 欧洲的水和气候恢复能力正面临越来越大的压力，土壤退化、集水区干涸和湿地丧失加剧了干旱，并引发了更具破坏性的洪水。作为回应，欧盟资助的项目 SpongeBoost、SpongeWorks 和 SpongeScapes 发布了一份联合政策简报，“通过恢复海绵功能实现欧盟政策的更好实施”。该简报提出了通过恢复景观的天然海绵功能（土壤、湿地、森林和洪泛区吸收、储存和缓慢释放水的能力）来增强欧洲水和气候恢复能力的建议。这三个姊妹项目将政策指导、科学证据和现实世界的实施相结合，以促进整个欧洲的海绵景观。

reflection.en: The EU policy brief highlights the urgent need to restore the natural 'sponge function' of landscapes, recognizing that healthy ecosystems are vital for climate and water resilience. This echoes the Genesis account where Yahweh declared all of creation 'very good,' implying a mandate for humanity to steward and protect it. Restoring these natural systems is...
reflection.zh: 欧盟的政策简报强调了恢复景观自然“海绵功能”的紧迫性，认识到健康的生态系统对气候和水韧性至关重要。这与《创世记》中雅伟宣告万物“甚好”的记载相呼应，暗示了人类有责任管理和保护它。恢复这些自然系统是我们照管好被赐予的美好世界的一种方式。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Summer 2026 expected to be declared UK's hottest on record
title.zh: 2026年夏季预计将成为英国有记录以来最热的夏季

summary.en: Met Office figures due on Tuesday are likely to show that the previous record, set in 2025, has been broken after an unprecedented summer of persistent heat.
summary.zh: 周二公布的英国气象局数据显示，在经历了前所未有的持续高温夏季后，2025年创下的先前记录很可能将被打破。

body.en:
The Met Office is expected to confirm that the UK has had its hottest summer since records began in 1884.

Provisional figures for the months of June, July and August are due to be released on Tuesday afternoon and are likely to reveal that mean temperatures - which include daytime and overnight values - have broken the previous record, set just last year .

It follows a spring and summer of persistent heat with five widespread heatwaves and 40 days of temperatures above 30C (86F), smashing the previous record of 34 days.

The temperature figures are in line with evidence that summers are getting hotter , with more intense and frequent heatwaves, as a result of human-induced climate change. Records are being broken more often - and by bigger margins.

For much of the summer, areas of high pressure have dominated the UK weather, with dry conditions and winds from continental Europe allowing temperatures to rise repeatedly.

On 11 August the Met Office said it was looking increasingly likely to be the hottest summer since records began.

The UK's mean temperature for the summer up to that point stood at 16.48C (61.66F), with only average conditions needed during the remainder of August to confirm the seasonal record.

The second half of the month did bring a change in the pattern with cooler, wetter weather for many - but overall temperatures have mostly remained around or above the seasonal norm.

England and Wales are both expected to set new records, Northern Ireland is likely to come close - but Scotland will fall short.

The highest temperature recorded this summer was 38.1C (100.6F) at Kew Gardens in London on 13 August.

This was, provisionally, the UK's fifth-hottest day on record in terms of maximum temperature, but it didn't meet the all-time high of 40.3C (104.5F) measured at Coningsby, Lincolnshire in July 2022.

However, it is the persistence of the heat this spring and summer that is remarkable and has broken numerous records.

A temperature of 30C or higher has been recorded on 40 separate days. The previous record was 34 days, set in 1995.

A temperature of 35C or higher has been recorded on 10 separate days. The previous record was five days, set in 1976 and matched in 2020.

A temperature of 35C or higher was recorded in four calendar months - May, June, July and August. The previous record was two calendar months.

A temperature of 37C or higher has been recorded on three separate days, which is a new record. 37C+ has only been recorded nine times in the UK - three of which have occurred this year.

There have been five widespread heatwaves , including one at the end of meteorological spring which broke the UK's May temperature record by more than 2C.

Another in June broke the temperature record for that month too - with Lingwood,...
body.zh: 英国气象局预计将确认英国已经经历了自 1884 年有记录以来最热的夏季。 六月、七月和八月的临时数据将于周二下午发布，可能会显示平均气温（包括白天和夜间温度）已经打破了去年创下的纪录。 此前，春季和夏季持续高温，出现了五次大范围热浪，并且有 40 天气温高于 30 摄氏度（86 华氏度），打破了之前 34 天的记录。 这些温度数据与证据表明，由于人类引起的气候变化，夏季变得越来越热，热浪更加强烈和频繁。记录被打破的次数越来越多，而且幅度也越来越大。 在夏季的大部分时间里，高压地区主导了英国的天气，干燥的天气和来自欧洲大陆的风使得气温反复升高。 8 月 11 日，英国气象局表示，看起来越来越有可能成为有记录以来最热的夏季。 截至该时间点，英国夏季平均气温为 16.48 摄氏度（61.66 华氏度），只需在 8 月剩余时间达到平均气温即可确认季节记录。 下半月确实带来了气候变化，许多人的天气变得凉爽、湿润，但总体气温大多保持在季节性正常水平左右或以上。 英格兰和威尔士预计将创造新纪录，北爱尔兰可能会接近，但苏格兰将达不到。 8 月 13 日，伦敦邱园 (Kew Gardens) 今年夏天记录的最高气温为 38.1 摄氏度（100.6 华氏度）。 就最高气温而言，这暂时是英国有记录以来第五个最热的一天，但并未达到 2022 年 7 月在林肯郡科宁斯比测得的历史最高气温 40.3 摄氏度（104.5 华氏度）。 然而，今年春夏持续的炎热天气却令人瞩目，并打破了无数记录。 已连续 40 天记录到 30 摄氏度或更高的气温。此前的纪录是 1995 年创下的 34 天。 已连续 10 天记录到 35 摄氏度或更高的体温。此前的记录为 5 天，于 1976 年创下，2020 年打破。 5 月、6 月、7 月和 8 月这四个月的气温达到 35 摄氏度或更高。之前的记录是两个日历月。 连续三天录得37摄氏度或更高的气温，这是一个新纪录。 37C+ 在英国仅记录了 9 次，其中 3 次发生在今年。 已经发生了五次大范围的热浪，其中一次是在春季末期，打破了英国五月份的气温记录超过2摄氏度。 六月的另一次也打破了该月的气温记录 - 林伍德 (Lingwood)...

reflection.en: The Earth, in its intricate systems and cycles, reveals the profound wisdom of its Creator. As we observe the persistent heatwaves and rising temperatures, it serves as a reminder of the delicate balance of creation and the call to be wise stewards of the planet entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 大地及其错综复杂的系统和循环，彰显了其创造主的深邃智慧。当我们观察到持续的热浪和不断升高的气温时，这提醒我们受托管理地球的责任，以及要成为这份造物的智慧管家。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: ‘Superhuman’ AI tool spots heart disease in less than 2 seconds
title.zh: “超人”人工智能工具2秒内发现心脏病

summary.en: A new AI tool, trained on millions of routine ECGs, can detect heart disease in under two seconds by analyzing data beyond human visual capacity. This technology aims to expedite treatment for high-risk patients, potentially reducing the need for lengthy waits for echocardiograms.
summary.zh: 一款新的人工智能工具，通过对数百万份常规心电图进行训练，能在两秒内发现心脏病，其分析能力超越了人眼所能见的范畴。该技术旨在加快高风险患者的治疗进程，并可能减少对需要长时间等待的超声心动图检查的依赖。

body.en:
Doctors have developed a “superhuman” AI tool that can spot heart disease in less than two seconds.

The groundbreaking technology has been trained on millions of patients and works by extracting more information from a routine electrocardiogram (ECG) than the human eye can typically see.

The traditional ECG, which records electrical activity in the heart, including the rate and rhythm, has been a vital medical tool in diagnosing heart attacks and abnormal heart rhythms for a century.

But it cannot detect heart disease. That requires an echocardiogram, a type of ultrasound scan, which patients often have to wait months for.

Now a team have developed an AI tool that can spot signs of heart failure and heart valve disease – two of the most common forms of heart disease – from ECG results in “the blink of an eye”.

Details of the breakthrough, which could boost early diagnosis of heart disease, were presented to thousands of delegates at the European Society of Cardiology annual congress in Munich, the world’s largest heart conference.

Early diagnosis is vital for heart failure and heart valve disease, enabling those who need lifesaving medicines to be spotted sooner, before they become dangerously unwell.

The development is being seen as potentially significant, because ECGs are one of the most common tests in medicine, with about a billion performed worldwide each year.

In a trial involving 67,000 patients in the US, the AI tool was able to identify up to 81% of those who had heart failure, and up to 90% of those with heart valve disease.

Dr Sonya Babu-Narayan, a consultant cardiologist and clinical director of the British Heart Foundation (BHF), which funded the trial, said: “It is exciting to see that AI can now deliver a read-out from an ECG in what feels like the blink of an eye.

“Technology like the AI ECG in this research, which has the potential to identify high-risk patients early, will not detect everyone with a heart condition. But it could be a solution to help fast-track the patients who are most likely to have a heart abnormality. When it comes to the heart, earlier diagnosis and treatment saves and improves lives.”

The tech cannot be used on its own to definitively diagnose or rule out heart failure or heart valve disease, but it gives a very strong indication someone may have them.

Someone judged as highly likely to have either could be sent rapidly for an echocardiogram, rather than wait months on the standard waiting lists. That could mean a quicker diagnosis which would enable them to start treatment earlier.

Prof Fu Siong Ng, a professor of cardiology at Imperial College London, said: “Patients can often wait several months for a heart ultrasound scan after being referred for one by their doctor.

“This makes it exciting...
body.zh: 医生们开发出了一种“超人”的人工智能工具，可以在不到两秒的时间内发现心脏病。 这项突破性的技术已经在数百万患者身上进行了培训，其工作原理是从常规心电图 (ECG) 中提取比人眼通常可以看到的更多信息。 传统的心电图记录心脏的电活动，包括心率和节律，一个世纪以来一直是诊断心脏病和心律失常的重要医疗工具。 但它无法检测心脏病。这需要超声心动图（一种超声波扫描），患者通常需要等待数月。 现在，一个团队开发了一种人工智能工具，可以根据“眨眼间”的心电图结果发现心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病（两种最常见的心脏病形式）的迹象。 这一突破的细节可以促进心脏病的早期诊断，在慕尼黑举行的欧洲心脏病学会年会上向数千名代表介绍了这一突破，这是世界上最大的心脏病会议。 早期诊断对于心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病至关重要，使那些需要救生药物的人能够在出现危险的不适之前尽早发现。 这一发展被认为具有潜在的重大意义，因为心电图是医学中最常见的测试之一，全世界每年进行约十亿次。 在美国一项涉及 67,000 名患者的试验中，AI 工具能够识别出高达 81% 的心力衰竭患者和高达 90% 的心脏瓣膜疾病患者。 资助这项试验的英国心脏基金会 (BHF) 的心脏病专家兼临床主任索尼娅·巴布-纳拉扬 (Sonya Babu-Narayan) 博士表示：“令人兴奋的是，人工智能现在可以在眨眼的时间内读取心电图读数。 “这项研究中的人工智能心电图等技术有可能及早识别出高危患者，但无法检测出每个患有心脏病的人。但这可能是帮助快速追踪最有可能患有心脏异常的患者的解决方案。当涉及到心脏时，早期诊断和治疗可以挽救并改善生命。” 该技术不能单独用于明确诊断或排除心力衰竭或心脏瓣膜疾病，但它给出了一个非常强烈的迹象，表明某人可能患有这些疾病。 被判断为极有可能患有这两种疾病的人可以被迅速送去做超声心动图检查，而不是在标准等待名单上等待数月。这可能意味着更快的诊断，使他们能够更早地开始治疗。 伦敦帝国理工学院心脏病学教授 Fu Siong Ng 教授表示：“在医生推荐进行心脏超声扫描后，患者通常需要等待几个月才能进行心脏超声扫描。 “这让人兴奋......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in this new tool's ability to diagnose heart disease, reflects a world where human knowledge and technical capabilities are accelerating. As we witness such profound leaps in understanding and application, we are reminded of the biblical observation that in the end times, 'many will run to and fro,...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如这款能诊断心脏病的工具所示，反映了一个人类知识和技术能力日益加速的世界。当我们见证理解和应用上的巨大飞跃时，我们不禁想起圣经中的观察——在末世，“许多人往来奔跑，知识也必增长”。这种技术进步为治疗和福祉带来了巨大的潜力，呼唤我们以智慧和怜悯之心来管理它。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Did you solve it? The fin-tastic fish puzzle
title.zh: 你解出来了吗？鱼的奇妙谜题

summary.en: The solution to today’s underwater conundrums. A fish is swimming in a tank that is two metres high, one metre across and one metre deep. The image below shows one path it swam. The puzzles asked readers to draw the top view of the shortest path that results in given front and side views.
summary.zh: 今日水下谜题的解答。一条鱼在一个高两米、宽一米、深一米的鱼缸里游泳。下图展示了它游过的一条路径。谜题要求读者画出能产生给定前后视图的最短路径的俯视图。

body.en:
Earlier today I set you the following puzzles. Here they are again with the solutions.

A fish is swimming in a tank that is two metres high, one metre across and one metre deep. The image below shows one path it swam.

I gave two examples of a front and side view, and asked you to draw the top view of the shortest path that results in those views.

Start off by looking at the cross section defined by the vertical line of the 1. The diagonal of the 7 has to be on that plane, as does the horizontal part of the 7. The final segment has to be on the area I shaded in above right. The top view is thus:

The bottom half of the path must fall on the shaded cross section above left. Likewise, the top section (excluding the very top and middle of the tank) must fall on the shaded cross section above centre. We want the shortest path, so there is only one way to join the bottom part of the path to the top part, and to link the path on the top cross section, above right. The top view is thus:

Today’s puzzles were created by maths educator George Watkins to celebrate the opening of the 1729 Maths School , which welcomes its first pupils later this month.

The school – in Mill Hill, north London – is the first specialist maths secondary school to open in the UK. Its name comes from a famous anecdote about a London taxi cab with the licence plate 1729 .

I’ve been setting a puzzle here on alternate Mondays since 2015. I’m always on the look-out for great puzzles. If you would like to suggest one, email me .
body.zh: 今天早些时候，我给你设置了以下难题。他们再次给出了解决方案。 一条鱼在一个两米高、一米宽、一米深的水箱里游泳。下图显示了它游过的一条路径。 我给出了前视图和侧视图的两个示例，并要求您绘制产生这些视图的最短路径的俯视图。 首先查看由 1 的垂直线定义的横截面。7 的对角线必须位于该平面上，7 的水平部分也必须位于该平面上。最后一段必须位于右上方阴影区域。俯视图是这样的： 路径的下半部分必须落在左上方的阴影横截面上。同样，顶部部分（不包括水箱的最顶部和中间）必须落在中心上方的阴影横截面上。我们想要最短的路径，因此只有一种方法可以将路径的底部部分连接到顶部部分，并链接顶部横截面上的路径（右上方）。俯视图是这样的： 今天的谜题是由数学教育家乔治·沃特金斯 (George Watkins) 创建的，旨在庆祝 1729 年数学学校的开学，该学校将于本月晚些时候迎来第一批学生。 这所学校位于伦敦北部的米尔山，是英国第一所开设的专业数学中学。它的名字来源于关于伦敦一辆牌照为1729的出租车的著名轶事。 自 2015 年以来，我一直在每隔一个星期一在这里设置一个谜题。我总是在寻找很棒的谜题。如果您想推荐一个，请给我发电子邮件。

reflection.en: This puzzle invites us to observe the intricate movements of a creature within its environment. The Bible reminds us that much wisdom can be found by observing the natural world around us, as even the creatures of the earth can teach us. May we approach all of creation with a spirit of curiosity and reverence, seeking to understand the Creator through His...
reflection.zh: 这个谜题邀请我们观察生物在其环境中错综复杂的运动。圣经提醒我们，通过观察周围的自然世界可以获得许多智慧，因为就连地上的生物也能教导我们。愿我们以好奇和敬畏的心态对待万物，通过祂的作品来认识创造主。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Popular sweeteners may leave effects that last for generations
title.zh: 流行甜味剂可能留下影响数代的效果

summary.en: Two common zero-calorie sweeteners, sucralose and stevia, may have lasting effects beyond their taste. Research in mice showed they altered the gut microbiome, reduced beneficial bacterial compounds, and changed gene activity related to metabolism and inflammation. Notably, some of these changes were observed in...
summary.zh: 两种常用的零卡路里甜味剂，三氯蔗糖和甜菊糖，可能产生比甜味本身更持久的影响。在小鼠研究中，研究人员发现这两种甜味剂都改变了肠道微生物组，减少了肠道细菌产生的有益化合物，并改变了与新陈代谢和炎症相关的基因活动。其中一些变化甚至出现在从未食用过这些甜味剂的后代中。

body.en: Two widely used zero-calorie sweeteners, sucralose and stevia, may have effects that linger far longer than the sweet taste itself. In mice, researchers found that both sweeteners altered the gut microbiome, reduced beneficial compounds produced by gut bacteria, and changed the activity of genes involved in metabolism and inflammation. Some of those changes were also detected in later generations that had never consumed the sweeteners themselves.
body.zh: 两种广泛使用的零热量甜味剂，三氯蔗糖和甜叶菊，其影响可能比甜味本身更持久。在小鼠中，研究人员发现这两种甜味剂改变了肠道微生物组，减少了肠道细菌产生的有益化合物，并改变了参与代谢和炎症的基因的活性。其中一些变化也在从未食用过甜味剂的后代中被发现。

reflection.en: The relentless advance of scientific knowledge, as seen in this study on sweeteners, continually reveals new layers of complexity in the world around us. Daniel's prophecy speaks of knowledge increasing in the end times, a phenomenon we witness daily as research uncovers connections previously unknown, even across generations.
reflection.zh: 科学知识的不断进步，正如这项关于甜味剂的研究所示，不断揭示我们周围世界的新层面的复杂性。但以理的预言谈到末世知识必增长，我们每天都在见证这一现象，研究揭示了以前未知的联系，甚至跨越了世代。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Scientists discover two superconducting states hiding as one
title.zh: 科学家发现两种隐藏在一起的超导态

summary.en: Scientists have discovered hidden complexity within two ultrathin superconductors, niobium diselenide and tantalum disulfide, which previously appeared to have only a single superconducting state. Highly sensitive measurements revealed that each material actually possesses two distinct superconducting states.
summary.zh: 科学家们在两种超薄的超导体——二硒化铌和二硫化钽——中发现了隐藏的复杂性，而这两种超导体此前似乎只有一个超导态。高灵敏度的测量显示，每种材料实际上都拥有两种不同的超导态。

body.en:
Uncovering this hidden structure could eventually allow researchers to design superconducting materials and devices with greater control and precision. As scientists pursue quantum computers, ultra-efficient electronics, and other advanced technologies, a detailed understanding of how electrons behave inside superconductors will become increasingly important.

Some scientific surprises emerge not from discovering something entirely new, but from taking a closer look at something researchers thought they already understood.

For decades, physicists have investigated superconductors —materials capable of carrying electrical current with zero energy loss . Their unusual properties could eventually support technologies ranging from ultra-efficient electronics and quantum computers to advanced medical systems.

One of the best-studied examples is niobium diselenide (NbSe 2 ) . When researchers reduced the material to only a few atomic layers, experiments appeared to show relatively simple superconducting behavior. In particular, the material seemed to have a single energy gap, a key characteristic that reflects how electrons pair together so they can move without electrical resistance.

Researchers, however, had reason to suspect that this simple picture was incomplete.

The study was led by PhD. student Shahar Simon and MSc. student Maya Klang under the guidance of Prof. Oded Millo, and Prof. Hadar Steinberg of the Racah Institute of Physics and the Center for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem . The research was published in Physical Review Letters .

With highly sensitive tunneling spectroscopy measurements, the researchers found that NbSe 2 does not behave like a straightforward superconductor governed by only one superconducting order. Instead, it contains two different superconducting orders that interact so strongly they appear as one .

The researchers identified the same concealed behavior in the closely related material TaS 2 .

"It's a bit like listening to what sounds like a single singer, only to discover it's actually a perfectly synchronized duet," said the researchers.

The finding provides an explanation for a puzzle that had remained unresolved for years. Traditional theories could not fully reproduce the detailed shape of the superconducting energy spectrum seen in earlier experiments.

By using a more advanced model that includes two distinct superconducting orders, the Hebrew University researchers were able to explain the experimental measurements much more accurately. The same approach also accounted for how the materials behave when magnetic fields are applied.

The results point to additional complexity in thicker forms of the material. According to the findings, bulk NbSe 2 may contain...
body.zh: 揭示这种隐藏的结构最终可以让研究人员能够设计出具有更高控制力和精度的超导材料和设备。随着科学家追求量子计算机、超高效电子学和其他先进技术，详细了解电子在超导体内的行为将变得越来越重要。 一些科学惊喜并不是来自于发现全新的东西，而是来自于更仔细地研究研究人员认为他们已经理解的东西。 几十年来，物理学家一直在研究超导体——一种能够以零能量损失传输电流的材料。它们不寻常的特性最终可以支持从超高效电子和量子计算机到先进医疗系统的技术。 研究最好的例子之一是二硒化铌 (NbSe 2 )。当研究人员将材料减少到只有几个原子层时，实验似乎显示出相对简单的超导行为。特别是，该材料似乎具有单一能隙，这是一个关键特征，反映了电子如何配对在一起，以便它们可以在没有电阻的情况下移动。 然而，研究人员有理由怀疑这张简单的图景并不完整。 该研究由博士领导。学生沙哈尔西蒙和理学硕士。学生 Maya Klang 在耶路撒冷希伯来大学拉卡物理研究所和纳米科学与纳米技术中心的 Oded Millo 教授和 Hadar Steinberg 教授的指导下进行。该研究发表在《物理评论快报》上。 通过高灵敏度的隧道光谱测量，研究人员发现 NbSe 2 的行为并不像仅受一种超导序控制的简单超导体。相反，它包含两种不同的超导秩序，它们相互作用如此强烈，以至于看起来像是一个。 研究人员在密切相关的材料 TaS 2 中发现了相同的隐藏行为。 研究人员说：“这有点像听一个歌手听起来像是一个歌手，却发现它实际上是一个完美同步的二重唱。” 这一发现为多年来悬而未决的谜题提供了解释。传统理论无法完全重现早期实验中看到的超导能谱的详细形状。 通过使用包含两个不同超导级的更先进模型，希伯来大学的研究人员能够更准确地解释实验测量结果。同样的方法还解释了材料在施加磁场时的行为。 结果表明，较厚的材料形式更加复杂。根据研究结果，散装 NbSe 2 可能含有...

reflection.en: The universe, like the materials studied here, holds profound depths that human curiosity and diligent effort can reveal. The pursuit of knowledge, even in the seemingly simple, uncovers layers of wonder, reflecting the glory of discovery itself. This persistent exploration mirrors our own journey of understanding Yahweh's creation and His intricate designs.
reflection.zh: 宇宙，如同这里研究的材料一样，蕴藏着深邃的奥秘，等待着人类的好奇心和不懈努力去揭示。对知识的追求，即使是在看似简单的领域，也能揭示出层层奇迹，这本身就彰显了发现的荣耀。这种持续的探索，也呼应着我们理解雅伟的创造及其精妙设计的旅程。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Smelling test: children need education in sniffing aromas, scientist says
title.zh: 闻香识世界：科学家称儿童需要嗅觉教育

summary.en: Dr. Will Tullett, a historian of smells from the University of York, argues that children need better education in understanding aromas. He suggests that this improved olfactory education can enhance their well-being and their perception of the world. Tullett also notes that pollution can impair smell and that many...
summary.zh: 来自约克大学的气味历史学家威尔·塔利特博士认为，儿童需要更好地学习理解香气。他提出，这种改进的嗅觉教育可以提升他们的福祉和对世界的感知能力。塔利特博士还指出，污染会损害嗅觉，并且许多现代产品都去除了天然气味，代之以合成香料。

body.en: Exclusive: Dr Will Tullett says better understanding of scents can improve wellbeing and perception of the world Children need a better education in sniffing aromas, a leading historian of smells has said, noting it may improve their wellbeing and help them understand the world around them. Dr Will Tullett, of the University of York, said pollution had been found to impair people’s olfactory abilities, while many objects and substances today – from margarines to car interiors and even our own homes – were stripped of their original smells and “reodourised” with synthetic scents. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家报道：威尔·塔利特博士表示，更好地理解气味可以改善幸福感和对世界的感知 一位著名的气味历史学家表示，孩子们需要接受更好的嗅香教育，并指出这可能会改善他们的幸福感并帮助他们了解周围的世界。约克大学的威尔·塔利特博士表示，污染已被发现会损害人们的嗅觉能力，而今天的许多物体和物质——从人造黄油到汽车内饰，甚至我们自己的家——都失去了原来的气味，并用合成气味“重新散发”气味。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Dr. Will Tullett's call for better olfactory education reminds us that God's creation is rich with sensory experiences that can deepen our understanding and appreciation of the world. Just as the heavens declare God's glory, so too can the subtle nuances of scent reveal the intricate design and wonder of His handiwork, enriching our lives and well-being.
reflection.zh: 威尔·塔利特博士呼吁加强嗅觉教育，这提醒我们，上帝的创造充满了感官体验，可以加深我们对世界的理解和欣赏。正如诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，气味的细微差别也能揭示祂化工的精巧设计和奇妙之处，从而丰富我们的生活和福祉。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.

title.en: Scientists challenge a 70-year-old “lizard brain” myth
title.zh: 科学家挑战“爬行动物大脑”的70年神话

summary.en: A long-standing view of brain evolution, picturing newer rational layers stacked on an ancient "lizard brain," may be misleading. New research suggests evolution balances competing wiring styles, expanding one while shrinking another, rather than a simple layering of old over new.
summary.zh: 一个关于大脑进化的长期观点，将较新的理性层堆叠在古老的“爬行动物大脑”之上，可能具有误导性。新的研究表明，进化似乎是在平衡两种相互竞争的布线方式，扩展一种而缩小另一种，而不是简单地将旧的覆盖在新的之上。

body.en:
Many important choices seem to pit reason against emotion. Popular culture often describes that tension as a contest between two parts of the brain: a newer, more advanced center for rational thought and an ancient "lizard brain" that runs on instinct.

But the evolutionary history of the brain appears to be far more complicated than a simple struggle between old and new.

"There was a theory proposed in the '50s that the brain evolved in layers starting with basic bodily functions, to emotions in the reptilian brain, leading up to sophisticated reasoning in humans," explains Nabil Imam, an assistant professor in the School of Computational Science and Engineering and a faculty member with Georgia Tech's Institute for Neuroscience, Neurotechnology, and Society (INNS). "This is not how an evolutionary biologist would think about the problem."

Research published in Science Advances suggests that brain evolution may be better understood in terms of wiring rather than newer regions being stacked on top of older ones.

By examining the organization of both biological brains and artificial neural networks, Imam and his colleagues found evidence that evolution may involve allocating a limited amount of brain space among competing wiring strategies. Their model describes a computational tug of war between two fundamentally different kinds of neural organization, both of which are established even before birth.

The findings could help explain a long-running puzzle in brain evolution and may also point toward new ways of building AI systems that use less data and energy.

Terms such as "logical brain" and "lizard brain" actually refer to groups of brain regions with very different functions. The neocortex, often associated with higher-level thought, forms the outer layer of the brain and is involved in vision, perception, reasoning, and other complex abilities.

"The limbic system, sometimes called the 'reptilian brain,' controls emotion broadly speaking -- but it also has other components with distinct functions," explains Imam. The system contains separate regions involved in memory, smell, navigation, and emotional regulation. "Why do people group all these different regions into one big system? There hasn't been a good theory for what is common between these different circuits."

To explore that question, the researchers compared how these brain systems change across species. Rather than looking at individual regions one at a time, they examined how the limbic system and neocortex vary together over evolutionary history.

A clear pattern emerged. When one part of the limbic system was relatively large, the other limbic regions also tended to be larger. At the same time, the neocortex was generally smaller.

"Rather," says Imam, "it's a coordinated...
body.zh: 许多重要的选择似乎都是理性与情感的对立。流行文化经常将这种紧张关系描述为大脑的两个部分之间的竞争：一个更新、更先进的理性思维中心和一个依靠本能运行的古老“蜥蜴大脑”。 但大脑的进化史似乎比新旧之间的简单斗争要复杂得多。 乔治亚理工学院计算科学与工程学院助理教授、佐治亚理工学院神经科学、神经技术和社会研究所 (INNS) 的教员纳比尔·伊玛姆 (Nabil Imam) 解释说：“上世纪 50 年代提出了一种理论，认为大脑是分层进化的，从基本的身体功能开始，到爬行动物大脑的情感，最后发展到人类复杂的推理。” “这不是进化生物学家思考这个问题的方式。” 发表在《科学进展》上的研究表明，大脑的进化可以通过布线来更好地理解，而不是通过将新区域堆叠在旧区域之上来理解。 通过检查生物大脑和人工神经网络的组织，伊玛目和他的同事发现了证据，表明进化可能涉及在相互竞争的布线策略之间分配有限的大脑空间。他们的模型描述了两种根本不同的神经组织之间的计算拉锯战，这两种组织甚至在出生前就已经建立了。 这些发现可能有助于解释大脑进化中长期存在的难题，也可能指出构建使用更少数据和能源的人工智能系统的新方法。 “逻辑脑”和“蜥蜴脑”等术语实际上是指功能截然不同的大脑区域组。新皮质通常与更高层次的思维相关，形成大脑的外层，涉及视觉、感知、推理和其他复杂的能力。 “边缘系统，有时被称为‘爬虫类大脑’，广义上控制着情绪——但它也有其他具有不同功能的组件，”伊玛目解释道。该系统包含涉及记忆、嗅觉、导航和情绪调节的独立区域。 “为什么人们将所有这些不同的区域归为一个大系统？目前还没有一个好的理论来解释这些不同电路之间的共同点。” 为了探索这个问题，研究人员比较了这些大脑系统在不同物种之间的变化。他们没有一次只观察一个区域，而是研究了边缘系统和新皮质在进化史上如何共同变化。 一个清晰的模式出现了。当边缘系统的一部分相对较大时，其他边缘区域也往往较大。与此同时，新皮质普遍较小。 “相反，”伊玛目说，“这是一个协调的......

reflection.en: The popular image of the brain as a layered structure, with a primal "lizard brain" beneath our rational thought, is being challenged by new research. This reminds us that the intricate workings of creation, even within ourselves, often hold deeper wisdom than our current understanding allows. Observing the complexity of the brain's evolution, rather than...
reflection.zh: 大脑被描绘成一个分层结构，在我们理性思维之下有一个原始的“爬行动物大脑”，这种流行观念正受到新研究的挑战。这提醒我们，造物的复杂运作，即使在我们自身之内，也常常蕴含着比我们当前理解更深刻的智慧。观察大脑进化的复杂性，而不是依赖于简单的模型，可以让我们更深刻地欣赏雅伟的设计。

title.en: Fossil feet may be misleading scientists about human evolution
title.zh: 化石脚可能误导科学家关于人类进化

summary.en: New research reveals that wild monkeys in West Africa possess a previously unrecognized foot flexibility that enables them to climb vertical tree trunks. This finding challenges a fundamental assumption about the locomotion and appearance of the last common ancestor of humans and chimpanzees, impacting our...
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，西非的野生猴子拥有先前未被认识到的足部灵活性，使其能够攀爬垂直的树干。这一发现挑战了关于人类和黑猩猩最后共同祖先的运动能力和外貌的一个基本假设，从而影响了我们对人类进化的理解。

body.en:
New research suggests that whatever scientists ultimately discover about the last common ancestor of humans and chimpanzees, one characteristic may be difficult to dispute: it was probably capable of climbing trees.

Humans and chimpanzees went their separate evolutionary ways between 6 and 7 million years ago, when they diverged from the last common ancestor (LCA) they once shared. Reconstructing that ancestor has become an important part of understanding human evolution, including the emergence of walking on two legs.

One major question concerns where and how the LCA moved through forests. Did it spend much of its time among high horizontal branches, climb vertically from the ground, or combine both behaviors?

Chimpanzees are highly capable tree trunk climbers, aided by ankles that can flex much farther than human ankles. Monkeys, by contrast, have often been viewed as relying more heavily on their arms to move through trees. That distinction has influenced ideas about whether the human-chimpanzee ancestor should have possessed feet more like those of modern apes or monkeys.

Researchers from The Ohio State University studied wild sooty mangabey monkeys, whose feet do not have the same highly flexible ankles found in chimpanzees. Detailed observations and measurements showed that the monkeys can nevertheless bend parts of their feet enough to climb narrow vertical tree trunks while seeking food, hiding or finding places to sleep.

"People are making behavioral inferences from fossils, and some say a monkey can't vertically climb as well as an ape can," said first study author Luke Fannin, assistant professor of anthropology at Ohio State. "We're saying there's a functional equivalence here. So you can't rule out vertical climbing just because something doesn't have a chimpanzee-like foot."

The research appears this week in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences .

Determining what the LCA looked like and how it moved could help researchers understand the evolutionary steps that eventually produced habitual bipedalism, a form of movement practiced regularly only by humans.

Humans are apes, but the new findings suggest that an ancestor with feet resembling those of monkeys might still have been capable of climbing in ways comparable to modern apes.

"Part of paleoanthropology is understanding how our evolution happened, and it's often through the hallmark of how we move because modern humans move quite differently than our cousins, the chimpanzees, do, and they're the living primate we're most closely related to," Fannin said. "And we're trying to understand why that is."

Fannin collected video of wild mangabeys at the Taï Forest Monkey Project field station in Ivory Coast. The project is co-directed by W. Scott McGraw, professor...
body.zh: 新的研究表明，无论科学家最终发现人类和黑猩猩最后的共同祖先，有一个特征可能很难争议：它可能能够爬树。 人类和黑猩猩在 6 至 700 万年前走上了各自的进化道路，当时它们与曾经共同的最后一个共同祖先 (LCA) 分道扬镳。重建祖先已成为理解人类进化的重要组成部分，包括两条腿走路的出现。 一个主要问题涉及 LCA 在何处以及如何穿过森林。它是否将大部分时间花在高水平的树枝上、从地面垂直攀爬，或者将这两种行为结合起来？ 黑猩猩是非常有能力攀爬树干的人，它们的脚踝比人类的脚踝弯曲得更远。相比之下，猴子通常被认为更依赖手臂在树林中移动。这种区别影响了关于人类-黑猩猩祖先是否应该拥有更像现代猿或猴子的脚的想法。 俄亥俄州立大学的研究人员研究了野生黑白眉猴，它们的脚不像黑猩猩那样具有高度灵活的脚踝。详细的观察和测量表明，猴子在寻找食物、躲藏或寻找睡觉的地方时，仍然可以弯曲部分脚，爬上狭窄的垂直树干。 “人们正在根据化石做出行为推断，有人说猴子不能像猿一样垂直攀爬，”该研究的第一作者、俄亥俄州立大学人类学助理教授卢克·范宁说。 “我们说这里存在功能上的等同性。所以你不能仅仅因为某些东西没有像黑猩猩一样的脚就排除垂直攀爬。” 该研究发表在本周的《美国国家科学院院刊》上。 确定 LCA 的样子以及它如何移动可以帮助研究人员了解最终产生习惯性两足行走的进化步骤，这是一种只有人类经常练习的运动形式。 人类是猿类，但新的发现表明，脚部与猴子相似的祖先可能仍然能够以与现代猿类相当的方式攀爬。 范宁说：“古人类学的一部分是了解我们的进化是如何发生的，这通常是通过我们如何移动的标志来了解的，因为现代人类的移动方式与我们的近亲黑猩猩完全不同，而它们是与我们关系最密切的现存灵长类动物。” “我们正在试图理解这是为什么。” 范宁在科特迪瓦的塔伊森林猴项目野外站收集了野生白眉猴的视频。该项目由 W. Scott McGraw 教授共同指导...

reflection.en: The intricate design of creation often holds lessons that surprise us. Even the seemingly simple act of a monkey climbing a tree can reveal complexities that reshape our understanding of life's history. As we observe the natural world, we are reminded that wisdom is often found in the details, waiting to be discovered through careful study and observation.
reflection.zh: 造物的精妙设计常常蕴含着令我们惊讶的教训。即使是猴子攀爬树木这样看似简单的行为，也能揭示出重塑我们对生命历史理解的复杂性。当我们观察自然世界时，我们被提醒，智慧常常隐藏在细节之中，等待着通过仔细的研究和观察而被发现。
