title.en: Space junk punched a new hole in the moon. It’s not ours to abuse | Moriba Jah
title.zh: 太空垃圾在月球上打了个新洞。我们无权滥用它

summary.en: A piece of defunct SpaceX rocket debris impacted the Moon on August 5th, creating a new crater near Einstein Crater. While astronomers observed the resulting plume of sodium and lithium, the incident highlights the growing problem of space junk and the lack of accountability within the space industry for discarding...
summary.zh: 8月5日，一块报废的SpaceX火箭残骸撞击了月球，在爱因斯坦陨石坑附近形成了一个新陨石坑。天文学家观测到了由此产生的钠和锂的羽状物，但这一事件凸显了太空垃圾日益增长的问题，以及太空行业在轨道上随意丢弃废弃物而缺乏问责制的情况。

body.en: The space industry treats the sky as a place to dump what it no longer wants. We must develop a new model of accountability On 5 August, a piece of a derelict SpaceX rocket traveling at 5,400 miles an hour met with the moon and punched a fresh hole into it near Einstein Crater . Astronomers were thrilled. The European Southern Observatory caught sodium and lithium flaring in the debris plume and called it a bonus. The media called it a light show. Nobody was physically hurt, so nobody is responsible, and within a week the story was gone. I have spent 20 years tracking the junk humanity leaves behind in space for a living, and I want to tell you plainly what that crater actually is: a receipt. It’s what you get when an entire industry treats the sky, and now the moon, as a place to dump what it no longer wants, and calls the dumping “normal operations” or “space exploration”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 航天工业将天空视为倾倒不再想要的东西的地方。我们必须制定新的问责模式 8 月 5 日，一枚废弃 SpaceX 火箭的一块碎片以每小时 5,400 英里的速度与月球相遇，并在爱因斯坦陨石坑附近的月球上砸出了一个新的洞。天文学家们兴奋不已。欧洲南方天文台在碎片羽流中发现了钠和锂的燃烧，并将其称为额外奖励。媒体称其为灯光秀。没有人受到身体伤害，所以没有人负责，一周之内这个故事就消失了。我花了 20 年的时间追踪人类在太空中留下的垃圾为生，我想清楚地告诉你那个陨石坑实际上是什么：一张收据。当整个行业将天空和现在的月球视为倾倒不再想要的东西的地方，并将倾倒称为“正常操作”或“太空探索”时，你就会得到这样的结果。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of a rocket fragment creating a new crater on the Moon serves as a stark reminder of our stewardship over creation, both on Earth and beyond. Psalm 24:1 reminds us that 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it.' This includes the vastness of space and the celestial bodies within it, which are not ours to defile with our waste.
reflection.zh: 火箭碎片在月球上造成新陨石坑的新闻，提醒我们对创造物的管家职分，无论是在地球上还是在地球之外。诗篇24:1提醒我们：“地和其中所充满的，都属于雅伟。”这包括浩瀚的太空及其中的天体，它们并非我们可随意用垃圾玷污之物。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: NASA’s Roman Space Telescope launches to reveal the Universe’s darkest secrets
title.zh: NASA的罗马空间望远镜发射，揭示宇宙最黑暗的秘密

summary.en: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has begun a three-month journey covering roughly one million miles as it travels toward its final orbit. The observatory lifted off at 7:26 a.m. EDT Sunday aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket from Launch Complex 39A at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida. Once operational,...
summary.zh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）的南希·格蕾丝·罗马空间望远镜已开始为期三个月的旅程，行程约一百万英里，前往其最终轨道。该天文台于周日上午东部夏令时7:26，由SpaceX猎鹰重型火箭从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心39A发射台升空。投入使用后，罗马望远镜将结合其敏锐的红外视野和异常宽广的天空视野。这种组合将使天文学家能够检查...

body.en:
NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has begun a three-month journey covering roughly one million miles as it travels toward its final orbit. The observatory lifted off at 7:26 a.m. EDT Sunday aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket from Launch Complex 39A at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

Once operational, Roman will combine sharp infrared vision with an unusually wide view of the sky. That combination will allow astronomers to examine enormous regions of space while also looking far back into cosmic history. Among its primary goals are studying dark matter, dark energy, and worlds outside of our solar system, known as exoplanets. Its sweeping observations are also expected to support many discoveries beyond those central objectives.

"Roman is exactly the kind of success story we want to see across NASA," said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. "Delivered ahead of schedule and on budget, this mission reflects more than a decade of dedication from the NASA workforce and our industry partners. Now, Roman will give us a new atlas of the universe, push the boundaries of discovery, and demonstrate what is possible when America's space program pairs bold ambition with disciplined execution."

Controllers at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland, started receiving telemetry from Roman just seven minutes after launch. Falcon Heavy operated as planned and separated from the observatory 31 minutes after liftoff. After detaching from the rocket's center core, the two boosters returned safely to the launch site, where they can be refurbished.

"Roman will be a discovery machine that will bring us closer than ever before to answering humanity's most profound questions about our cosmic history," said Nicky Fox, associate administrator for the Science Mission Directorate at NASA Headquarters in Washington. "With its large field of view and fast survey speeds, Roman will usher us into a new era of discovery and make the invisible visible, setting the foundation for humanity's search for life beyond our solar system."

During the first part of the mission, Roman communicates with controllers using the Near Space Network, a system of ground stations and relay satellites that handles tracking, telemetry, and commands. Roughly 70 minutes after launch, communications shift to NASA's Deep Space Network, which will help guide the observatory toward the second Sun-Earth Lagrange point, or L2, about one million miles from Earth.

L2 is a region where the gravitational influences of the Sun and Earth allow spacecraft to maintain a relatively stable position with limited fuel use. Roman will first communicate through the Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex in Australia. Approximately six hours later, communications will transfer to the...
body.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜已开始为期三个月的旅程，覆盖约 100 万英里，朝着最终轨道运行。该天文台于美国东部时间周日上午 7 点 26 分搭乘 SpaceX 猎鹰重型火箭从佛罗里达州 NASA 肯尼迪航天中心的 39A 发射场升空。 一旦投入使用，罗曼将把敏锐的红外视觉与异常广阔的天空视野结合起来。这种结合将使天文学家能够检查巨大的太空区域，同时也可以回顾宇宙历史。其主要目标之一是研究暗物质、暗能量和太阳系之外的世界（即系外行星）。其广泛的观察也有望支持这些中心目标之外的许多发现。 “罗曼正是我们希望在 NASA 看到的那种成功故事，”NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 说道。 “这项任务在预算范围内提前完成，体现了 NASA 工作人员和行业合作伙伴十多年来的奉献精神。现在，罗曼将为我们提供一本新的宇宙地图，突破探索的界限，并展示当美国的太空计划将大胆的雄心与严格的执行相结合时，一切皆有可能。” 发射后仅七分钟，位于马里兰州格林贝尔特的美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心的控制人员就开始接收来自罗曼的遥测数据。猎鹰重型火箭按计划运行，并在升空 31 分钟后与天文台分离。与火箭中心核心分离后，两个助推器安全返回发射场，在那里可以进行翻新。 “罗曼将成为一台发现机器，它将让我们比以往任何时候都更接近回答人类关于宇宙历史的最深刻的问题，”美国宇航局华盛顿总部科学任务理事会副主任尼基·福克斯说。 “凭借其广阔的视野和快速的勘测速度，罗马将引领我们进入一个发现的新时代，让不可见的变得可见，为人类寻找太阳系以外的生命奠定基础。” 在任务的第一部分，罗曼使用近空网络与控制器进行通信，近空网络是一个由地面站和中继卫星组成的系统，负责处理跟踪、遥测和命令。发射后大约 70 分钟，通信转移到 NASA 的深空网络，这将有助于引导天文台前往距离地球约 100 万英里的第二个日地拉格朗日点（L2）。 L2 是一个区域，太阳和地球的引力影响使航天器能够在有限的燃料使用下保持相对稳定的位置。罗曼将首先通过澳大利亚的堪培拉深空通信中心进行通信。大约六个小时后，通讯将转移到...

reflection.en: The launch of the Roman Space Telescope marks a significant step in humanity's quest to understand the universe. As it embarks on its million-mile journey, it carries our collective curiosity to probe the mysteries of dark matter, dark energy, and exoplanets. This endeavor reminds us that the heavens themselves are a testament to a grandeur beyond our...
reflection.zh: 罗马空间望远镜的发射标志着人类探索宇宙奥秘的又一重要里程碑。它踏上了一百万英里的旅程，承载着我们集体的好奇心，去探究暗物质、暗能量和系外行星的奥秘。这项事业提醒我们，诸天本身就是宏伟壮丽的见证，超越我们目前的理解，激发着敬畏与惊叹。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Scale of snakebites estimated globally
title.zh: 蛇咬伤的规模估计全球

summary.en: A study published in Nature estimates the global incidence of snakebites and associated deaths using available data and modeling, providing crucial information for public health initiatives aimed at addressing this concern.
summary.zh: 发表在《自然》杂志上的一项研究，利用现有数据和模型估计了全球蛇咬伤的发生率和相关死亡人数，为旨在解决这一问题的公共卫生举措提供了关键信息。

reflection.en: The vastness of the natural world, even its dangers like snakebites, holds lessons. By carefully studying patterns and using data, scientists can better understand and combat threats, reflecting the ancient wisdom that creation itself can teach us about its intricacies and how to navigate them.
reflection.zh: 即使是像蛇咬伤这样的危险，广阔的自然界也蕴含着教训。通过仔细研究模式和利用数据，科学家们可以更好地理解和对抗威胁，这反映了古老的智慧——造物本身可以教会我们关于其复杂性以及如何应对它们。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: What’s your lab’s archetype? The answer could inform how you use AI
title.zh: 你的实验室是什么原型？答案可能会影响你如何使用人工智能

summary.en: Nature, Published online: 31 August 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02543-z A white paper proposes four priority models for research groups, each with a distinct approach to utilizing artificial intelligence.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志，2026年8月31日在线发表；doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02543-z 一份白皮书为研究团队提出了四种优先模型，每种模型在利用人工智能方面都有不同的方法。

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence rapidly advances, its integration into scientific research presents new opportunities and challenges. This development echoes the ancient prophecy of knowledge increasing and understanding expanding, urging us to consider how we steward these powerful tools. May we pursue wisdom and discernment in applying these innovations,...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能的飞速发展，其在科学研究中的应用带来了新的机遇和挑战。这一发展呼应了古老的预言，即知识增长，理解力扩展，促使我们思考如何管理这些强大的工具。愿我们在应用这些创新时，追求智慧和辨别力，确保它们服务于人类，并反映受造界的秩序。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Order from disorder: do we need a new law of physics?
title.zh: 秩序源于无序：我们是否需要新的物理定律？

summary.en: A radical proposal that evolutionary pressures apply to atoms as much as animals should provoke scientific debate.
summary.zh: 一项激进的提议认为，进化压力对原子的作用与对动物的作用一样大，这应该会引发科学辩论。

reflection.en: The universe, from the smallest atom to the grandest animal, reveals the intricate wisdom of its Creator. This proposal to explore evolutionary pressures on atoms invites us to see the deep order Yahweh has woven into the fabric of reality. May this scientific inquiry deepen our awe for the Creator's boundless ingenuity.
reflection.zh: 宇宙万物，从最小的原子到最宏伟的动物，都彰显了其创造者精妙的智慧。这项关于探索原子进化压力的提议，邀请我们看到雅伟编织在现实结构中的深层秩序。愿这项科学探索加深我们对创造者无限创造力的敬畏。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: The leap second is dead. Long live the leap hour?
title.zh: 跳秒已死。跳时万岁？

summary.en: Fear of a possible ‘negative’ leap second is accelerating plans to abolish the practice.
summary.zh: 对可能出现的“负跳秒”的担忧正在加速废除该做法的计划。

reflection.en: The relentless march of human knowledge and technological innovation is a hallmark of our age. As we develop ever more sophisticated systems, like the precise timekeeping discussed here, we are reminded of the prophetic words that 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This rapid advancement calls for wisdom and discernment, ensuring our...
reflection.zh: 人类知识和技术创新的不懈进步是我们这个时代的标志。随着我们开发出越来越复杂的系统，例如这里讨论的精确计时，我们不禁想起预言中的话：“许多人往来奔跑，知识就增长。”这种快速发展需要智慧和辨别力，以确保我们的创新能够服务于人类并反映受造界的秩序。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Why are rich people so pessimistic? What the numbers say
title.zh: 富人为何如此悲观？数字揭示原因

summary.en: A study published in Nature suggests that factors like age, location, and expectations significantly influence people's outlook on the future, with optimism appearing to be scarce in contemporary society.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志在线发表的一项研究表明，人们对未来的乐观程度很大程度上受到年龄、居住地和期望等因素的影响，在当今社会，乐观情绪似乎供不应求。

reflection.en: In a world where pessimism seems to be a growing trend, even among those with material wealth, it's easy to feel adrift. Yet, the ancient promise remains: 'For I know the plans I have for you,' declares Yahweh, 'plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.' This divine assurance offers a counterpoint to despair, reminding...
reflection.zh: 在一个悲观主义似乎日益成为趋势的世界里，即使在物质富裕的人群中也是如此，人们很容易感到迷失。然而，古老的应许依然存在：“雅伟说，‘我知道我为你们所定的计划，是使你们得平安，而不是灾祸的计划，要赐给你们盼望和未来。’”这神圣的保证是对绝望的有力回应，提醒我们，我们最终的盼望并非系于世俗的境况，而是系于雅伟永恒的信实。

verse.textEn: For I know the plans I have for you, declares Yahweh, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
verse.textZh: 我知道我向你们所怀的意念，是赐平安的意念，不是降灾祸的意念，要叫你们末后有指望。这是雅伟说的。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: ‘If you build something vastly smarter than you, it better be on your side’: can we stop AI from deceiving us?
title.zh: “如果你创造了比你聪明得多的东西，最好让它站在你这边”：我们能阻止人工智能欺骗我们吗？

summary.en: The idea that machines can now intentionally mislead or manipulate us, similar to how humans do, is deeply unsettling. Researchers are urgently seeking solutions to this potential for deception by artificial intelligence before it becomes too late.
summary.zh: 机器现在能够像人类一样有意地误导或操纵我们，这一想法令人深感不安。研究人员正在紧急寻找解决方案，以应对人工智能潜在的欺骗性，争取为时未晚。

body.en: We are used to the idea that our fellow humans might intentionally mislead or manipulate us, but the idea that machines can now do the same is deeply unsettling. Researchers are racing to find solutions before it’s too late The summer issue of the Long Read magazine is out now. Click here to order In November 2023 – a lifetime ago in the field of artificial intelligence – some of the most powerful people in the world descended on Bletchley Park, the wartime codebreaking hub in Buckinghamshire, to talk about AI safety . In attendance were the then US vice-president, Kamala Harris, the AI bosses Sam Altman and Dario Amodei, delegations from 28 countries, two of the three so-called “godfathers” of AI, and Elon Musk. The first iteration of ChatGPT had been released only a year earlier, and there was already plenty of evidence that AI models could be used for ill, from spreading misinformation to generating deepfakes. A presentation at the summit, however, highlighted a different issue: what if the biggest problem wasn’t to come from people misusing the technology, but from AI’s own behaviour? Continue reading...
body.zh: 我们已经习惯了人类同胞可能会故意误导或操纵我们的想法，但机器现在也可以做同样的事情，这令人深感不安。研究人员正在竞相寻找解决方案，以免为时已晚 《Long Read》杂志夏季刊现已出版。点击此处订购 2023 年 11 月（人工智能领域的百年前），世界上一些最有权势的人来到白金汉郡的战时密码破译中心布莱切利公园，谈论人工智能安全。出席会议的有时任美国副总统卡马拉·哈里斯、人工智能大佬萨姆·奥尔特曼和达里奥·阿莫代、来自 28 个国家的代表团、三位所谓人工智能“教父”中的两位以及埃隆·马斯克。 ChatGPT 的第一代版本仅在一年前发布，并且已经有大量证据表明人工智能模型可能被用于恶意行为，从传播错误信息到生成深度伪造品。然而，峰会上的一次演讲强调了一个不同的问题：如果最大的问题不是来自人们滥用技术，而是来自人工智能自身的行为怎么办？继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI presents a profound challenge, mirroring human capacity for deception. As we develop intelligences far exceeding our own, the question of their alignment with our values becomes paramount. This echoes the ancient wisdom that true character is revealed under pressure, urging us to build not just smart systems, but trustworthy ones.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展带来了严峻的挑战，它模仿了人类欺骗的能力。当我们开发出远超我们自身智能的系统时，它们是否与我们的价值观一致就变得至关重要。这呼应了古老的智慧：真正的品格在压力下显现，促使我们不仅要构建智能的系统，更要构建值得信赖的系统。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: The Bentley Supersports: A stripped-out engineer's indulgence
title.zh: 宾利Supersports：轻量化的工程师放纵之作

summary.en: It's the lightest Bentley in 85 years.
summary.zh: 这是85年来最轻的宾利。

body.en: Bentley provided flights from Washington, DC, to Monterey, California, and accommodation so Ars could drive the Supersports, as well as ride in a preproduction Torcal EV, which we wrote about last week. Ars does not accept paid editorial content. MONTEREY, Calif.—Last week, we brought news of the Bentley Torcal, a new electric vehicle that the luxury automaker has been cooking up at its HQ in Crewe, England. The company wants to attract new customers with its first battery EV, part of a plan to make sustainability as much a part of the brand's character as its high-end fit and finish. W12 engines have given way to V8 plug-in hybrid power, and the new Continental GT is all the better for it . But around the same time as Ars got its first experience of that new PHEV two-door on a rather wet Spanish racetrack, some of Bentley's boffins were wondering what might happen if you also built one without the hybrid stuff. Or all-wheel drive—something that has been a characteristic of every new road-going Bentley since the turn of the century. That would certainly cut the curb weight. So, too, would leaving out the rear seats. That sort of idea leads down a well-trodden path for some OEMs, and Porsche in particular is famous for making stripped-out road cars inspired by its race cars and making money from them, too. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 宾利提供从华盛顿特区飞往加利福尼亚州蒙特雷的航班，并提供住宿，以便 Ars 可以驾驶 Supersports，并乘坐我们上周写过的预生产 Torcal 电动汽车。 Ars 不接受付费编辑内容。加利福尼亚州蒙特利——上周，我们带来了宾利托卡尔 (Bentley Torcal) 的消息，这是一家豪华汽车制造商在其位于英国克鲁的总部研发的一款新型电动汽车。该公司希望通过其首款电池电动汽车吸引新客户，这是一项计划的一部分，旨在使可持续发展与高端装配和装饰一样成为该品牌特色的一部分。 W12 发动机已经让位于 V8 插电式混合动力，而新款欧陆 GT 则更胜一筹。但大约在同一时间，当 Ars 在相当潮湿的西班牙赛道上首次体验这款新型 PHEV 两门车时，宾利的一些研究人员想知道，如果您也制造一辆没有混合动力的汽车，会发生什么。或者全轮驱动——自世纪之交以来，这一直是每辆新款公路宾利汽车的特征。这肯定会减少整备重量。因此，也可以省略后排座椅。这种想法为一些原始设备制造商带来了一条常见的道路，尤其是保时捷，以制造受其赛车启发的精简公路车并从中赚钱而闻名。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Bentley's engineers have crafted their lightest car in 85 years, a testament to meticulous design and skilled labor. This dedication to excellence in their work echoes the biblical call to 'do everything for the glory of God,' finding purpose and honor in the quality of one's craft.
reflection.zh: 宾利的工程师们打造出了85年来最轻的汽车，这是精湛设计和熟练技艺的证明。这种对卓越工作的奉献精神，呼应了圣经中“凡所行的，都为荣耀神”的呼召，在技艺的品质中找到目标和荣耀。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Amazon rigged $20bn worth of ad prices, US lawsuit alleges
title.zh: 亚马逊被指控操纵广告定价，面临美国各州和监管机构的诉讼

summary.en: Amazon is facing a lawsuit from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission and 22 states, which alleges the company secretly overcharged over a million advertising customers by manipulating online auction prices since 2019, potentially netting $20 billion. Amazon disputes these claims, stating the FTC misunderstands their ad...
summary.zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）和22个州联合对亚马逊提起诉讼，指控该公司自2019年以来通过操纵在线拍卖价格，秘密向超过一百万的广告客户收取过高费用，可能已获利200亿美元。亚马逊对此表示强烈反对，认为FTC误解了其广告市场。

body.en:
Amazon secretly overcharged more than a million advertising customers by manipulating online auctions it uses to set ad prices, according to a lawsuit filed by the US Federal Trade Commission (FTC) and a bipartisan group of 22 states.

According to the lawsuit, filed on Monday, the alleged scheme has likely netted the firm $20bn (£14.8bn) from advertising customers since 2019.

"Amazon overrides and replaces the actual auction results with higher prices set by Amazon to increase its profits," says a complaint filed in the company's home state of Washington.

In a statement to the BBC, Amazon said it "strongly disagrees" with the premise that it misled advertisers and called the suit "misguided."

In addition to advertisers, the FTC, a US consumer watchdog, and the states say Amazon customers have also been harmed as extra costs are passed onto shoppers.

"Consumers are suffering, have suffered, and will continue to suffer substantial injury as a result," the complaint states, prompting swift pushback from Amazon.

"The FTC wants the public to believe this case is about higher prices for consumers. It is not," Amazon said in its statement.

The company's shares fell following the announcement of the lawsuit, closing 2.5% lower on Monday.

Many brands and sellers compete on Amazon to place Sponsored Product ads and Sponsored Brands ads when consumer search for products using keywords on Amazon's e-commerce platform.

The complaint accuses Amazon of secretly charging advertisers more in so-called "second price" auctions, whereby prospective advertisers expect to pay one cent more than the next highest bidder for each bid they win.

But in practice, the complaint alleges, Amazon has charged its Sponsored Products advertisers their own winning bid close to 80% of the time.

The lawsuit states that Amazon's methods were spurred because "it was unhappy about how much revenue its advertising auctions were generating".

Amazon responded by saying the FTC "fundamentally misunderstands how advertisers operate".

"Advertisers adjust bids based on real-world performance, not descriptions of auction mechanics," Amazon said in its statement.

"Average winning bids fell 50% from 2019 to 2025 on Sponsored Products search ads, and roughly 92% of placed ads are not given to the highest bid," the company added.

Last year, it settled a case with the FTC that alleged that it enrolled millions of consumers in its Prime subscription offering without their consent, and knowingly made it difficult for consumers to cancel.

Amazon settled the case for $2.5bn, including civil penalties and consumer refunds.

body.zh: 美国联邦贸易委员会 (FTC) 和一个由 22 个州组成的两党组织已提起诉讼，指控亚马逊通过操纵用于设定广告价格的在线拍卖，秘密向超过 100 万广告客户收取过高费用。 美国联邦贸易委员会 (FTC) 和各州在周一提起的诉讼中表示，自 2019 年以来，涉嫌的计划可能已使该公司从广告客户中获利 200 亿美元。 在该公司总部华盛顿州提交的一份投诉称，“亚马逊为了增加利润而设定了更高的价格，从而推翻并取代了实际的拍卖结果。” 在给 BBC 的一份声明中，亚马逊“强烈不同意”其误导广告商的前提，并称该诉讼“具有误导性”。 除了广告商之外，美国消费者监管机构联邦贸易委员会和各州表示，由于额外成本转嫁给购物者，亚马逊的客户也受到了伤害。 投诉称：“消费者正在遭受、已经遭受并将继续遭受重大伤害。”这引发了亚马逊的迅速反击。 亚马逊在声明中表示：“联邦贸易委员会希望公众相信此案是为了向消费者收取更高的价格。但事实并非如此。” 诉讼公告公布后，该公司股价下跌，周一收盘下跌 2.5%。 当消费者在亚马逊电子商务平台上使用关键字搜索产品时，许多品牌和卖家都在亚马逊上竞争投放商品推广广告和品牌推广广告。 起诉书指控亚马逊在所谓的“第二价格”拍卖中秘密向广告商收取更高费用，即潜在的广告商希望为他们每次获胜的出价比第二高出价者多支付一美分。 但在实践中，投诉称，近 80% 的情况下，亚马逊都会向其商品推广广告商收取自己的中标费用。 该诉讼称，亚马逊的做法之所以受到刺激，是因为“它对其广告拍卖产生的收入感到不满”。 亚马逊回应称，联邦贸易委员会“从根本上误解了广告商的运作方式”。 亚马逊在声明中表示：“广告商根据现实世界的表现调整出价，而不是根据拍卖机制的描述。” 该公司补充道：“从 2019 年到 2025 年，商品推广搜索广告的平均中标出价下降了 50%，大约 92% 的投放广告没有给出最高出价。” 去年，该公司与美国联邦贸易委员会 (FTC) 达成和解，指控该公司在未经数百万消费者同意的情况下将其纳入其 Prime 订阅服务，并故意让消费者难以取消。 亚马逊以 25 亿美元和解，包括民事罚款和消费者退款。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

reflection.en: This lawsuit highlights the tension between corporate profit and fair practice. The allegations suggest a deliberate manipulation of pricing, raising questions about accountability and justice in the digital marketplace. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles that should guide all economic interactions.
reflection.zh: 这项诉讼凸显了企业利润与公平交易之间的紧张关系。这些指控暗示了故意的价格操纵，引发了对数字市场中问责制和公正性的疑问。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与我们的神同行，这些原则应指导所有经济往来。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Trump admin shelves Cyclospora research despite record-breaking outbreak
title.zh: 特朗普政府搁置旋毛孢属研究，尽管疫情创纪录

summary.en: The CDC has tallied nearly 30,000 confirmed and probable cases this summer.
summary.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）统计，今年夏天已有近3万例确诊和疑似病例。

body.en: The Trump administration is halting vital federal research on the foodborne parasite Cyclospora, despite the record-breaking, nationwide outbreak of the diarrheal pathogen, according to Politico . Of the three research programs that represent nearly all of the Cyclospora work at the US Department of Agriculture, two have been defunded, and the third is about to lose every scientist working on it. The Trump administration is shuttering the USDA's Beltsville Agricultural Research Center near Washington, DC, and moving its work to a location in Iowa. That includes relocating the remaining Cyclospora research. Although the research is still funded, insiders told Politico that not one of the scientists working on the project plans to relocate from Maryland to Iowa. Instead, they are either retiring, being reassigned to a different project, or leaving the USDA's research services. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 据 Politico 报道，尽管腹泻病原体在全国范围内爆发创纪录，但特朗普政府正在停止对食源性寄生虫环孢子虫的重要联邦研究。在代表美国农业部几乎所有环孢菌工作的三个研究项目中，两个项目已被取消资助，第三个项目即将失去所有从事该项目的科学家。特朗普政府正在关闭美国农业部位于华盛顿特区附近的贝尔茨维尔农业研究中心，并将其工作转移到爱荷华州的一个地点。这包括重新安置剩余的环孢子虫研究。尽管这项研究仍然得到资助，但内部人士告诉 Politico，从事该项目的科学家中没有一位计划从马里兰州搬到爱荷华州。相反，他们要么退休，被重新分配到不同的项目，要么离开美国农业部的研究服务。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: It is disheartening to see vital research on a foodborne parasite halted, especially during a record-breaking outbreak. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that "where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety." Effective governance and public health rely on heeding expert advice and continuing research, not shelving it...
reflection.zh: 看到一种食源性寄生虫的重要研究在创纪录的疫情期间被搁置，令人沮丧。《箴言》11:14提醒我们：“不先筹画，民就败落；谋士众多， people 得胜。” 有效的治理和公共卫生依赖于听取专家意见和持续的研究，而不是在最需要的时候将其搁置。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Get in on the Ars community that doesn’t fit beneath an article
title.zh: 加入 Ars 社区，它不适合文章之下

summary.en: You've read the stories. Now check out our forums.
summary.zh: 您已经读过这些故事。现在来看看我们的论坛吧。

body.en: If you’re like many of our readers, you’ve got Ars Technica bookmarked and hit the front page a few times a day. But for others, a compelling story is what brings them here for the first time. And the discussions sometimes keep them coming back. Since its launch in 1998, Ars Technica has been known for its depth of community. If all you're doing is checking out the front page and the discussion threads that sit beneath each story, you’re missing out on more than you realize. The Ars OpenForum is a place for readers to ask questions, compare notes, argue (without being jerks to each other), and go down all sorts of rabbit holes. Our Hardware and Tweaking forums cover PC builds , networking , mobile computing , CPUs and motherboards , A/V , and just about any other hardware-related topic you can think of. Stop by the Operating Systems & Software forums for in-depth discussion on Windows , macOS , or Linux or just to have a good, friendly argument over why your preferred OS rules . Read full article Comments
body.zh: 如果您像我们的许多读者一样，您已经为 Ars Technica 添加了书签，并且每天都会登上首页几次。但对于其他人来说，一个引人入胜的故事是他们第一次来到这里。讨论有时会让他们回来。自 1998 年推出以来，Ars Technica 以其社区深度而闻名。如果您所做的只是查看首页和每个故事下方的讨论主题，那么您错过的东西比您意识到的要多。 Ars OpenForum 是读者提问、交换意见、争论（而不是互相嘲笑）以及探索各种兔子洞的地方。我们的硬件和调整论坛涵盖 PC 构建、网络、移动计算、CPU 和主板、A/V 以及您能想到的任何其他硬件相关主题。请访问操作系统和软件论坛，深入讨论 Windows、macOS 或 Linux，或者只是就您首选操作系统的规则进行友好的讨论。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The Ars Technica community is a testament to how shared interests can foster deep engagement and the exchange of knowledge. In an age where information is rapidly expanding, these digital spaces allow for the exploration of complex topics, much like the prophecy that 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' It's a reminder that while...
reflection.zh: Ars Technica 社区证明了共同的兴趣如何能够促进深入的参与和知识的交流。在一个信息飞速膨胀的时代，这些数字空间允许人们探索复杂的主题，这与“许多人往来奔跑，知识就增长”的预言十分相似。它提醒我们，虽然科技在进步，但人类连接、学习和讨论的愿望仍然是我们体验的重要组成部分。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Review: Coyote vs. Acme is an unabashed love letter to Looney Tunes
title.zh: 评论：兔八哥大战二丁目是献给乐一通的毫不掩饰的情书

summary.en: Director Dave Green's live action/animated hybrid captures the smart, subversive weirdness of the classic cartoons. After a three-year delay, 'Coyote vs. Acme' is finally in theaters, delighting audiences with its blend of slapstick, satire, and warmth, proving worth the wait.
summary.zh: 导演戴夫·格林的真人与动画结合的影片捕捉到了经典卡通片聪明、颠覆性的怪诞风格。经过三年的延误，《兔八哥大战二丁目》终于上映，以其融合了滑稽、讽刺和温情的风格取悦了观众，证明了等待是值得的。

body.en: It took three years, but Coyote vs. Acme is finally in theaters and delighting audiences of all ages with its irresistible blend of slapstick humor, pointed satire, and even a warm fuzzy here and there. We're happy to report that the film was worth the wait. (Some spoilers below but no major reveals.) The film is based on a well-known satirical piece by Ian Frazier (also titled “Coyote vs. Acme”) published in The New Yorker in 1990. Development of a film version didn’t start until 2018, but some pretty talented people worked on the script, including James Gunn. Small wonder that Warner Bros.’ bizarre 2023 decision to shelve the film in order to take a tax write-off sparked outrage both within the industry and among fans online. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 历时三年，《土狼大战阿克米》终于在影院上映，以其令人难以抗拒的滑稽幽默、尖刻讽刺，甚至时不时出现的温暖模糊的融合，让各个年龄段的观众都感到高兴。我们很高兴地告诉大家，这部电影值得等待。 （下面有一些剧透，但没有重大透露。）这部电影改编自伊恩·弗雷泽 (Ian Frazier) 1990 年在《纽约客》上发表的著名讽刺文章（也名为《Coyote vs. Acme》）。电影版本的开发直到 2018 年才开始，但一些非常有才华的人参与了剧本创作，其中包括詹姆斯·古恩 (James Gunn)。难怪华纳兄弟在 2023 年做出了搁置这部电影以进行税务冲销的奇怪决定，此举引发了业内和网上粉丝的愤怒。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The creation of 'Coyote vs. Acme,' a film that captures the unique spirit of Looney Tunes, speaks to the explosion of human creativity and knowledge. Daniel 12:4 foretells a time when 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This film, born from years of work and a blend of artistic talents, is a testament to that increasing knowledge and...
reflection.zh: 《兔八哥大战二丁目》这部影片捕捉了乐一通独特的精神，它的创作体现了人类创造力和知识的爆发。但以理书12:4预言：“必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。”这部影片历经多年打磨，汇集了众多艺术人才，正是这种日益增长的知识及其富有想象力的表达方式的证明。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Trump tells FCC to punish journalist for calling his election results "mixed"
title.zh: 特朗普要求FCC惩罚记者，因其称其选举结果“好坏参半”

summary.en: President Trump has called for the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to punish or rebuke NBC journalist Kristen Welker for stating that his primary election endorsements had "mixed results." Trump accused Welker of "purposeful inaccuracy" and used the incident to criticize the 'Meet the Press' program.
summary.zh: 特朗普总统要求联邦通信委员会（FCC）惩罚或谴责NBC记者克里斯汀·威尔克，因为她称其在初选中的背书“好坏参半”。特朗普指责威尔克“故意不准确”，并以此批评“与人民面对面”节目。

body.en: President Trump yesterday demanded that the Federal Communications Commission punish or rebuke an NBC journalist for saying he has "mixed results" in his election endorsements. In the latest example of how Trump is using the FCC to harass reporters and news organizations that he dislikes, he said Meet the Press host Kristen Welker "will be reported to the FCC for rebuke or punishment" for what he claimed was a "purposeful inaccuracy." "Kristen Welker, the Unpopular 'Hostess' of the once great Meet the Press, now considered Meet the Fake Press, just stated that Donald Trump has 'mixed results' on his Endorsements of Candidates, when the recent WINS of Darline Graham and Mike Mazzei, stand at 100% for the U.S. Senate, and 98% for the U.S. House, recently and over the longterm. How can anyone be allowed to say this, working for freely given Public Airwaves? Results are attached. Because of this purposeful inaccuracy, she will be reported to the FCC for rebuke or punishment," Trump wrote in a Truth Social post . A separate post from Trump yesterday said, "THE FAKE POLLS USED BY OUR CROOKED MEDIA ARE OUT OF CONTROL, AND SOMETHING MUST BE DONE ABOUT IT. FCC TO THE RESCUE! President DJT." Trump also posted a rant on Friday about New York Times journalist Maggie Haberman, calling her "an unattractive person both inside and out" who "should be forced to turn over any and all money that she’s made through her fake reporting on me." Trump referred to Haberman throughout his post as "Maggot Haberman." Read full article Comments
body.zh: 特朗普总统昨天要求联邦通信委员会惩罚或斥责一名 NBC 记者，因为该记者称他在选举支持中“结果好坏参半”。在特朗普如何利用联邦通信委员会骚扰他不喜欢的记者和新闻机构的最新例子中，他表示，《会见新闻界》主持人克里斯汀·韦尔克“将因他声称的“故意失实”而向联邦通信委员会报告，接受谴责或惩罚。 “曾经伟大的《与媒体会面》节目中不受欢迎的‘女主人’克里斯汀·维尔克，现在被认为是‘与假媒体会面’，她刚刚表示，唐纳德·特朗普对候选人的支持“结果好坏参半”，而最近达林·格雷厄姆和迈克·马泽伊在美国参议院的支持率为 100%，在美国众议院的支持率为 100%，无论是近期还是长期来看。谁能允许说呢？特朗普在《真相社会》的帖子中写道，由于这种故意的不准确行为，她将被报告给联邦通信委员会以接受谴责或惩罚。特朗普昨天在另一篇帖子中表示，“我们不诚实的媒体使用的虚假民意调查已经失控，必须对此采取措施。FCC 来救援！DJT 总统。”特朗普周五还对《纽约时报》记者玛吉·哈伯曼进行了咆哮，称她“是一个从里到外都没有吸引力的人”，“应该被迫交出她通过虚假报道我赚到的所有钱”。特朗普在整个帖子中称哈伯曼为“蛆哈伯曼”。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Words carry immense power, capable of building up or tearing down. When spoken by those in positions of authority, their impact is amplified, potentially silencing dissent or punishing perceived inaccuracies. The story of President Trump's demand to the FCC serves as a stark reminder of the need for careful speech and the potential for words to be...
reflection.zh: 言语拥有巨大的力量，既能建造也能摧毁。当权者说出的话语，其影响力会被放大，可能压制异议或惩罚被视为不准确的言论。特朗普总统要求联邦通信委员会采取行动的故事，鲜明地提醒我们言语需谨慎，以及言语可能被武器化的危险。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: “Zlibrary my beloved”: Anthropic staff chats extolling piracy cited in Sony suit
title.zh: “我心爱的Zlibrary”：Anthropic员工吹捧盗版言论被索尼诉讼引用

summary.en: A lawsuit claims that Anthropic's alleged use of pirated books and music to train its AI models, despite a prior $1.5 billion settlement, has harmed songwriters and led to AI-generated songs topping charts.
summary.zh: 一项诉讼声称，Anthropic公司在先前支付了15亿美元和解金后，仍涉嫌使用盗版书籍和音乐来训练其人工智能模型，此举损害了词曲作者的利益，并导致人工智能生成的歌曲登上排行榜。

body.en: Some of the world’s leading music publishers think that Anthropic got off too light in a historic settlement where the Claude maker paid authors $1.5 billion after admitting to pirating more than 7 million books to train AI. “$1.5 billion is obviously not a large enough settlement to deter infringing conduct by a company that has parlayed such mass infringement into a staggering $2-trillion-dollar valuation,” music publishers said in a lawsuit filed Friday. Music publishers suing Anthropic include Sony, EMI, and Warner Chappell. They alleged that Anthropic’s illegal torrenting also included “thousands upon thousands” of their copyrighted musical compositions. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 一些世界领先的音乐出版商认为，在一项历史性和解中，Anthropic 的表现太轻了。克劳德的制作者在承认盗版超过 700 万本书来训练人工智能后，向作者支付了 15 亿美元。音乐出版商在周五提起的诉讼中表示，“15 亿美元的和解金额显然不足以阻止一家公司的侵权行为，该公司已将如此大规模的侵权行为转化为惊人的 2 万亿美元估值。”起诉 Anthropic 的音乐出版商包括索尼、百代和华纳查普尔。他们声称 Anthropic 的非法洪流还包括“成千上万”他们受版权保护的音乐作品。阅读全文 评论

title.en: AI could cause global economic downturn, Andrew Bailey warns G20
title.zh: 人工智能可能导致全球经济衰退，安德鲁·贝利警告G20

summary.en: The governor of the Bank of England has warned G20 finance ministers that artificial intelligence could lead to a global economic downturn and pose significant cybersecurity risks to financial systems. Andrew Bailey stated that a collapse in the AI sector could trigger a worldwide market correction, and urged...
summary.zh: 英格兰银行行长警告G20财政部长，人工智能可能导致全球经济衰退并对金融系统构成重大的网络安全风险。安德鲁·贝利表示，人工智能行业的增长崩溃可能引发全球市场调整，并敦促公司为广泛的安全漏洞做好准备。

body.en:
The governor of the Bank of England has warned G20 finance ministers that artificial intelligence could cause a global economic downturn and pose a significant cyber security risk to financial systems.

Andrew Bailey said any collapse of growth in the AI sector could lead to a "future market correction" that spreads worldwide.

In an open letter to finance ministers in the US on Monday, he said companies around the world should prepare for security breaches "involving simultaneous disruption across multiple firms".

Earlier this month, a group of 100 firms , including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI, urged countries and groups to beef up their cyber defences before AI grows powerful enough to override them.

Bailey told the G20 finance ministers that a combination of highly priced stock markets, increased borrowing by investors, and the growing concentration of money into a small number of major technology companies could amplify any future market correction.

"The issue is not simply that investors are borrowing more, but that leverage is interacting with high valuations and market concentration, in particular the increasing cross-investment between artificial intelligence (AI) companies and hyper scalers, in a way that could amplify a future market correction," he said.

Bailey has called on those in charge of financial security to develop "appropriate steps to support safe and responsible model release and deployment on a global basis".

Bailey, who was writing in his capacity as chairman of the Financial Stability Board international watchdog (FSB), expressed concern about the "volatility" prompted by the effect of energy supply shocks caused by the US-Iran war.

His warning comes several months after UK Chancellor John Healey announced a £100m fund aimed at backing British AI start-ups .

That is part of the government's efforts to grow the country's "sovereign AI" capacity, developing homegrown AI technology to ensure the UK is not dependent on services from abroad.

Ministers want to see companies compete for the funding to help tackle challenges like cutting waiting lists in the NHS and bolstering cybersecurity and defence.

A UK government spokesperson said its new AI economics institute was working with international partners to build "a stronger shared understanding of how AI is transforming economies around the world."

"The institute is the first government-backed body of its kind focused on AI's economic impact, helping policymakers understand what AI means for growth, productivity, jobs and public services as the technology develops at pace," the spokesperson said.

But there is growing concern that AI companies are increasingly developing models that can easily override the safeguarding systems of banks and financial...
body.zh: 英国央行行长警告二十国集团财长，人工智能可能导致全球经济衰退，并对金融系统构成重大网络安全风险。 安德鲁·贝利表示，人工智能行业增长的任何崩溃都可能导致全球范围内的“未来市场调整”。 他在周一致美国财政部长的公开信中表示，世界各地的公司应该为“涉及多家公司同时中断”的安全漏洞做好准备。 本月早些时候，包括谷歌、微软、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在内的 100 家公司敦促各国和组织加强网络防御，以免人工智能强大到足以超越它们。 贝利向二十国集团财长们表示，股市价格高昂、投资者借贷增加以及资金日益集中于少数主要科技公司，这些因素结合在一起可能会放大未来的市场调整。 他表示：“问题不仅仅是投资者借入更多资金，而是杠杆与高估值和市场集中度相互作用，特别是人工智能（AI）公司和超大规模企业之间日益增加的交叉投资，从而可能放大未来的市场调整。” 贝利呼吁负责金融安全的人员制定“适当的措施，支持在全球范围内安全、负责任地发布和部署模型”。 贝利以金融稳定委员会国际监管机构（FSB）主席的身份撰写文章，对美伊战争造成的能源供应冲击所引发的“波动”表示担忧。 几个月前，英国财政大臣约翰·希利宣布设立一项旨在支持英国人工智能初创企业的 1 亿英镑基金。 这是政府增强国家“主权人工智能”能力、开发本土人工智能技术以确保英国不依赖国外服务的努力的一部分。 部长们希望看到企业争夺资金，以帮助应对诸如减少 NHS 等候名单以及加强网络安全和防御等挑战。 英国政府发言人表示，其新成立的人工智能经济研究所正在与国际合作伙伴合作，“就人工智能如何改变世界各地的经济建立更强有力的共识”。 该发言人表示：“该研究所是同类中第一个由政府支持的机构，专注于人工智能的经济影响，帮助政策制定者了解随着技术的快速发展，人工智能对增长、生产力、就业和公共服务意味着什么。” 但人们越来越担心人工智能公司正在越来越多地开发可以轻松超越银行和金融保护系统的模型......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence brings both immense promise and potential peril, as highlighted by the Bank of England's warning. Like the testing of character through praise, the development and integration of AI require careful discernment and preparation for unforeseen consequences, lest our ambition outstrip our wisdom. As we navigate...

title.en: ‘Superhuman’ AI tool spots heart disease in less than 2 seconds
title.zh: “超人”人工智能工具2秒内发现心脏病

summary.en: A new AI tool, trained on millions of routine ECGs, can detect heart disease in under two seconds by analyzing data beyond human visual capacity. This technology aims to expedite treatment for high-risk patients, potentially reducing the need for lengthy waits for echocardiograms.
summary.zh: 一款新的人工智能工具，通过对数百万份常规心电图进行训练，能在两秒内发现心脏病，其分析能力超越了人眼所能见的范畴。该技术旨在加快高风险患者的治疗进程，并可能减少对需要长时间等待的超声心动图检查的依赖。

body.en:
Doctors have developed a “superhuman” AI tool that can spot heart disease in less than two seconds.

The groundbreaking technology has been trained on millions of patients and works by extracting more information from a routine electrocardiogram (ECG) than the human eye can typically see.

The traditional ECG, which records electrical activity in the heart, including the rate and rhythm, has been a vital medical tool in diagnosing heart attacks and abnormal heart rhythms for a century.

But it cannot detect heart disease. That requires an echocardiogram, a type of ultrasound scan, which patients often have to wait months for.

Now a team have developed an AI tool that can spot signs of heart failure and heart valve disease – two of the most common forms of heart disease – from ECG results in “the blink of an eye”.

Details of the breakthrough, which could boost early diagnosis of heart disease, were presented to thousands of delegates at the European Society of Cardiology annual congress in Munich, the world’s largest heart conference.

Early diagnosis is vital for heart failure and heart valve disease, enabling those who need lifesaving medicines to be spotted sooner, before they become dangerously unwell.

The development is being seen as potentially significant, because ECGs are one of the most common tests in medicine, with about a billion performed worldwide each year.

In a trial involving 67,000 patients in the US, the AI tool was able to identify up to 81% of those who had heart failure, and up to 90% of those with heart valve disease.

Dr Sonya Babu-Narayan, a consultant cardiologist and clinical director of the British Heart Foundation (BHF), which funded the trial, said: “It is exciting to see that AI can now deliver a read-out from an ECG in what feels like the blink of an eye.

“Technology like the AI ECG in this research, which has the potential to identify high-risk patients early, will not detect everyone with a heart condition. But it could be a solution to help fast-track the patients who are most likely to have a heart abnormality. When it comes to the heart, earlier diagnosis and treatment saves and improves lives.”

The tech cannot be used on its own to definitively diagnose or rule out heart failure or heart valve disease, but it gives a very strong indication someone may have them.

Someone judged as highly likely to have either could be sent rapidly for an echocardiogram, rather than wait months on the standard waiting lists. That could mean a quicker diagnosis which would enable them to start treatment earlier.

Prof Fu Siong Ng, a professor of cardiology at Imperial College London, said: “Patients can often wait several months for a heart ultrasound scan after being referred for one by their doctor.

“This makes it exciting...
body.zh: 医生们开发出了一种“超人”的人工智能工具，可以在不到两秒的时间内发现心脏病。 这项突破性的技术已经在数百万患者身上进行了培训，其工作原理是从常规心电图 (ECG) 中提取比人眼通常可以看到的更多信息。 传统的心电图记录心脏的电活动，包括心率和节律，一个世纪以来一直是诊断心脏病和心律失常的重要医疗工具。 但它无法检测心脏病。这需要超声心动图（一种超声波扫描），患者通常需要等待数月。 现在，一个团队开发了一种人工智能工具，可以根据“眨眼间”的心电图结果发现心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病（两种最常见的心脏病形式）的迹象。 这一突破的细节可以促进心脏病的早期诊断，在慕尼黑举行的欧洲心脏病学会年会上向数千名代表介绍了这一突破，这是世界上最大的心脏病会议。 早期诊断对于心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病至关重要，使那些需要救生药物的人能够在出现危险的不适之前尽早发现。 这一发展被认为具有潜在的重大意义，因为心电图是医学中最常见的测试之一，全世界每年进行约十亿次。 在美国一项涉及 67,000 名患者的试验中，AI 工具能够识别出高达 81% 的心力衰竭患者和高达 90% 的心脏瓣膜疾病患者。 资助这项试验的英国心脏基金会 (BHF) 的心脏病专家兼临床主任索尼娅·巴布-纳拉扬 (Sonya Babu-Narayan) 博士表示：“令人兴奋的是，人工智能现在可以在眨眼的时间内读取心电图读数。 “这项研究中的人工智能心电图等技术有可能及早识别出高危患者，但无法检测出每个患有心脏病的人。但这可能是帮助快速追踪最有可能患有心脏异常的患者的解决方案。当涉及到心脏时，早期诊断和治疗可以挽救并改善生命。” 该技术不能单独用于明确诊断或排除心力衰竭或心脏瓣膜疾病，但它给出了一个非常强烈的迹象，表明某人可能患有这些疾病。 被判断为极有可能患有这两种疾病的人可以被迅速送去做超声心动图检查，而不是在标准等待名单上等待数月。这可能意味着更快的诊断，使他们能够更早地开始治疗。 伦敦帝国理工学院心脏病学教授 Fu Siong Ng 教授表示：“在医生推荐进行心脏超声扫描后，患者通常需要等待几个月才能进行心脏超声扫描。 “这让人兴奋......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in this new tool's ability to diagnose heart disease, reflects a world where human knowledge and technical capabilities are accelerating. As we witness such profound leaps in understanding and application, we are reminded of the biblical observation that in the end times, 'many will run to and fro,...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如这款能诊断心脏病的工具所示，反映了一个人类知识和技术能力日益加速的世界。当我们见证理解和应用上的巨大飞跃时，我们不禁想起圣经中的观察——在末世，“许多人往来奔跑，知识也必增长”。这种技术进步为治疗和福祉带来了巨大的潜力，呼唤我们以智慧和怜悯之心来管理它。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: ‘Scary’: how misinformation and AI hallucinations are infiltrating Australia’s parliament
title.zh: “可怕”：虚假信息和人工智能幻觉如何渗透澳大利亚议会

summary.en: Guardian analysis reveals that dozens of policy submissions across the political spectrum incorrectly summarize real research and invent or wrongly cite sources. This AI-generated material is flooding Australia's government inquiry process, inventing studies and attributing nonexistent research to real academics.
summary.zh: 《卫报》的分析显示，来自不同政治派别的数十份政策提交材料错误地总结了真实研究，并捏造或错误引用了来源。这些人工智能生成的材料充斥着澳大利亚的政府问询过程，捏造研究并将其归功于真实学者但实际上并不存在的来源。

body.en: Exclusive : Guardian analysis reveals that dozens of policy submissions from across the political spectrum incorrectly summarise real research and invent or wrongly cite sources Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia’s government inquiry process is supposed to help parliament make better decisions, hearing from experts and constituents alike. But Guardian Australia can reveal that the system is being flooded with AI-generated material, which is inventing studies and attributing nonexistent research to real academics and authors. In some cases, committee reports have cited submissions in which the majority of sources appear to be AI-generated “hallucinations”, when large language models (LLMs) invent content that looks real but doesn’t actually exist. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：《卫报》分析显示，来自各个政治派别的数十份政策提交文件错误地总结了真实的研究和发明，或错误地引用了消息来源。 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 澳大利亚政府的调查程序应该帮助议会做出更好的决策，听取专家和选民的意见。但《澳大利亚卫报》可以透露，该系统正在充斥着人工智能生成的材料，这些材料正在发明研究，并将不存在的研究归因于真正的学者和作者。在某些情况下，委员会报告引用了提交的材料，其中大多数来源似乎是人工智能生成的“幻觉”，即大型语言模型（LLM）发明了看起来真实但实际上并不存在的内容。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The infiltration of AI-generated falsehoods into parliamentary submissions is a stark reminder of the corrosive power of untruth. Ephesians 4:25 calls us to "put off falsehood and speak truthfully to one another." In an age where AI can mimic human communication, discerning truth and upholding integrity in our discourse becomes ever more critical.
reflection.zh: 人工智能生成的谎言渗透到议会提交材料中，这 stark地提醒我们虚假信息的腐蚀力量。以弗所书4:25呼吁我们“所以，你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话”。在一个人工智能可以模仿人类交流的时代，辨别真理并在我们的言论中坚守诚信变得至关重要。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。
