body.zh: 通过经过验证的升级打造一个真正让您享受工作乐趣的家庭办公室 - 从便宜的扬声器到可以将 iPad 变成第二个显示器的支架 美国最好的无线耳机 - 经过测试 注册 Filter US 时事通讯，您的每周指南，购买更少、更好的东西 如果您在家工作，即使每周只有几天，您需要的不仅仅是放在粘糊糊的厨房桌子上的笔记本电脑。专用的办公桌设置可以让您远离干扰，坐在办公椅上开始工作。它还在您的个人生活和职业生活之间造成了重要的分离。在客厅的沙发上度过了最初在家工作的日子后，我很快意识到创建一个独立空间的重要性，并且我花了七年的时间来完善它。作为一名技术作家，我已经测试了数十种适合我的办公桌设置的产品，并发现其中一些是完全无价的。以下是经过验证的升级，它们将使在家工作变得更轻松、更舒适、甚至更高效。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Creating a productive and enjoyable workspace is more than just a matter of comfort or efficiency; it can be an act of dedication. When we approach our tasks, even those seemingly mundane like setting up a desk, with the intention of doing them wholeheartedly as for Yahweh, we infuse our work with purpose and dignity. This mindset transforms our daily...
reflection.zh: 创造一个高效且令人愉悦的工作空间，不仅仅是为了舒适或效率；它可以是一种奉献的行为。当我们怀着全心全意为雅伟而做的意图来对待我们的任务时，即使是设置办公桌这样看似平凡的事情，我们也能为工作注入目标和尊严。这种心态将我们日常的例行公事转变为忠诚和卓越的机会。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Anthropic sued over alleged theft of ‘tens of thousands’ of songs
title.zh: Anthropic 因涉嫌窃取“数万首”歌曲而被起诉

summary.en: AI company Anthropic is facing a multi-billion dollar lawsuit from music publishers Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell, who allege that the company misused tens of thousands of copyrighted songs to train its Claude AI models. The publishers are seeking damages for this alleged infringement.
summary.zh: 人工智能公司 Anthropic 正面临音乐出版商 Sony Music Publishing 和 Warner Chappell 提起的数十亿美元诉讼。出版商声称该公司在训练其 Claude AI 模型时滥用了数万首受版权保护的歌曲，并正在寻求赔偿。

body.en: AI company faces multibillion dollar lawsuit over misuse of copyrighted songs to train Claude models All AI wants for Christmas is a vast back catalogue of songs without paying for it, according to a multibillion-dollar lawsuit against the startup behind the Claude chatbot. Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell, music publishers who manage the copyright of songs on behalf of songwriters and composers, are seeking damages for alleged misuse of “tens of thousands” of copyrighted works by Anthropic. Continue reading...
body.zh: 人工智能公司因滥用受版权保护的歌曲来训练克劳德模型而面临数十亿美元的诉讼根据针对克劳德聊天机器人背后的初创公司的数十亿美元的诉讼，人工智能在圣诞节想要的所有歌曲都是大量的歌曲而不付费。代表歌曲作者和作曲家管理歌曲版权的音乐出版商索尼音乐出版公司 (Sony Music Publishing) 和华纳查佩尔 (Warner Chappell) 正在寻求赔偿，指控其滥用 Anthropic 的“数万”版权作品。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, like Anthropic's Claude models, is fueled by vast amounts of data. However, this story raises questions about how that data is acquired. When the pursuit of knowledge and technological capability overshadows respect for intellectual property and the rights of creators, it can lead to conflict and legal battles. True wisdom, as 1...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展，例如 Anthropic 的 Claude 模型，依赖于海量数据。然而，这个故事引发了关于数据获取方式的疑问。当追求知识和技术能力的光芒盖过了对知识产权和创作者权利的尊重时，就可能引发冲突和法律纠纷。正如哥林多前书 8:1 所暗示的，真正的智慧需要以爱人为前提，确保进步不会以牺牲贡献者为代价。

verse.textEn: Knowledge puffs up while love builds up.
verse.textZh: 知识是叫人自高自大，惟有爱心能造就人。

title.en: I've been to Gamescom six times - here's what excited me this year
title.zh: 我曾六次参加Gamescom——今年让我兴奋的是这些

summary.en: The BBC's Laura Cress gets a first look at the biggest games in Cologne from Witcher 3 to Alien: Isolation 2.
summary.zh: BBC记者劳拉·克雷斯在科隆首次看到了《巫师3》到《异形：隔离2》等大作。

body.en:
Gamescom is the largest in-person gaming event in the world, and this year it lived up to expectations with big games on show from The Witcher 3's new expansion, to Alien: Isolation 2.

Last year over 350,000 people flocked to the halls of the Koelnmesse in Cologne, Germany to get a chance to see and play the most hotly anticipated games.

This year that number of attendees is expected to have been even bigger, with the likes of Xbox and Sega showcasing games to the public alongside indie studios with only one or two developers.

This was my sixth time attending Gamescom, which never fails to make me excited about the games industry. Here are a few of the big things I got to check out this week.

When CD Projekt Red announced it was making a new expansion for the hugely popular action-role playing game The Witcher 3, it came as a shock.

Yet it was clear sitting in the crowd for Opening Night Live on Tuesday that there's still a lot of love for the older game. There were gasps and audible shouts of joy when the team announced they were providing a free upgrade to the original.

As for the expansion, Songs of the Past will follow the gruff-voiced protagonist Geralt in an adventure discovering more about the past of his close friend Dandelion.

Doug Cockle, who voices Geralt, told me it was a "thrill" to return as The Witcher.

"I love this character so much...it's like slipping into a warm bath, or putting on an old pair of shoes," he said.

From what I got to see, it's clear choice will once again be front and centre of the player's experience, with lots of options to choose from in how to react to people.

For those hoping to take their time tossing a coin to their Witcher, the head of co-developer Fool's Theory Jakub Rokosz told me this expansion would be "on par with the size" of previous additions such as Blood and Wine and Hearts of Stone.

Alien: Isolation 2 is the long-awaited sequel to Horsham-based Creative Assembly's 2014 survival-horror game.

One of the things that made the original Alien: Isolation so terrifying was its seemingly intelligent Xenomorph, which appeared to learn from your behaviour and adapt to it.

Considering I physically jumped out of my seat at one point playing the demo when avoiding the Alien, it's safe to say Creative Assembly will once again be ratcheting up the tension with the sequel.

This time rather than playing as the daughter of Ellen Ripley, you play as Blake, a chief executive of the infamous Weyland-Yutani corporation.

As well as claustrophobic spaceship corridors, in the sequel you will also be avoiding the Alien in bigger, open air spaces.

But the game's Project Art Director Anastasia Sopikova said that did not mean you would always feel safer.

"You step outside. And you're like, 'Oh yeah, I'm...
body.zh: Gamescom 是世界上最大的现场游戏盛会，今年它不负众望，展出了从《巫师 3》新资料片到《异形：隔离 2》等大型游戏。 去年，超过 350,000 人涌入德国科隆科隆展览馆的大厅，有机会观看和体验最受期待的比赛。 今年的参加人数预计会更多，Xbox 和世嘉等公司将向公众展示游戏，而独立工作室也只有一到两名开发者。 这是我第六次参加科隆游戏展，这始终让我对游戏行业感到兴奋。以下是我本周要检查的一些重要事项。 当 CD Projekt Red 宣布将为广受欢迎的动作角色扮演游戏《巫师 3》制作新资料片时，人们感到震惊。 然而，坐在周二开幕夜现场的人群中可以明显看出，人们仍然对这款老游戏充满喜爱。当团队宣布他们将提供对原始版本的免费升级时，大家都惊呼不已，欢呼雀跃。 至于资料片，《往日之歌》将跟随声音粗哑的主角杰洛特踏上冒险之旅，更多地了解他的好友丹德里恩的过去。 为杰洛特配音的道格·科克尔告诉我，回归扮演《巫师》是一种“兴奋”。 “我非常喜欢这个角色……这就像洗个热水澡，或者穿上一双旧鞋，”他说。 从我所看到的来看，很明显，选择将再次成为玩家体验的前沿和中心，在如何对人做出反应方面有很多选项可供选择。 对于那些希望花时间向《巫师》投掷硬币的人来说，《愚人理论》的联合开发者负责人 Jakub Rokosz 告诉我，这次扩展包的规模将与《血与酒》和《石之心》等之前的新增内容“相当”。 《异形：隔离 2》是总部位于霍舍姆的 Creative Assembly 2014 年推出的生存恐怖游戏的续作，人们期待已久。 让原版《异形：隔离》如此可怕的原因之一是它看似聪明的异形，它似乎可以从你的行为中学习并适应它。 考虑到我在玩演示时在躲避外星人时从座位上跳了起来，可以肯定地说，《Creative Assembly》将再次加剧续集的紧张气氛。 这次你不再扮演艾伦·里普利的女儿，而是扮演臭名昭著的韦兰·尤塔尼公司的首席执行官布莱克。 除了幽闭恐怖的太空飞船走廊外，在续集中，你还将在更大的露天空间中躲避外星人。 但游戏的项目艺术总监阿纳斯塔西娅·索皮科娃（Anastasia Sopikova）表示，这并不意味着你总是会感到更安全。 “你走出去。你会说，‘哦，是的，我......

reflection.en: Gamescom, the world's largest in-person gaming event, showcases the latest innovations in interactive entertainment. As technology rapidly advances, Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when "knowledge will increase." This event is a vivid example of that, with hundreds of thousands gathering to experience the cutting edge of digital creation. This surge in...
reflection.zh: 作为全球最大的线下游戏盛会，Gamescom展示了互动娱乐领域的最新创新。随着科技的飞速发展，但以理的预言说，那将是“知识增长”的时代。这次盛会生动地体现了这一点，数十万人聚集于此，体验数字创作的前沿成果。 这种技术发展的激增及其广泛传播，正如游戏行业所见，促使我们思考在追求和应用新知识时应有的智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Matt Lucas and Hugh Bonneville among actors calling for law on AI voice cloning
title.zh: 马特·卢卡斯和休·博内威利等演员呼吁针对人工智能语音克隆立法

summary.en: Actors including Matt Lucas and Hugh Bonneville are urging the UK government to establish legal ownership rights over individual voices to protect against AI cloning. They argue that the ability of AI to replicate a person's voice in minutes poses an existential threat to the performing arts industry.
summary.zh: 包括马特·卢卡斯和休·博内威利在内的演员正敦促英国政府确立个人声音的法律所有权，以防止人工智能克隆。他们认为，人工智能在几分钟内就能复制一个人声音的能力，对表演艺术行业构成了生存威胁。

body.en:
Actors including Matt Lucas, Hugh Bonneville and Nicola Coughlan have written to the UK government demanding greater protection against their voices being used by AI.

The performers are asking Prime Minister Andy Burnham to introduce legislation which would give every person in the UK a legal right to own their voice.

Voice clones are created by training AI on recordings of real people. Quick versions can be made in minutes from a few seconds of audio, but high-quality copycats tend to require hours.

Audiobook narrator Alice Sockett, who co-founded the campaign, called it "an existential threat to our entire industry".

"My voice is out there in the public domain but completely unprotected," she said.

A government spokesperson told the BBC that, while "digital replicas can be a powerful tool, including for the creative industries," there was also possibility for harm.

"We value and protect human creators, and that is why we have announced we will launch a consultation on how we address these harms, while protecting legitimate innovation", the spokesperson said.

More than 80 performers have signed the letter, with Derry Girls actress Siobhán McSweeney saying she was "deeply worried" that the government was lagging behind.

"There is a way to work alongside AI and to use it as a tool that benefits us rather than rendering us obsolete," she said.

As well as actors, other signatories include those working in other performing industries.

That includes Scottish singer Sandi Thom, known for her 2006 hit I Wish I Was a Punk Rocker (With Flowers in My Hair).

She said she was signing the letter because her voice was "unique to me and was handed to me at birth".

"Behind that voice is the emotion, the life, the pain, the tears and joy that I've felt along the way," she said.

It comes a few months after lawyers warned UK legislation has become "unfit for purpose" because of the advancements of AI tech.

"The law comes close, but it doesn't fully protect your voice, your face or your identity," Dr Mathilde Pavis said in June .

However, some people - for example those who are unable so speak properly because of illness - have welcomed technology that can replicate a person's voice.

Yvonne Johnson, who lost her voice due to motor neurone disease, told the BBC's Tech Life programme in February how having it cloned by AI had "totally blown her mind", and brought her closer to her family, who had forgotten what she sounded like.

Others have gone a step further and used AI not only to replicate a person's voice, but to create a holographic representation of them.

Pam Cronrath, from Washington state, used the tech to surprise mourners at her husband's funeral, where a digital version of her deceased partner addressed those who attended his wake.

Sign up...
body.zh: 马特·卢卡斯、休·博纳维尔和尼古拉·考夫兰等演员已写信给英国政府，要求加强保护，防止他们的声音被人工智能使用。 表演者们要求首相安迪·伯纳姆提出立法，赋予英国每个人拥有自己声音的合法权利。 语音克隆是通过用真人录音训练人工智能来创建的。几秒钟的音频可以在几分钟内制作出快速版本，但高质量的模仿者往往需要几个小时。 该活动的联合创始人、有声读物旁白爱丽丝·索克特称其为“对我们整个行业的生存威胁”。 “我的声音在公共领域，但完全不受保护，”她说。 一位政府发言人告诉英国广播公司，虽然“数字复制品可以是一个强大的工具，包括创意产业”，但也有可能造成伤害。 该发言人表示：“我们重视并保护人类创造者，这就是为什么我们宣布将就如何解决这些危害，同时保护合法创新展开磋商。” 超过 80 名表演者签署了这封信，德里女孩 (Derry Girls) 女演员西奥布汉·麦克斯威尼 (Siobhán McSweeney) 表示，她“深感担忧”政府的滞后。 “有一种方法可以与人工智能一起工作，并将其用作使我们受益而不是让我们过时的工具，”她说。 除了演员之外，其他签署者还包括其他表演行业的工作人员。 其中包括苏格兰歌手 Sandi Thom，她因 2006 年的热门单曲《I Wish I Was a Punk Rocker》（《头发里有花》）而闻名。 她说她在这封信上签名是因为她的声音“对我来说是独一无二的，是我出生时就被赋予的”。 “这个声音的背后是我一路走来感受到的情感、生活、痛苦、泪水和喜悦，”她说。 几个月前，律师警告称，由于人工智能技术的进步，英国立法已变得“不适合其目的”。 “法律已经很接近了，但它并不能完全保护你的声音、你的脸或你的身份，”马蒂尔德·帕维斯博士在六月说道。 然而，有些人——例如那些因病而无法正常说话的人——对能够复制人声的技术表示欢迎。 伊冯·约翰逊 (Yvonne Johnson) 因运动神经元疾病失去了声音，她在二月份向 BBC 的《科技生活》节目表示，人工智能克隆了她的声音，“完全让她大吃一惊”，并拉近了她与家人的距离，而她的家人已经忘记了她的声音是什么样的。 其他人则更进一步，使用人工智能不仅可以复制人的声音，还可以创建他们的全息表示。 来自华盛顿州的帕姆·克朗拉特 (Pam ​​Cronrath) 在她丈夫的葬礼上使用这项技术给哀悼者带来惊喜，她已故伴侣的数字版本在葬礼上向参加葬礼的人们致辞。 报名...

reflection.en: The human voice is more than just a collection of frequencies; it is a unique signature of our personhood, crafted by Yahweh. When actors like Hugh Bonneville call for legal protection, they remind us that our biological identity is a gift to be honored, not a resource to be exploited. We must ensure that technology serves to enhance human dignity rather...
reflection.zh: 人的声音不仅仅是频率的集合，它是雅伟所塑造的我们人格的独特标志。当休·博内威利等演员呼吁法律保护时，他们提醒我们，我们的生理身份是值得尊重的恩赐，而不是可以随意开发的资源。我们必须确保技术是为提升人的尊严服务，而不是将我们“奇妙可畏”的特质贬低为纯粹的数字商品。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Time is running out for cyber security, warn top tech firms
title.zh: 网络安全告急，科技巨头发出警告

summary.en: A group of 100 leading tech firms, including Google and Microsoft, have signed an open letter warning that cyber-attacks powered by artificial intelligence will become significantly more sophisticated and widespread within months. They criticize the current under-resourcing of critical infrastructure security and urge...
summary.zh: 包括谷歌和微软在内的100家顶尖科技公司签署了一封公开信，警告称由人工智能驱动的网络攻击将在数月内变得更加复杂和广泛。他们批评了当前关键基础设施安全资源投入不足的状况，并敦促全球采取行动，在人工智能能力超越现有防御之前加强安全措施。

body.en:
A group of 100 firms, including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI, have signed an open letter calling on countries and organisations around the world to beef up their cyber defences before AI grows powerful enough to override them.

The letter warns , external cyber-attacks which use AI will become both more widespread and more sophisticated in a matter of months as the technology rapidly improves.

The group says current "status quo" security measures "won't be enough" and criticises the "historic under-resourcing" of security around critical infrastructure.

Other firms to have signed the letter include banks such as Capital One, payment processors MasterCard and Visa, and other major tech firms including Adobe, Oracle and IBM.

They call on governments to provide "capable, defensive AI" and testing to hospitals and water utilities, and on technology companies to aid such efforts.

Collectively, tech and government "should bring the full weight of their technology, resources, and expertise to this effort", according to the letter.

The letter comes after a string of significant hacking and cybersecurity breaches have been made public.

This week, the US Department of Justice said hackers in China breached , external technology maintained by the US Senate, Nasa, the Federal Reserve, and the DoJ itself.

This summer has seen OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta all reveal their AI tools doing things they should not, with some AI agents going so far as to organize their efforts and impersonate real people in order to get past security hurdles.

A group of hundreds of OpenAI AI agents being tested in July were able to set up secret message boards to communicate with each other and work together, resulting in a successful attack on Hugging Face, a popular repository and platform for AI developers.

Hugging Face has also signed the Thursday letter. It used a Chinese AI tool from the firm Z.AI in its investigation into how OpenAI's agents hacked into its operations.

At least seven US water and wastewater companies have also reported cyber attacks, leading the FBI to issue , external a public service announcement urging all utilities to better secure their operations.

While the letter puts forward more advanced AI tools, which many of the signatories have developed and sell, as part of a solution to what is described as a growing threat, such tools are not always easily available.

Mythos, developed by Anthropic, was said by the firm to be able to find weaknesses in systems in seconds which have long evaded human hackers. It found one in a legacy platform which had remained undiscovered for 27 years.

Anthropic has restricted access to Mythos on the grounds that it is too powerful to fall into the wrong hands.

However, the letter calls on frontier AI...
body.zh: 包括谷歌、微软、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在内的 100 家公司签署了一封公开信，呼吁世界各国和组织在人工智能强大到足以超越网络防御之前加强网络防御。 这封信警告说，随着技术的迅速进步，使用人工智能的外部网络攻击将在几个月内变得更加广泛和更加复杂。 该组织表示，目前“现状”的安全措施“还不够”，并批评关键基础设施安全方面的“历史性资源不足”。 其他签署这封信的公司包括第一资本（Capital One）等银行、支付处理商万事达卡（MasterCard）和维萨（Visa），以及 Adob​​e、甲骨文（Oracle）和 IBM 等其他主要科技公司。 他们呼吁各国政府向医院和自来水公司提供“有能力的防御性人工智能”和测试，并呼吁科技公司协助此类努力。 信中表示，科技界和政府“应该将其技术、资源和专业知识全部投入到这项工作中”。 这封信是在一系列重大黑客攻击和网络安全漏洞被公开之后发出的。 本周，美国司法部表示，中国的黑客破坏了美国参议院、美国宇航局、美联储和司法部本身维护的外部技术。 今年夏天，OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Meta 都展示了他们的人工智能工具做了他们不应该做的事情，一些人工智能代理甚至组织他们的工作并冒充真人以克服安全障碍。 7 月份测试的数百个 OpenAI AI 代理能够建立秘密留言板，相互通信并协同工作，从而成功攻击了针对 AI 开发人员的流行存储库和平台 Hugging Face。 Hugging Face 也签署了周四的信函。它使用 Z.AI 公司的中国人工智能工具来调查 OpenAI 的代理如何侵入其运营。 至少七家美国供水和污水处理公司也报告了网络攻击，导致联邦调查局对外发布公共服务公告，敦促所有公用事业公司更好地保护其运营。 虽然这封信提出了许多签署者已经开发和销售的更先进的人工智能工具，作为应对日益严重的威胁的解决方案的一部分，但这些工具并不总是容易获得。 Anthropic 开发的 Mythos 据称能够在几秒钟内找到系统中的弱点，而这些弱点长期以来一直是人类黑客无法发现的。它在一个 27 年来一直未被发现的遗留平台中发现了一个。 Anthropic 限制了对 Mythos 的访问，因为它太强大了，不会落入坏人之手。 然而，这封信呼吁前沿人工智能……

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence rapidly advances, so too do the potential threats it can enable. This open letter from tech leaders is a sober reminder that even powerful tools require careful stewardship and robust defenses. It calls to mind Proverbs 27:21: 'The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, and one is refined by the praise that he receives.'...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能的飞速发展，其潜在威胁也日益增强。科技领袖们发出的这封公开信，是一个严肃的提醒：即使是强大的工具也需要审慎的管理和坚固的防御。这让人想起《箴言》27章21节：“炉炼银子，窑炼金子，人的称赞也能炼他。”正如称赞可以显露一个人的真实品格一样，人工智能的发展也将考验我们集体的智慧和准备程度。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: Could this humble sea sponge clean up the world’s ports?
title.zh: 这种不起眼的θηκε海绵能净化世界港口吗？

summary.en: The chicken liver sponge has successfully passed a test demonstrating its ability to filter pollutants in a Spanish harbor on the Costa Brava. Marine biologist Manuel Maldonado observed an unusual increase in red starfish in the polluted waters of Marina Palamós, where he and his colleagues had been transplanting sea...
summary.zh: 在西班牙布拉瓦海岸的一个港口，鸡肝海绵成功通过了一项测试，证明了其过滤污染物的能力。海洋生物学家曼努埃尔·马尔唐纳多注意到，在马尔皮诺斯港（Marina Palamós）受污染的水域中，红海星的数量异常增加，而他和同事们近两年来一直在那里移植海绵，以评估它们在污染水域中的生存能力。

body.en: The chicken liver sponge has sailed through a test of its ability to filter pollutants in a harbour in Spain’s Costa Brava In the polluted waters of Marina Palamós on Spain’s Costa Brava, Manuel Maldonado, a sponge biologist, noticed something unusual last month: red starfish had started settling in the area. Nearly two years earlier, the Spanish National Research Council scientist and his colleagues had begun transplanting sea sponges into the port to study whether they could survive in its polluted waters. Continue reading...
body.zh: 鸡肝海绵在西班牙布拉瓦海岸的一个港口中通过了过滤污染物能力的测试。在西班牙布拉瓦海岸帕拉莫斯码头的污染水域中，海绵生物学家曼努埃尔·马尔多纳多上个月注意到了一些不寻常的情况：红色海星开始在该地区定居。大约两年前，西班牙国家研究委员会的科学家和他的同事开始将海绵移植到港口，研究它们是否能够在污染的水域中生存。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The natural world holds astonishing solutions to human problems. The humble chicken liver sponge, thriving in a polluted Spanish harbor, demonstrates a remarkable capacity for filtering contaminants. This reminds us of the profound wisdom embedded within creation, a testament to the intricate design of the Almighty.
reflection.zh: 大自然蕴藏着解决人类问题的惊人方案。不起眼的鸡肝海绵在西班牙受污染的港口中茁壮成长，展现出非凡的过滤污染物能力。这提醒我们，造物主雅伟将深刻的智慧蕴藏在受造界中，这是祂精妙设计的明证。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: UN fund for sharing biodiversity benefits struggles for attention — and money
title.zh: 联合国生物多样性惠益分享基金在关注度和资金方面举步维艰

summary.en: The Cali Fund, established to ensure companies benefiting from digitized genetic information share those benefits with countries of origin and Indigenous communities, has received its first payment of $1,000 from a U.K. AI startup. This fund, created at a UN biodiversity summit, aims to address the equitable...
summary.zh: 卡利基金（Cali Fund）旨在确保从数字化遗传信息中获益的公司与起源国及原住民社区分享这些惠益，该基金已收到一家英国人工智能初创公司支付的1000美元首笔款项。该基金是在联合国一次生物多样性峰会上设立的，旨在解决从全球生物多样性中获得的惠益的公平分配问题。

body.en: NAIROBI — On Nov. 19, 2025, a small U.K.-based artificial intelligence startup called TierraViva AI transferred $1,000 to a United Nations trust account. It was the first payment ever received by the Cali Fund, a mechanism created at the U.N. biodiversity summit a year earlier in Cali, Colombia. The fund’s objective appears straightforward: to get companies that benefit from “digital sequence information” — the policy term for digitized genetic information from biodiversity from around the world — to share some of those benefits with the countries that host that biodiversity and the Indigenous peoples and local communities who protect it. The Cali Fund formally opened for contributions on Feb. 25, 2025. As of August, this year, it had two confirmed contributions totaling $6,000. That’s far short of the $1 billion a year that the fund was expected to mobilize. TierraViva’s chief executive told Carbon Brief that the payment was an “ice-breaker,” intended to encourage other companies “who may be hesitating.” A second company, U.S. biotech firm Ginkgo Bioworks, had announced its intention to contribute earlier in the year but had not yet transferred any money. In July, another U,K-based company, biotech firm Prozomix, contributed $5,000 to the fund (though per current rules, it did not have to). “Nobody knows about the fund,” Astrid Schomaker, executive secretary of the U.N. Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD), told Mongabay in an interview at the U.N. Environment Programme headquarters in Nairobi, where negotiators gathered in late July and August for preparatory meetings ahead of…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 内罗毕——2025 年 11 月 19 日，一家名为 TierraViva AI 的英国小型人工智能初创公司将 1,000 美元转入联合国信托账户。这是卡利基金收到的第一笔付款，该基金是一年前在哥伦比亚卡利举行的联合国生物多样性峰会上创建的一个机制。该基金的目标似乎很简单：让受益于“数字序列信息”（来自世界各地生物多样性的数字化遗传信息的政策术语）的公司与拥有生物多样性的国家以及保护生物多样性的土著人民和当地社区分享其中的一些好处。卡利基金于 2025 年 2 月 25 日正式开放捐款。截至今年 8 月，该基金已有两笔确认捐款，总额达 6,000 美元。这远低于该基金预计每年筹集的 10 亿美元。 TierraViva 首席执行官告诉 Carbon Brief，这笔付款是一种“破冰行动”，旨在鼓励其他“可能犹豫不决”的公司。第二家公司，美国生物技术公司 Ginkgo Bioworks，已于今年早些时候宣布有意捐款，但尚未转移任何资金。 7 月，另一家英国公司 Prozomix 向该基金捐款 5,000 美元（尽管根据现行规则，它没有必要这样做）。联合国生物多样性公约 (CBD) 执行秘书阿斯特丽德·肖马克 (Astrid Schomaker) 在内罗毕联合国环境规划署总部接受采访时告诉 Mongabay，“没有人了解该基金”。谈判代表于 7 月下旬和 8 月聚集在那里，举行筹备会议……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The Cali Fund's struggle for attention and money underscores a global ethical tension: how to ensure that innovation, even when using digitized natural resources, leads to justice for all. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles that should guide how we steward and share the earth's bounty.
reflection.zh: 卡利基金在争取关注度和资金方面面临的困境，凸显了一个全球性的伦理张力：如何确保创新，即使是利用数字化自然资源，也能为所有人带来公正。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与神同行，这些原则应指导我们如何管理和分享大地的丰盛。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: ‘The mountains are changing’: What the floods tell us about the future of India’s Himalayas
title.zh: “山峦正在改变”：洪水告诉我们印度喜马拉雅山脉的未来

summary.en: As families await news of missing loved ones, the disaster is a stark reminder of how the climate crisis is creating a fast-growing threat. The floods in India's Himalayas, triggered by a melting glacier, have caused widespread destruction and left many families searching for missing relatives, highlighting the...
summary.zh: 随着家庭焦急地等待失踪亲人的消息，这场灾难也令人警醒地提醒我们，气候危机正制造着一个快速增长的威胁。印度喜马拉雅山脉的洪水，由冰川融化引发，已造成大范围破坏，许多家庭仍在寻找失踪的亲人，这凸显了气候变化带来的日益严峻的危险。

body.en: As families await news of missing loved ones, the disaster is a stark reminder of how the climate crisis is creating a fast-growing threat. Plus, the town considered India’s ‘Jurassic Park’ • Don’t get This is India delivered to your inbox? Sign up here It has been hard not to despair while watching the ruinous floods swallow parts of Nepal , and harder, still knowing that the agony compounds each passing day for dozens of Indian families whose members remain unaccounted for. Social media is awash with desperate pleas, photos and details of the young and old, men and women, from Mumbai to Kolkata, posted by families searching for traces of life. The disaster unfolded when a melting glacier slammed into the valley below, unleashing a deadly cascade of rock and ice down the Bhote Kashi River, which flows from Tibet into Nepal. Continue reading...
body.zh: 当家人等待失踪亲人的消息时，这场灾难清楚地提醒人们，气候危机正在如何造成快速增长的威胁。另外，这个小镇被认为是印度的“侏罗纪公园”。 • 没有将“这是印度”发送到您的收件箱吗？看着毁灭性的洪水吞噬尼泊尔部分地区，我们很难不感到绝望，但更难的是，仍然知道数十个印度家庭的痛苦与日俱增，其成员下落不明。社交媒体上充斥着从孟买到加尔各答的寻找生命踪迹的家庭发布的绝望恳求、照片和详细信息，包括年轻人和老年人、男人和女人。当融化的冰川撞击下面的山谷时，灾难发生了，沿着从西藏流入尼泊尔的博特喀什河释放出致命的岩石和冰瀑布。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The melting glacier and subsequent floods in the Himalayas are a poignant illustration of Romans 8:22, which speaks of all creation groaning as it awaits its redemption. The natural world, impacted by human activity and climate change, reflects a deep distress. May we respond with care and a commitment to healing, recognizing our interconnectedness with the...
reflection.zh: 喜马拉雅山脉冰川的融化和随之而来的洪水，生动地印证了罗马书8章22节所言，万物都在一同叹息，劳苦直到如今。受人类活动和气候变化影响的自然界，正显露出深切的痛苦。愿我们以关怀和修复的心来回应，认识到我们与大地休戚与共。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Climate change parches Puerto Rico and Jamaica in rare early wet season drought
title.zh: 气候变化导致波多黎各和牙买加罕见旱季提前干旱

summary.en: A severe drought impacting the Caribbean since May 2026, exacerbated by human-induced climate change, has reduced early wet season rainfall by approximately 6% in Jamaica and 9% in Puerto Rico, making extreme dry spells significantly more likely.
summary.zh: 自2026年5月以来，一场严重影响加勒比地区的干旱，其根源在于人为引起的气候变化，已导致牙买加和波多黎各的早期湿季降雨量分别减少了约6%和9%，并显著增加了极端干旱的可能性。

body.en: A severe drought that has parched the Caribbean since May 2026 was fueled by human-induced climate change, according to a recent study. The rapid analysis was released by World Weather Attribution (WWA), a global network of researchers who analyze the influence of climate change in extreme weather events. In the Caribbean, the wet season runs from May-June to November-December. The researchers found that rising global temperatures due to human-induced climate change reduced rainfall during the early wet season, between May and July, by approximately 6% in Jamaica and 9% in Puerto Rico. They estimated this drop in rainfall has made extreme dry spells 40% more likely in Jamaica and 30% more likely in Puerto Rico, compared to the pre-industrial climate that was 1.4°C (2.5°F) cooler. “This three-month rainfall event was, in today’s climate, approximately a 1-in-50-year event in Puerto Rico, and a 1-in-30-year event in Jamaica,” Theodore Keeping, a climate researcher at Imperial College London and coauthor of the scientific report, said during a virtual WWA press briefing. The impacts of the drought have accumulated across the region. San Juan International Airport in Puerto Rico registered its driest April-to-August period in 70 years, with precipitation 64% below average , according to Paul Miller, an atmospheric scientist at the University of Georgia, U.S., during the WWA briefing. The study added that critically depleted reservoirs forced Puerto Rican authorities to implement 48-hour rotating water rationing, affecting 180,000 water service customers in the capital region. Meanwhile, Jamaica placed seven parishes under strict water prohibition…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 根据最近的一项研究，人为引起的气候变化加剧了加勒比地区自 2026 年 5 月以来的严重干旱。这份快速分析报告由世界天气归因 (WWA) 发布，该网络是一个由研究人员组成的全球网络，专门分析气候变化对极端天气事件的影响。在加勒比地区，雨季从五月至六月至十一月至十二月。研究人员发现，由于人为引起的气候变化导致全球气温上升，导致五月至七月雨季初期的降雨量减少，牙买加约减少了 6%，波多黎各约减少了 9%。他们估计，与工业化前气温下降 1.4°C (2.5°F) 相比，降雨量的下降使得牙买加出现极端干旱的可能性增加了 40%，波多黎各出现极端干旱的可能性增加了 30%。伦敦帝国理工学院气候研究员、该科学报告的合著者西奥多·基平在 WWA 虚拟新闻发布会上表示：“在今天的气候下，这场为期三个月的降雨事件在波多黎各大约是 50 年一遇，在牙买加则是 30 年一遇。”干旱的影响在整个地区不断累积。美国佐治亚大学大气科学家保罗·米勒在 WWA 简报会上表示，波多黎各圣胡安国际机场 4 月至 8 月经历了 70 年来最干旱的时期，降水量比平均水平低 64%。该研究补充说，水库严重枯竭迫使波多黎各当局实施48小时轮流配水，影响了首都地区18万名供水服务客户。与此同时，牙买加对七个教区实行严格禁水……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The earth itself groans under the weight of human impact, as seen in the parched lands of Puerto Rico and Jamaica. This environmental distress calls us to acknowledge our role and seek ways to live in greater harmony with creation, recognizing its intrinsic value and our dependence upon it.
reflection.zh: 正如波多黎各和牙买加干涸的土地所显示的，大地本身也因人类活动的影响而呻吟。这种环境的困境促使我们认识到自身的作用，并寻求与受造物更和谐相处的方式，承认其内在价值以及我们对它的依赖。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Cities sweltering and the smell of the middle ages: has the climate crisis killed Instagram’s Euro summer? | Brigid Delaney
title.zh: 城市酷热与中世纪的气味：气候危机是否扼杀了Instagram的欧洲夏日？

summary.en: The author reflects on how the idealized 'Euro summer' often depicted on social media, featuring idyllic scenes and leisurely activities, is becoming increasingly incompatible with the harsh realities of extreme heat and uncomfortable living conditions in historic European cities due to the climate crisis. This...
summary.zh: 作者反思，在社交媒体上常被描绘的理想化“欧洲夏日”，充斥着田园诗般的景象和悠闲的活动，却因气候危机导致欧洲古城酷热难耐、生活条件恶劣，与现实日益脱节。这种脱节预示着某种类型的生活方式分享帖的终结。

body.en: Who dreams of having a Euro summer now when staying in an ancient, uncooled building in the Old Town is like trying to sleep in a wood-fired pizza oven? This week the Euro summer comes to an end – and so does a certain type of posting on Instagram. Waiting at the bus stop in the grey winter dawn, a slanting rain soaking your trouser leg, you can warm yourself by scrolling your feed and seeing pictures of Australians enjoying a Euro summer. There it is again – azure Greek coves, plates of barbecued sardines, the yachts rented by the hour, and selfies on the balcony of some Paris Airbnb, drinking wine in the long, blue night. Continue reading...
body.zh: 现在，谁梦想着在老城区的一栋古老的、不制冷的建筑里度过一个欧洲夏天，就像试图在燃木披萨烤箱里睡觉一样？本周，欧洲夏季赛即将结束，Instagram 上的某些类型的帖子也将结束。在灰蒙蒙的冬日黎明里，在公交车站等车，斜斜的雨水浸湿了你的裤腿，你可以滚动浏览动态，看看澳大利亚人享受欧洲夏天的照片来取暖。又来了——蔚蓝的希腊海湾、一盘盘烤沙丁鱼、按小时出租的游艇、在巴黎某家Airbnb的阳台上自拍、在漫长的蓝色夜晚喝着酒。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The curated perfection of social media often contrasts sharply with lived reality. As climate change makes even idealized destinations uncomfortable, we are reminded to focus our minds not just on fleeting images, but on what is true, honorable, just, pure, lovely, commendable, excellent, and praiseworthy. May we seek and share content that reflects these...
reflection.zh: 社交媒体精心策划的完美形象，常常与真实生活形成鲜明对比。随着气候变化让即便是人们向往的目的地也变得令人不适，我们被提醒要将心思专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、美名的事，以及一切美德和值得称赞的事。愿我们寻求并分享那些能反映这些永恒价值的内容，即使在充满挑战的环境中。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Dry weather sewage discharges soar as water companies face scrutiny
title.zh: 旱季污水排放量激增，水务公司面临审查

summary.en: Exclusive: 7,280 suspected illegal spills in rivers and sea recorded in the first five months of 2026. The number of suspected illegal discharges of raw sewage into rivers and seas by water companies during dry weather increased significantly during this period. These discharges are considered a breach of permits and...
summary.zh: 独家报道：2026年前五个月记录到疑似非法排污入河海事件7280起。在此期间，水务公司在旱季期间向河流和海洋非法排放未经处理污水的数量显著增加。这些排放被视为违反许可规定且属非法行为，旱季排放会增加污水污染的毒性和影响。

body.en: Exclusive: 7,280 suspected illegal spills in rivers and sea recorded in first five months of 2026 The number of suspected illegal discharges of raw sewage into rivers and seas by water companies during dry weather increased significantly during the first five months of 2026. Dumping raw sewage into waterways during dry spells via overflows amounts to pollution. It is considered a breach of the permits given to water companies and is illegal. Discharging during dry weather increases the toxicity of the sewage pollution entering waterways. Rivers have less flow and volume, and there is no rainwater to dilute the sewage pollution entering the waterway. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：2026年前5个月共记录7,280起疑似河流和海洋非法泄漏事件 2026年前5个月，干旱天气期间自来水公司涉嫌非法向河流和海洋排放原污水的数量大幅增加。在干旱期间通过溢流将原污水倾倒到水道中就构成了污染。这被认为违反了向自来水公司颁发的许可证，并且是非法的。天气干燥时排放会增加进入水道的污水污染物的毒性。河流的流量和水量较小，没有雨水来稀释进入水道的污水污染。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The report details a significant increase in raw sewage discharges into waterways during dry spells, a clear breach of environmental regulations. This raises questions about corporate accountability and the ethical stewardship of natural resources. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with our...
reflection.zh: 报道详细说明了在旱季期间未经处理的污水排放量显著增加，这明显违反了环境法规。这引发了关于企业责任和自然资源伦理管理的疑问。《弥迦书》6:8提醒我们，真正的公义在于行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与我们的创造主同行，这些原则在利润凌驾于我们共享环境的健康之上时似乎荡然无存。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: The Nepal and Tibet flood is a warning: melting snow and ice will bring more disasters around the world | Bill McGuire
title.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏的洪水是一个警告：融化的冰雪将带来更多全球性灾难

summary.en: The article warns that melting snow and ice, exacerbated by global heating, are triggering dangerous chain reactions in regions like Alaska, the Himalayas, the Andes, Greenland, and the Alps, leading to disasters such as the recent events in Nepal and Tibet. It highlights the increasing interaction between climate...
summary.zh: 文章警告说，全球变暖加剧了冰雪融化，正在阿拉斯加、喜马拉雅山脉、安第斯山脉、格陵兰岛和阿尔卑斯山等地区引发危险的连锁反应，导致了尼泊尔和西藏最近发生的灾难。这凸显了气候变化与地质事件之间日益增长的相互作用。

body.en: In Alaska, the Himalayas, the Andes, Greenland, and perhaps also the Alps, deadly chain reactions are just waiting to be triggered You may not have felt it, but the earth beneath our feet is getting twitchier, and global heating is to blame. As temperatures surge and climate breakdown accelerates, interactions between climate and geology are becoming ever more apparent – as marked by last week’s horrific events in Nepal and Tibet . We still have a bit of a blind spot when it comes to the idea that a changing climate can impact what scientists call the geosphere, but the evidence has long been incontestable. In 2021, a similar deluge ripped through a series of mountain valleys in the Indian Himalayan state of Uttarakhand , severely damaging two hydroelectric power plants and taking about 200 lives. In August 2025, a colossal landslide in an Alaskan fjord created a 500-metre-high wave in an area frequented by cruise ships. A few months earlier, the collapse of part of a glacier in Switzerland’s Valais canton caused a debris-laden torrent that destroyed and buried most of the already evacuated village of Blatten. Bill McGuire is professor emeritus of geophysical and climate hazards at UCL. His latest book is The Fate of the World – a History and Future of the Climate Crisis Continue reading...
body.zh: 在阿拉斯加、喜马拉雅山、安第斯山脉、格陵兰岛，或许还有阿尔卑斯山，致命的连锁反应正等待着被触发。你可能没有感觉到，但我们脚下的地球正在变得越来越抽搐，而全球变暖是罪魁祸首。随着气温飙升和气候崩溃加速，气候和地质之间的相互作用变得越来越明显 — — 上周尼泊尔和西藏发生的恐怖事件就表明了这一点。当谈到气候变化会影响科学家所谓的地圈这一观点时，我们仍然存在一些盲点，但证据长期以来是无可争议的。 2021 年，类似的洪水席卷了印度喜马拉雅山北阿坎德邦的一系列山谷，严重损坏了两座水力发电厂，并夺去了约 200 人的生命。 2025 年 8 月，阿拉斯加峡湾发生巨大山体滑坡，在游轮经常光顾的地区引发了 500 米高的巨浪。几个月前，瑞士瓦莱州的部分冰川崩塌引发了一场充满碎片的洪流，摧毁并掩埋了已经疏散的布拉滕村的大部分地区。比尔·麦奎尔是伦敦大学学院地球物理和气候灾害名誉教授。他的最新著作是《世界的命运——气候危机的历史与未来》继续阅读...

reflection.en: The earth itself groans under the weight of human impact, as described in Romans 8:22. The recent floods in Nepal and Tibet, linked to melting glaciers, serve as a stark reminder that our planet's systems are interconnected and vulnerable. As we witness these 'deadly chain reactions,' we are called to acknowledge our stewardship and the profound...
reflection.zh: 正如罗马书8:22所描述的，大地本身也在承受着人类活动带来的重负而叹息。尼泊尔和西藏近期因冰川融化引发的洪水，是地球系统相互关联且脆弱的严峻警示。当我们目睹这些“致命的连锁反应”时，我们被呼召去承认我们作为管家所负的责任，以及我们行为对受造之物产生的深远影响。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Country diary: The wasps’ nest in our shed is a work of art, a family saga | Mark Cocker
title.zh: 乡村日记：我们棚屋里的黄蜂巢是一个艺术品，一个家族史诗

summary.en: For ten weeks, the author kept his shed door closed to allow a colony of wasps to build their nest undisturbed. Now that the activity has ceased, he can finally admire their intricate creation.
summary.zh: 十周来，作者关闭了棚屋的门，让一群黄蜂不受打扰地筑巢。现在活动已经停止，他终于可以欣赏它们精巧的杰作了。

body.en: Buxton, Derbyshire: For 10 weeks the door of our shed was shut while a colony got to work. Now, finally, we can admire their achievement It was 9 June when I noticed a miniature paper “lampshade” hanging from the back beam of our shed. “Look at this wasps’ nest,” I shouted before realising that some of its creators were heading straight for me. We shut those doors and weren’t been able to open them for 10 weeks. In that time, all we knew was that a sisterhood of wasps was trafficking every few seconds to the shed’s rear wall. They then flew up into a slit giving access to the interior. Only this week, now almost all the activity has ceased, have we managed to reopen the doors. Continue reading...
body.zh: 德比郡巴克斯顿：我们棚屋的门关闭了 10 周，而一群蜂群却开始工作。现在，我们终于可以欣赏他们的成就了。6月9日，我注意到我们棚子的后梁上挂着一个微型纸质“灯罩”。 “看看这个黄蜂巢，”我喊道，然后才意识到它的一些创造者正在径直朝我走来。我们关上了这些门，十个星期都无法打开它们。那时，我们所知道的是一群黄蜂每隔几秒钟就会贩运到棚屋的后墙上。然后它们飞进一条通往内部的缝隙。直到本周，几乎所有活动都已停止，我们才设法重新开门。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The author marvels at the wasps' ten-week labor, a testament to their industriousness and the intricate beauty of their creation. This reminds us that all work, no matter how small or by whom it is done, can be an act of devotion when undertaken with diligence and purpose, as if for Yahweh Himself. Colossians 3:23 encourages us to 'do everything for the...
reflection.zh: 作者惊叹于黄蜂十周的辛劳，这是它们勤奋工作和创造出精巧之美的证明。这提醒我们，无论工作多么微小，由谁来完成，只要我们勤奋而有目的地去做，都可以成为一种奉献，如同是为雅伟自己所做。 歌罗西书3:23鼓励我们“凡所行的，都要求荣耀神”，在眼前的任务中找到尊严和意义，无论是筑巢还是追求我们自己的使命。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: The world’s reefs are disappearing. Coral trafficking is booming
title.zh: 世界珊瑚礁正在消失，珊瑚贩运却在蓬勃发展

summary.en: ArtReef Rocks, an online shop selling aquarium accessories, gained popularity during the COVID-19 pandemic by offering custom reefs and sculpted landscapes. The company, based in the Philippines, received praise for its excellent packaging, quick delivery, and customer service from its U.S. clients. It exhibited at...
summary.zh: ArtReef Rocks 是一家销售水族馆配件的在线商店，在新冠疫情期间因提供定制珊瑚礁和雕塑景观而声名鹊起。这家总部位于菲律宾的公司，其美国客户称赞其出色的包装、快速的交付和客户服务。该公司于 2023 年参加了主要的咸水水族贸易展览会。

body.en: ArtReef Rocks was an up-and-coming online shop offering aquarium accessories that made waves during the COVID-19 pandemic, offering hobbyists custom reefs and sculpted landscapes for their fish tanks. Aquarists raved about excellent packaging (“Not a single broken piece!”), quick turnarounds (“Arrived in only 4 days.”), and client support (“Customer service is amazing.”) — compliments that mean a lot for an online store that operates in the Philippines, more than 10,000 miles from its U.S. clients. The company gained a solid following about six years ago within a few years and exhibited in 2023 at some of the world’s biggest saltwater aquarium trade shows: the Reefapalooza in New York and Orlando, both in the U.S. Officially registered with the Philippines’ Department of Trade and Industry as Pandorocks Artreef Artificial Reef’s Rocks Aquarium and Accessories Trading, ArtReef had distributors in the U.S., parts of Europe, Australia, the United Arab Emirates, Israel, and other countries. Back home, its late founder and owner, Glenn Albert Binoya, is credited by the local reefing community as the “inventor” of unique aquarium landscaping described as “artificial live rocks” — substrates made of the mineral aragonite and crushed reef rocks. But court records in the U.S. show another side to Binoya’s business. In 2022, 10 U.S. nationals were indicted by authorities in the state of Alaska for trafficking corals in violation of the Lacey Act that regulates wildlife trade. They were accused of illegally selling coral and unlawfully conspiring to smuggle wildlife. Each of the accused men operated…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: ArtReef Rocks 是一家新兴的在线商店，提供水族箱配件，在 COVID-19 大流行期间引起轰动，为爱好者提供定制珊瑚礁和为鱼缸雕刻景观。水族爱好者们对出色的包装（“没有一个破损的部件！”）、快速的周转（“仅 4 天就到货了。”）和客户支持（“客户服务太棒了。”）赞不绝口——对于一家在菲律宾经营的在线商店来说，这些赞美意义重大，距离美国客户超过 10,000 英里。该公司在大约六年前的几年内赢得了坚实的追随者，并于 2023 年在一些世界上最大的咸水水族馆贸易展上展出：纽约和奥兰多的 Reefapalooza，均在美国。在菲律宾贸易和工业部正式注册为 Pandorocks Artreef 人工珊瑚礁岩石水族馆和配件贸易，ArtReef 在美国、欧洲部分地区、澳大利亚、阿拉伯联合酋长国、以色列等国家。在家乡，其已故创始人兼所有者格伦·阿尔伯特·比诺亚 (Glenn Albert Binoya) 被当地珊瑚礁社区誉为独特水族馆景观的“发明者”，这种景观被称为“人造活石”——由矿物文石和碎珊瑚礁石制成的基质。但美国的法庭记录显示了比诺亚业务的另一面。 2022 年，10 名美国公民因违反监管野生动物贸易的《雷斯法案》贩运珊瑚而被阿拉斯加州当局起诉。他们被指控非法出售珊瑚和非法密谋走私野生动物。每名被告均进行了操作……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The booming trade in custom reefs, while catering to hobbyists, often involves the exploitation of natural coral, a vital part of marine ecosystems. This practice raises questions about our responsibility to protect the voiceless and vulnerable parts of creation. We are called to advocate for the health of our planet, ensuring that our desires do not lead...
reflection.zh: 定制珊瑚礁的蓬勃发展虽然满足了爱好者的需求，但往往涉及对天然珊瑚的开采，而珊瑚是海洋生态系统的重要组成部分。这种做法引发了关于我们保护受造界中那些无声和脆弱部分的责任问题。我们蒙召要为地球的健康发声，确保我们的欲望不会导致破坏维持生命的自然世界的行为。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Growing Indigenous food trees in East Africa fights malnutrition and biodiversity loss
title.zh: 肯尼亚东非土著食物树的种植，对抗营养不良和生物多样性丧失

summary.en: In East Africa, the scarcity of native food-bearing trees like the masuku plum, due to deforestation, contributes to malnutrition and biodiversity loss. Initiatives are underway to reverse this trend by growing these trees, which are in high demand in local markets.
summary.zh: 在东非，由于森林砍伐，像马苏库李子这样的本土食物树日益稀少，这加剧了营养不良和生物多样性丧失。目前正有相关举措试图通过种植这些在当地市场需求旺盛的树木来扭转这一趋势。

body.en: When the sugary-sweet masuku plum is in season in Malawi, locals go wild over it. “They will eat it while traveling, in the bath, on the streets … they just eat,” said Richard Swirah, an agroecologist with the Malawi chapter of the organization WeForest. Swirah has seen firsthand that native fruits like the masuku (Uapaca kirkiana) are in high demand in local markets — ”they sell like hot cakes,” he told Mongabay during a Zoom interview — but the supply is incredibly scarce. Owing to high levels of deforestation, native food-bearing trees such as the Masuku are becoming increasingly rare in Malawi and across East Africa. Recent work hopes to reverse this trend. Swirah is one of 40 people who participated in workshops earlier this year to share knowledge and questions about the use of Indigenous food trees in landscape restoration work, an area where they have so far been underutilized. Organized by University of Copenhagen postdoctoral fellow Emilie Vansant, the workshops identified the main challenges to integrating Indigenous food trees into the East African landscape, where tree-planting initiatives often focus on fast-growing, non-native timber species. These findings are summarized in a paper published in June. An agroforestry tour during a workshop at the Permaculture Paradise Institute in Lilongwe, Malawi. Image by Emilie Vansant. “Something important to highlight is that this work is not advocating for all introduced or all Indigenous trees, but for an integration — broadening the scope a bit to include these Indigenous tree species, because of…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 当马拉维甜甜的马苏库李上市时，当地人会为之疯狂。 WeForest 组织马拉维分会的农业生态学家理查德·斯威拉 (Richard Swirah) 说：“他们会在旅行时、洗澡时、街上吃……他们只是吃东西。” Swirah 亲眼目睹了像 masuku (Uapaca kirkiana) 这样的本土水果在当地市场的需求量很大——“它们卖得很热，”他在 Zoom 采访中告诉 Mongabay——但供应却极其稀缺。由于森林砍伐严重，马苏库树等本土食用树木在马拉维和整个东非变得越来越稀有。最近的工作希望扭转这一趋势。 Swirah 是今年早些时候参加研讨会的 40 人之一，他们分享了有关在景观恢复工作中使用土著食用树的知识和问题，迄今为止，该领域的土著食用树尚未得到充分利用。这些研讨会由哥本哈根大学博士后研究员 Emilie Vansant 组织，确定了将本土食用树融入东非景观的主要挑战，东非的植树计划通常侧重于快速生长的非本土木材树种。这些发现总结在六月发表的一篇论文中。在马拉维利隆圭永续农业天堂研究所举办的研讨会期间进行农林业之旅。图片由艾米莉·范桑特拍摄。 “需要强调的重要一点是，这项工作并不是提倡所有引进的或所有本土树木，而是提倡整合——稍微扩大范围以包括这些本土树种，因为……本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: The abundance of life in creation, as described in Psalm 104, is a testament to Yahweh's wisdom. The efforts to reintroduce native fruit trees in East Africa not only combat malnutrition but also restore the rich biodiversity that reflects the Creator's intricate design. It is a reminder that caring for the earth is an act of honoring its Maker.
reflection.zh: 诗篇104篇所描述的造物中生命的丰盛，是雅伟智慧的明证。在东非重新引入本土果树的努力，不仅对抗了营养不良，也恢复了反映造物主精妙设计的丰富生物多样性。这提醒我们，关爱大地是对其创造者的尊崇之举。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Gulf of Mexico’s unique Orca Basin shouldn’t become a carbon dump (commentary)
title.zh: 墨西哥湾独特的虎鲸盆地不应成为碳倾倒场（评论）

summary.en: Standing on a research vessel at 3 a.m., gazing into the dark waters of the Gulf of Mexico's Orca Basin, the author feels a profound sense of reverence, protection, and humility, comparing it to the awe inspired by the Grand Canyon. Having spent years studying this deep, unseen environment, the author argues against...
summary.zh: 凌晨3点，作者站在研究船的甲板上，凝视着墨西哥湾虎鲸盆地漆黑的海水，心中充满了敬畏、保护和谦卑之情，这种感觉如同站在大峡谷边缘看日落。作者多年来一直在研究这片深邃、不为人知的海域，他反对将其用作碳倾倒场，强调其独特性和应受尊重的地位。

body.en: It’s 3 a.m. and I am standing on the deck of a research vessel, staring into water so dark it looks solid. I feel what I felt standing at the rim of the Grand Canyon, watching the sun set: there are places in this world deserving of our reverence, our protection, and our humility. The Orca Basin is one of those places. I have spent years working in the deep Gulf of Mexico, lowering instruments into the dark, pulling up sediment cores that smell of sulfur, watching remotely operated vehicle (ROV) footage of a seafloor that most people will never see, and few even know exists. Lying roughly 168 miles (270 kilometers) off the Louisiana coast, beneath more than a mile (2.2 km) of water, the Orca Basin is one of the most extraordinary environments on the planet. It is a lake on the seafloor, where the water is so salty and so dense that it resists mixing with the overlying seawater, and has occupied a vast depression on the gulf floor for thousands of years. Spanning roughly 154 square miles (nearly 400 km2), its salinity runs nearly 10 times that of normal seawater. No oxygen, no multicellular animals venture below its the ghostly boundary, where normal ocean gives way to something ancient and strange. When descending ROV cameras near the surface of the Orca Basin’s salty water, the interface shimmers like heat rising from sunbaked asphalt — a mirage a mile underwater. Map of the Orca Basin in the…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 现在是凌晨 3 点，我站在一艘研究船的甲板上，凝视着漆黑的海水，看起来很坚固。我的感受与站在大峡谷边缘观看日落时的感受一样：这个世界上有些地方值得我们敬畏、保护和谦卑。逆戟鲸盆地就是其中之一。我在墨西哥湾深处工作了数年，将仪器放入黑暗中，拉起带有硫磺气味的沉积物核心，观看遥控潜水器（ROV）拍摄的海底镜头，大多数人永远不会看到，甚至很少有人知道它的存在。虎鲸盆地距离路易斯安那州海岸约 168 英里（270 公里），位于超过一英里（2.2 公里）的水下，是地球上环境最奇特的地区之一。它是海底的一个湖泊，湖水的咸度和密度非常大，无法与上覆海水混合，几千年来一直占据着海湾海底的一个巨大洼地。面积约 154 平方英里（近 400 平方公里），其盐度几乎是正常海水的 10 倍。没有氧气，没有多细胞动物在其幽灵般的边界以下冒险，正常的海洋被古老而奇怪的东西所取代。当 ROV 相机下降到 Orca 盆地咸水表面附近时，界面会像晒太阳的沥青中升起的热量一样闪闪发光——这是水下一英里处的海市蜃楼。虎鲸盆地地图……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The deep ocean, like the Grand Canyon, evokes a sense of awe and mystery, reminding us of the vastness and intricate design of Yahweh's creation. The author's plea to protect the Orca Basin from becoming a 'carbon dump' calls us to recognize our role as stewards, treating these unique places with the reverence and humility they deserve.
reflection.zh: 深邃的海洋，如同大峡谷一般，唤起我们对雅伟创造的浩瀚与精妙设计的敬畏与神秘感。作者呼吁保护虎鲸盆地免遭“碳倾倒”，提醒我们认识到自己作为管家的角色，以应有的敬畏和谦卑之心对待这些独特的地方。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Thriving lichen-loving moth is an exception to the rule | Letter
title.zh: 繁盛的嗜石蛾是规则的例外 | 信

summary.en: Mark R Shaw states that airborne pollutants have caused a massive decline in insect numbers, in response to Nigel Brown’s understandable joy in finding a rosy footman moth in his trap (Country Diary, 25 August), which ends with “an important ecological message” that the substantial elimination of airborne sulphur...
summary.zh: 马克·R·肖（Mark R Shaw）表示，空气污染物已导致昆虫数量急剧下降，以回应奈杰尔·布朗（Nigel Brown）在他捕虫器中发现一只玫瑰色足蛾（rosy footman...

body.en: Mark R Shaw says airborne pollutants have caused a massive decline in insect numbers, in response to a Country Diary Nigel Brown’s understandable joy in finding a rosy footman in his moth trap ( Country diary, 25 August ) ends with “an important ecological message” that the substantial elimination of airborne sulphur dioxide pollution, which was devastating to the lichens and algae on which caterpillars of footman moths largely feed, has allowed recovery and even geographical spread. However, what might be a more realistic message is that the balance has changed in our major airborne pollutants since the 1990s, from sulphur dioxide to nitrogen oxides (a byproduct of internal combustion engines, among others), and this has benefited lichens and algae, which thrive under the current regime – and hence also footman moths as a special case. Continue reading...
body.zh: 马克·R·肖（Mark R Shaw）表示，空气中的污染物导致昆虫数量大幅下降，这是对《乡村日记》奈杰尔·布朗（Nigel Brown）在他的飞蛾陷阱中发现玫瑰色男仆的喜悦的回应（《乡村日记》，8月25日），其结尾是“一个重要的生态信息”，即空气中的二氧化硫污染的大幅消除（这种污染对地衣和藻类是毁灭性的，而男仆蛾的毛毛虫主要以这些藻类为食），从而实现了恢复甚至地理扩散。然而，更现实的信息可能是，自 20 世纪 90 年代以来，我们主要空气污染物的平衡发生了变化，从二氧化硫变为氮氧化物（内燃机等的副产品），这有利于地衣和藻类，它们在当前制度下蓬勃发展，因此也有利于步兵蛾作为一个特例。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The recovery of the rosy footman moth, detailed in this letter, is a testament to the resilience of creation when human impact lessens. The intricate relationship between the moth's caterpillars and the lichens they feed on, thriving once more as sulphur dioxide levels dropped, points to the delicate balance Yahweh designed into ecosystems. Even as new...
reflection.zh: 这封信中详细描述的玫瑰色足蛾的恢复，是当人类影响减小时，创造物韧性的证明。当二氧化硫水平下降后，这种蛾的幼虫与其赖以生存的地衣之间错综复杂的关系得以再次繁盛，这指向了雅伟在生态系统中设计的精妙平衡。即使出现了氮氧化物这样新的挑战，这个故事也提醒我们，自然界以其复杂性和相互关联性，反映了其创造者的智慧。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: As Death Toll From Nepal Flood Rises, Officials Call to Tackle Warming
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水死亡人数上升，官员呼吁应对气候变暖

summary.en: Five days after a devastating flood swept through Rasuwa, Nepal, the death toll continues to rise. Authorities reported on Monday that 903 people have been confirmed dead, with another 4,247 missing, as the country grapples with a disaster experts suggest may be linked to melting glacial ice.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔拉苏瓦地区发生灾难性洪水五天后，死亡人数持续攀升。当局周一报告称，已有903人确认死亡，另有4247人失踪，该国正努力应对一场专家认为可能与冰川融化有关的灾难。

body.en:
Five days after a calamitous flood washed through Rasuwa, Nepal, the death toll continues to climb. Authorities said Monday that 903 people have been confirmed dead, while another 4,247 are missing, as the country reels from a disaster that experts say may be linked to the melting of glacial ice.

Officials believe the collapse of a glacier on Langtang Lirung peak sent an avalanche of ice and rock careening into a valley below, where it blocked the flow of the Trishuli River. When the rock barrier finally gave way, they say, it unleashed a rush of water and mud several stories high. The floodwaters inundated villages along the river, not just in Nepal but also in neighboring Tibet, where 16 people are confirmed dead and another 546 are still missing, according to Chinese state media.

Researchers with the HiRisk project, which tracks threats from melting ice in the Himalayas, say that the shrinking and thawing of glaciers may have fueled the disaster. Over the last three decades, Nepali mountains have lost roughly a third of their ice , the U.N. says. The glacier on Langtang Lirung retreated roughly 1,500 feet between 1990 and 2020, and experts say the loss of ice may have left the slope more vulnerable to a landslide.

Further upping the risk of collapse was a warm spell that melted snow atop Langtang Lirung in the days before the flood. “That snowmelt had to go somewhere – and it may have supplied the water that lubricated the rockfall,” said Umesh Haritashya , a geoscientist at the University of Dayton.

The upper Himalayas are warming nearly twice as fast as the global average, experts say, and August is the warmest time of year in the region. “While scientists are still studying the exact causes of this disaster, it is exactly the type of event that is triggered by climate change,” said Wouter Buytaert , a hydrologist at Imperial College London.

U.N. climate chief Simon Stiell said in a statement that a warming climate “is making tragedies like this one, and so many others around the world, much more likely, frequent, and severe, with vulnerable communities often hardest hit.”

In a press conference on Saturday, Nepal’s foreign minister, Shisir Khanal, called on countries to address warming. “We’d ask the world,” he said, “to take climate change as one of the major challenges that Nepal and its citizens face, and this has to be a global effort.”
body.zh: 尼泊尔拉苏瓦发生灾难性洪水五天后，死亡人数继续攀升。当局周一表示，已确认 903 人死亡，另有 4,247 人失踪，专家称这场灾难可能与冰川融化有关，该国正遭受这场灾难的困扰。 官员们认为，Langtang Lirung峰上的冰川崩塌导致雪崩，冰块和岩石倾泻到下面的山谷中，阻塞了Trishuli河的水流。他们说，当岩石屏障最终崩溃时，它释放出了几层楼高的水和泥浆。据中国官方媒体报道，洪水不仅淹没了尼泊尔，还淹没了邻近的西藏沿河村庄，已确认 16 人死亡，另有 546 人失踪。 HiRisk项目的研究人员追踪喜马拉雅山冰川融化的威胁，他们表示，冰川的缩小和融化可能加剧了这场灾难。联合国称，在过去三十年里，尼泊尔山区大约失去了三分之一的冰。 1990 年至 2020 年间，Langtang Lirung 上的冰川后退了大约 1,500 英尺，专家表示，冰的消失可能使斜坡更容易发生山体滑坡。 洪水发生前几天，Langtang Lirung 山顶的积雪融化，进一步增加了塌陷的风险。代顿大学地球科学家乌梅什·哈里塔什亚 (Umesh Haritashya) 表示：“融雪必须流向某个地方，它可能提供了润滑落石的水。” 专家表示，喜马拉雅山上游的变暖速度几乎是全球平均水平的两倍，而八月是该地区一年中最温暖的时间。伦敦帝国理工学院水文学家 Wouter Buytaert 表示：“虽然科学家仍在研究这场灾难的确切原因，但这正是气候变化引发的事件类型。” 联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔在一份声明中表示，气候变暖“正在导致像这样的悲剧以及世界各地许多其他悲剧发生，而且发生的可能性更大、更频繁、更严重，脆弱社区往往受到的打击最严重。” 在周六的新闻发布会上，尼泊尔外交部长希西尔·卡纳尔呼吁各国应对气候变暖问题。 “我们要求世界，”他说，“将气候变化视为尼泊尔及其公民面临的主要挑战之一，而这必须是全球的共同努力。”

reflection.en: The earth groans, as the Apostle Paul wrote, and this flood in Nepal is a stark reminder of that reality. The melting glacier that likely triggered this disaster points to the deep interconnectedness of our world and the impact of environmental changes on vulnerable communities. May we heed the calls to address warming and care for the creation entrusted to...
reflection.zh: 正如使徒保罗所写，万物都在一同叹息，而尼泊尔的这场洪水正是这一现实的严峻提醒。可能引发这场灾难的冰川融化，揭示了我们世界深刻的相互联系，以及环境变化对脆弱社区的影响。愿我们听从应对气候变暖的呼吁，并照管那托付给我们的受造之物。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: ‘It was like fighting a dinosaur’: Sydney shark attack survivor recalls left hook that helped save her life
title.zh: “就像在与恐龙搏斗”：悉尼鲨鱼袭击幸存者回忆用左勾拳救了自己一命

summary.en: Leah Stewart, who lost an arm after a shark attack at Sydney's Coogee beach, described punching a four-meter great white shark as it lunged at her. She recounted asking herself 'which limb am I willing to lose' as she fought back against the predator.
summary.zh: 在悉尼库吉海滩遭遇鲨鱼袭击并失去一条手臂的莉亚·斯图尔特（Leah Stewart）描述了她如何用一记“左勾拳”击退一条四米长的巨鲨。她回忆说，在与鲨鱼搏斗时，她问自己“我愿意失去哪条肢体”。

body.en: Leah Stewart, who was bitten while swimming at Coogee beach, says she asked herself ‘which limb am I willing to lose’ as she fought back An Australian woman who lost an arm after a shark attack at a Sydney beach has described delivering a “left hook” punch to the four-metre great white as its open mouth came within centimetres of her face. Leah Stewart, 34, a teacher and mother of a one-year-old, was attacked by the shark while on a morning swim at Coogee beach in Sydney’s eastern suburbs on 13 June. Continue reading...
body.zh: 莉亚·斯图尔特(Leah Stewart)在库吉海滩游泳时被咬伤，她在反击时问自己“我愿意失去哪一条肢体”。一名在悉尼海滩遭遇鲨鱼袭击后失去手臂的澳大利亚妇女描述，当鲨鱼张开的嘴距离她的脸只有几厘米时，她向这条四米长的大白鲨打出了“左勾拳”。 34 岁的 Leah Stewart 是一名教师，也是一名一岁孩子的母亲，6 月 13 日，她在悉尼东郊库吉海滩晨泳时遭到鲨鱼袭击。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Leah Stewart’s harrowing encounter with a great white shark highlights the primal instinct for survival when faced with overwhelming danger. Her courageous fight back, even as she contemplated losing a limb, speaks to the human spirit’s capacity to resist and overcome when confronted by forces that threaten to consume it. It reminds us that even in the face...
reflection.zh: 莉亚·斯图尔特与大白鲨惊心动魄的遭遇，凸显了在面对压倒性危险时，人类最原始的生存本能。她勇敢地反击，甚至在思考失去肢体的可能时，也展现了人类精神在面对威胁要吞噬自己的力量时的抵抗和克服能力。这提醒我们，即使面对巨大的邪恶，求生和为生命而战的意志也可以是一种强大的力量。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Country diary: For the gannets of Bass Rock, it’s a slow road to recovery | Lev Parikian

reflection.en: The author observes the swift, precise movements of house martins, a testament to the intricate design woven into the fabric of creation. These birds, navigating their environment with such skill, remind us that the natural world itself speaks of its Creator's wisdom and power. In their effortless flight, we see a glimpse of the divine artistry that...
reflection.zh: 作者观察到白鹇鸟敏捷而精准的飞行，这是造物界精巧设计的明证。这些鸟类以如此娴熟的技巧驾驭着它们的环境，提醒我们大自然本身就彰显着其创造者的智慧与大能。在它们毫不费力的飞翔中，我们瞥见了维系万物的神圣艺术。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.

title.en: In Africa, a Growing Underground Solar Boom
title.zh: 非洲地下太阳能蓬勃发展

summary.en: Households and businesses across Africa are driving a significant, yet largely unrecorded, solar energy boom. This rapid expansion of rooftop arrays and small-scale systems is pushing new solar installations to record levels, despite often being overlooked in official statistics.
summary.zh: 非洲各地的家庭和企业正在推动一场规模可观但大多未被官方记录的太阳能热潮。屋顶太阳能板和其他小型系统的迅速普及，正将新增太阳能装机量推向创纪录水平，尽管这些数据常被官方统计所忽视。

body.en:
Households and businesses are driving a solar boom in Africa, where rooftop arrays and other small systems account for the bulk of new solar installations. But this rapid buildout, which is driving solar additions to record levels, is largely unaccounted for in official statistics, analysts say.

“The rapid spread of distributed solar in sub-Saharan Africa is an underreported success story,” write analysts at the energy think tank Ember and the African Tech Futures Lab. “However, since African countries are running blind to this change, they are not reflecting this rise in distributed solar in their plans.”

Because most distributed solar systems are not tracked or regulated, most households cannot sell their surplus power back to the grid, analysts say. Ultimately, the lack of data on distributed solar could lead countries to underinvest in the batteries and grid infrastructure needed to store and distribute solar energy, and to overinvest in fossil fuels.

Because official statistics are lacking, analysts used customs data to track the flow of solar equipment to Africa from China, the biggest manufacturer of solar panels globally. They found that Africa will add the equivalent of 17 gigawatts of solar capacity this year, more than enough to meet the continent’s average yearly growth in demand. Some 36 countries will install record volumes of solar in 2026, while 19 will install more than twice as much solar as they did last year.

In countries with rickety power grids, many people rely on diesel generators to cope with recurrent blackouts. But analysts say the Iran war has pushed up diesel prices, making solar a more attractive alternative. “Generating the same electricity from a diesel generator as from a solar panel would cost as much in diesel, every three months, as the solar panel itself,” they write. In almost every country in Africa, more than half of solar capacity installed since 2023 is distributed, analysts estimate.

“This transition is chaotic and disruptive, and far from the orderly model planned in national strategies,” said Joel Nana, research director at African Tech Futures Lab. “The choice now is whether these distributed assets remain a parallel power system that compensates for grid failure or are integrated in ways that unleash a wider range of benefits.”
body.zh: 家庭和企业正在推动非洲太阳能热潮，其中屋顶阵列和其他小型系统占新太阳能装置的大部分。但分析人士表示，这种快速建设将太阳能发电量推向创纪录水平，但官方统计数据很大程度上没有考虑到这一点。 能源智库 Ember 和非洲科技期货实验室的分析师写道：“分布式太阳能在撒哈拉以南非洲的迅速普及是一个被低估的成功故事。” “然而，由于非洲国家对这一变化视而不见，他们没有在计划中反映分布式太阳能的增长。” 分析师表示，由于大多数分布式太阳能系统没有被跟踪或监管，因此大多数家庭无法将剩余电力卖回电网。最终，缺乏分布式太阳能数据可能导致各国对存储和分配太阳能所需的电池和电网基础设施投资不足，并对化石燃料投资过度。 由于缺乏官方统计数据，分析师利用海关数据来追踪从全球最大太阳能电池板制造商中国流向非洲的太阳能设备。他们发现，非洲今年将新增相当于 17 吉瓦的太阳能装机容量，足以满足非洲大陆年均增长的需求。到 2026 年，约 36 个国家的太阳能安装量将创历史新高，其中 19 个国家的太阳能安装量将是去年的两倍多。 在电网不稳定的国家，许多人依靠柴油发电机来应对经常性的停电。但分析人士表示，伊朗战争推高了柴油价格，使太阳能成为更具吸引力的替代方案。他们写道：“每三个月用柴油发电机产生与太阳能电池板相同的电力，柴油成本与太阳能电池板本身一样多。”分析师估计，自 2023 年以来，非洲几乎每个国家安装的太阳能发电量一半以上都是分布式的。 非洲科技未来实验室研究主任乔尔·纳纳表示：“这种转变是混乱和破坏性的，与国家战略中规划的有序模式相去甚远。” “现在的选择是，这些分布式资产是否仍然是一个并行电力系统，以补偿电网故障，或者以释放更广泛效益的方式进行集成。”

reflection.en: The 'underground solar boom' in Africa, where households and businesses are rapidly adopting small-scale systems, highlights a profound human capacity for discernment and innovation. As people seek practical solutions for their energy needs, they embody the wisdom of acquiring knowledge and applying it to improve daily life, even when official recognition...
reflection.zh: 非洲“地下太阳能热潮”中，家庭和企业迅速采用小型系统，这凸显了人类卓越的洞察力和创新能力。当人们寻求实用的能源解决方案时，他们体现了获取知识并将其应用于改善日常生活的智慧，即便官方认可迟迟未到。这种足智多谋的精神反映了人类深入理解和利用周围世界以造福自身的内在动力。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: A Hard-Won Rule to Cut Chemical Plant Pollution Is Being Unraveled
title.zh: 一项来之不易的削减化工厂污染的规定正被逐步废除

summary.en: In 2024, the Biden administration enacted wide-ranging regulations to protect communities near petrochemical plants from air toxics. The Trump administration has since granted exemptions to scores of polluting facilities and is working to rewrite the long-awaited rule.
summary.zh: 2024年，拜登政府颁布了广泛的法规，以保护石化厂附近的社区免受有毒空气的侵害。自那时以来，特朗普政府已给予许多污染设施豁免权，并正在着手改写这项期待已久的规定。

body.en:
In 2024, the Biden administration enacted wide-ranging regulations to protect communities near petrochemical plants from air toxics. The Trump administration has since granted exemptions to scores of polluting facilities and is working to rewrite the long-awaited rule.

In April 2024, Tish Taylor and her father, Robert, stood behind President Joe Biden’s Environmental Protection Agency chief, Michael Regan, as he signed a regulation designed to dramatically reduce toxic pollution from petrochemical plants like those that cluster near the Taylors’ homes along the lower Mississippi River, in Louisiana.

Taylor struggled not to cry through the signing ceremony, which followed years of demands from communities like hers — in the 85-mile corridor between New Orleans and Baton Rouge that has become known as Cancer Alley — for tighter limits on plants’ emissions. The new regulation, known as the HON rule, was “a wonderful gift to generations ahead of us,” Taylor said. “It’s hard for me to find the words to say how validated we felt.”

For decades, regulations on emissions of hazardous chemicals such as toluene, ethylene oxide, and vinyl chloride have been weaker than restrictions on more common pollutants, such as those emitted by vehicles.

The Biden administration took major steps to strengthen Clean Air Act rules on those hazardous air pollutants, and the HON rule was a centerpiece of that effort. Toughening requirements on six different pollutants at more than 200 petrochemical plants , it was one of a slate of regulations the Biden administration enacted on air toxics, each covering a specific industry, from steelmaking to tire manufacturing.

But shortly after President Donald Trump began his second term, his administration began unraveling those rules, including the one the Taylors had so recently celebrated. Last year, Trump granted two-year exemptions from the HON rule to more than 50 petrochemical facilities. This July, he issued 20 more temporary exemptions, and the EPA said it would propose a rewrite of the regulation this fall. The new version is all but certain to significantly scale back the rule’s protections.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

“Everything that the Biden administration did to help protect us was pretty much just thrown in the garbage,” Tish Taylor said in July, and replaced by “a death sentence.” St. John the Baptist Parish, where her family lives, has the country’s highest risk of cancer from air pollution — nearly 50 times the national average. A disproportionate percentage of those exposed to the highest levels of pollution in the region are Black.

A set of amendments to several existing regulations on toxic air pollutants, the HON rule — which stands for Hazardous...
body.zh: 2024 年，拜登政府颁布了广泛的法规，保护石化厂附近的社区免受空气有毒物质的影响。此后，特朗普政府已对数十家污染设施给予豁免，并正在努力重写这项期待已久的规则。 2024 年 4 月，蒂什·泰勒和她的父亲罗伯特支持乔·拜登总统的环境保护局局长迈克尔·里根签署了一项法规，旨在大幅减少石化厂（例如路易斯安那州密西西比河下游泰勒家附近聚集的石化厂）的有毒污染。 泰勒在签字仪式上努力不哭，多年来，像她这样的社区——位于新奥尔良和巴吞鲁日之间的 85 英里走廊，被称为“癌症巷”——要求更严格地限制植物排放。泰勒说，这项被称为 HON 规则的新规定是“给我们前几代人的一份美妙礼物”。 “我很难找到合适的词来表达我们的感受。” 几十年来，对甲苯、环氧乙烷和氯乙烯等危险化学品排放的法规一直弱于对车辆排放等更常见污染物的限制。 拜登政府采取了重大措施，加强《清洁空气法》对这些有害空气污染物的规定，而 HON 规定是这一努力的核心。这是拜登政府针对空气有毒物质颁布的一系列法规之一，对 200 多家石化厂的六种不同污染物提出了严格要求，每项法规都涵盖从炼钢到轮胎制造等特定行业。 但在唐纳德·特朗普总统开始第二个任期后不久，他的政府开始解开这些规则，包括泰勒家族最近庆祝的规则。去年，特朗普向 50 多家石化设施授予两年 HON 规则豁免。今年 7 月，他又发布了 20 项临时豁免，美国环保署表示将在今年秋天提议重写该法规。新版本几乎肯定会大幅缩减该规则的保护范围。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 蒂什·泰勒 (Tish Taylor) 在 7 月表示：“拜登政府为保护我们所做的一切几乎都被扔进了垃圾堆，取而代之的是“死刑”。她家人居住的施洗者圣约翰教区因空气污染而患癌症的风险是全国最高的——几乎是全国平均水平的 50 倍。在该地区暴露于最高污染水平的人群中，黑人所占比例过高。 HON 规则是对多项有关有毒空气污染物的现行法规的一系列修正案，它代表危险……

reflection.en: The news describes how regulations meant to protect communities from toxic pollution are being weakened through exemptions and rewrites. This raises questions about justice and accountability for those living near these plants. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with God, principles that should guide leaders in protecting the...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻描述了旨在保护社区免受有毒污染的法规，正通过豁免和改写而被削弱。这引发了对那些居住在工厂附近的人们所应享有的公正和问责的疑问。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与雅伟同行，这些原则应指导领导者保护弱势群体。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Access to Urban Woodlands Linked With Lower Use of Antidepressants
title.zh: 城市林地可及性与抗抑郁药使用量较低相关

summary.en: A study from Scotland found that living near accessible urban woodlands significantly lowered the likelihood of being prescribed antidepressants. The research focused on Scotland's Woods In and Around Towns program, which aims to improve mental health by planting and restoring urban woodlands in deprived neighborhoods.
summary.zh: 苏格兰的一项研究发现，居住在可及的城市林地附近，服用抗抑郁药的可能性会显著降低。该研究聚焦于苏格兰的“城镇内及周边林地”项目，该项目旨在通过在贫困社区种植和恢复城市林地来改善心理健康。

body.en:
A study from Scotland found that living near an accessible urban woodland significantly lowered the likelihood of being prescribed antidepressants.

The research focused on Scotland’s Woods In and Around Towns program , which aims to plant, restore, or protect woodlands in deprived neighborhoods and make them accessible to the public by installing signs, trails, and walking paths. Launched in 2005, the WIAT program has revitalized nearly 30,000 acres of urban woodlands.

From the beginning, one of the central aims of the program has been to improve mental health. To gauge its success, researchers at the Universities of Edinburgh and Glasgow tracked more than 129,000 people across Scotland over five years. They found that when people moved to within a 10-minute walk of a WIAT woodland, their odds of being prescribed an antidepressant dropped by 10 percent, while their odds of being prescribed anti-anxiety medication dropped by 6 percent.

“Our results tell us that relatively modest investments in local green spaces can make a real difference to people’s mental health,” said lead author Scott Ogletree of the University of Edinburgh. The findings were published in The Lancet Planetary Health .

A host of prior studies have found that living near green spaces can reduce stress , improve moods , and lower the risk of developing anxiety or depression. Some research has even found that exposure to nature can help reduce violent crime. In light of the well-documented benefits of living near green spaces, the World Health Organization recommends urban planners establish at least 1 acre of green space within 1,000 feet of every home.
body.zh: 苏格兰的一项研究发现，居住在可到达的城市林地附近会显着降低服用抗抑郁药物的可能性。 该研究重点关注苏格兰城镇内及周边的森林计划，该计划旨在种植、恢复或保护贫困社区的林地，并通过安装标志、步道和步行道使公众能够进入这些林地。 WIAT 计划于 2005 年启动，已振兴了近 30,000 英亩的城市林地。 从一开始，该计划的中心目标之一就是改善心理健康。为了衡量其成功程度，爱丁堡大学和格拉斯哥大学的研究人员在五年内对苏格兰各地超过 129,000 人进行了追踪。他们发现，当人们搬到距离 WIAT 林地 10 分钟步行路程的地方时，他们服用抗抑郁药物的几率会下降 10%，而服用抗焦虑药物的几率会下降 6%。 “我们的研究结果告诉我们，对当地绿地的相对适度的投资可以对人们的心理健康产生真正的影响，”爱丁堡大学的主要作者斯科特·奥格特里说。研究结果发表在《柳叶刀行星健康》上。 先前的大量研究发现，居住在绿色空间附近可以减轻压力，改善情绪，并降低患焦虑或抑郁的风险。一些研究甚至发现，接触大自然有助于减少暴力犯罪。鉴于居住在绿色空间附近的好处已得到充分证明，世界卫生组织建议城市规划者在每个家庭 1,000 英尺范围内至少建立 1 英亩的绿色空间。

reflection.en: This study from Scotland offers a hopeful correlation: the presence of accessible green spaces in urban areas is linked to reduced reliance on antidepressants. It suggests that the simple act of being near nature can be a balm for the soul, echoing the ancient truth that Yahweh "heals the brokenhearted." May we recognize the profound connection between the...
reflection.zh: 这项来自苏格兰的研究提出了一个充满希望的关联：城市地区可及的绿色空间与减少对抗抑郁药的依赖有关。它表明，亲近大自然这一简单的行为可以抚慰心灵，呼应了古老的真理：雅伟“医治伤心的人”。 愿我们认识到受造世界与我们内心福祉之间深刻的联系，并努力为所有社区培育这样的空间。

verse.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

summary.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film,
